scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: Why Are Water Harvesting Projects Supported Under The Scheme?
answer: North East India largely has hilly regions where the supply of water is not regular throughout the year and during the dry season, there is no secured water supply in the institutes. Water harvesting projects are supported under the Scheme for assured water even during the dry season.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: Who Is The Implementing Agency For This Scheme?
answer: The Scheme is being implemented through the Indian Institute of Technology- Guwahati.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: What Is The Objective Of This Scheme?
answer: Objective: To enhance the functional efficiency of the technical institutes located in far-flung areas of North East India, by addressing deficiencies in water, electricity, and internet connectivity on the campuses.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: Why Is Setting Up An Initial Internet Connection Considered Under The Scheme?
answer: The availability/ connection of the internet facility is also not up to the desired level in North Eastern Region. To mitigate this problem, funding | for setting up an initial internet connection is considered under the Scheme. Recurring expenditures for the future shall have to be borne by the institution.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: Why Is The Scheme Making Provision For Installations For Captive Solar Power Energy?
answer: Most of the urban and rural areas in North Eastern India are deprived of continuous electricity supply, which not only affects daily life but also imparting of higher technical education. The scheme makes the provision of installations for captive solar power energy; at places where the solar energy is not effective, procurement of generators can be considered.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: What Is The Limit Of Funding For The "Solving Water Problems" Project?
answer: Project Name: Solving Water Problems Project | Limit of Funding: ₹ 15,00,000 | Duration of Project: 2 years from the date of receipt of the first installment.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: What Is The Limit Of Funding For The "Power/ Solar Energy Project" Project?
answer: Project Name: Power/ Solar Energy Project | Limit of Funding: ₹ 20,00,000 | Duration of Project: 6 months from the date of receipt of the fund for the purpose.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: What Is The Limit Of Funding For The "Internet Connection Project" Project?
answer: Project Name: Internet Connection Project | Limit of Funding: ₹ 5,00,000 | Duration of Project: 6 months from the date of receipt of the fund for the purpose.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: How Will The Disbursement Of The Funds Be Done?
answer: Disbursement of the Funds: | The first installment is an advance of 80% of the sanctioned grant. | The second installment is reimbursement on successful completion of the project and submission of requisite documents by the institute.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: What If The Institute Fails To Initiate The Project Within Six Months?
answer: If the project is not initiated within six months, the institute shall have to refund the complete grant with accrued interest to AICTE with justification.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: Who Should Audit The Utilization Certificate And Statement Of Accounts?
answer: Utilization Certificate and Statement of Accounts in prescribed proforma must be duly audited by the Finance Officer/Account Officer.

scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
question: What Documents Are To Be Submitted For The Procurement Of Solar Power Energy Equipment/Generator/Internet Connection?
answer: A. Documentary proof of cost etc. along with the purchase procedure/formalities to be adopted as per the prescribed order formalities indicated in the GFR. | b. A certificate from the Principal/ Competent Authority (concerned Secretary, State Government for Technical Education) that expenditure over and above AICTE grant, if any, will be met by the State Govt./or the college, and the purchase will not be delayed for want of funds.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: What Is The Full Name Of The "A2K+" Scheme?
answer: The Full Name of the "A2K+" Scheme is "Access to Knowledge for Technology Development and Dissemination" Scheme.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: What Is The Purpose Of This Scheme?
answer: This scheme is targeted towards developing mechanisms to disseminate science, technology and innovation-related information to industries, research and academic institutions, In-house R&D units of industry, Scientific & Industrial Research Organizations (SIROs), consultants, industry associations, techno-entrepreneurs, government departments and others.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: What Are The Names Of The Programmes Supported In This Scheme?
answer: The names of the programmes supported in this scheme are - | 1: Supporting industrial technology-related studies (A2K+ Studies) | 2: Supporting the organization of national and international conferences, exhibitions etc. (A2K+ Events) | 3: Support for Technology Development and Utilization Programme for Women | 4: Technology Development and Demonstration Programme (TDDP)

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: What Objective Does The A2K+ Studies Program Have?
answer: The objective of the A2K+ Studies program is to support emerging areas of technology aimed at providing useful information and knowledge base to industry, industry associations, academia, research institutions, consultants, entrepreneurs, research students, and policymakers for doing any further work in these areas; to study and analyze the developments in the emerging technology areas and document the findings, leanings, and outcomes for wider dissemination; and preparation of status reports on technologies from publicly funded institutions, that are ready for commercialization with a view to catalyzing the translation of research output from institutions to market.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: How Much Shall The Support For The Overhead Charges Be?
answer: The support for the Overhead Charges is fixed at 15%.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: For What Purposes Can The Travel Be In Order To Be Considered For Support?
answer: Travel for networking, survey, stakeholder meetings, experts, resource persons, etc.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: Is International Travel Permissible Under A Project?
answer: No, international travel is not permissible under any project.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: What Types Of Contingencies And Consumables Are Eligible For Support?
answer: Contingencies and consumables eligible for support are: research equipment essential for the study and approved by TAC.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: Will The DSIR Support Towards Manpower Expenses Vary With The Changes In Fellowship Rates?
answer: No, the DSIR support towards manpower expenses shall remain fixed respective of changes in fellowship rates if any.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: Can Support Be Granted For Setting Up General-Purpose Infrastructural Facilities?
answer: No support is granted for setting up general-purpose infrastructural facilities.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: Which Rule Of The GFR 2017 Should Be Considered For Establishing The Distinct Legal Entity Of An Institution?
answer: Rule 228 of GFR 2017 should be considered for establishing the distinct legal entity of an institution.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: Are UGC Approved Colleges Eligible?
answer: Yes, all Universities and Colleges listed on UGC/AICTE website ar eligible.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: To Whom Should The Application Be Addressed?
answer: The application should be addressed to - | Dr. Sujata Chaklanobis, Head (A2K+) | Department of Scientific & Industrial Research | Ministry of Science & Technology | Technology Bhawan, New Mehrauli Road | New Delhi-110 016 | Email: priya@nic.in

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: How Many Hard Copies Of The Proposal Are Required To Be Submitted?
answer: The Applicants should submit five hard copies of the proposal duly signed.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: How Many Soft Copies Of The Proposal Are Required To Be Submitted?
answer: The Applicants should submit one soft copy [MS Word file and not a PDF file] through e-mail and by enclosing a pen drive.

scheme_name: Access To Knowledge For Technology Development And Dissemination (A2K+) - Studies
question: What Should Be The Superscription On The Envelope / Document Holder?
answer: Superscribe "CONFIDENTIAL, A2K+ Studies" on the document holder.

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: Who can apply for the Advance Authorisation Scheme?
answer: Manufacturer exporters or merchant exporters tied to supporting manufacturers are eligible to apply under this scheme.

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: Can I apply for Advance Authorisation if I am a pharmaceutical exporter?
answer: Yes, but Advance Authorisation for pharmaceutical products made through Non-Infringing (NI) process is issued only to manufacturer exporters.

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: What benefits does this scheme offer for imported inputs?
answer: It allows duty-free import of inputs physically incorporated in the export product, including fuel, oil, and catalysts consumed during production.

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: Are there any exemptions from taxes and duties under this scheme?
answer: Yes, inputs are exempted from Basic Customs Duty, Additional Customs Duty, Education Cess, Anti-dumping Duty, Safeguard Duty, IGST, and Compensation Cess.

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: Is there any provision for importing spices under this scheme?
answer: Yes, duty-free import of spices under Chapter 9 is allowed only for crushing, grinding, sterilization, or oil/oleoresin manufacturing, not for cleaning or repacking.

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: What is the time limit to complete the export obligation?
answer: Please follow the given path: | The export obligation must be fulfilled within 18 months from the date of issue of the Authorisation or as notified by DGFT.

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: What are SION norms?
answer: SION (Standard Input Output Norms) are sector-wise norms notified by DGFT that define input-output ratios for specific export products.

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: Is Advance Authorisation applicable for SEZ or intermediate supplies?
answer: Yes, it can be issued for physical exports, including SEZ supplies, intermediate supplies, and other specified categories under FTP para 7.02.

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: How do I start the application process for Advance Authorisation?
answer: You must visit www.dgft.gov.in and apply under Services > Advance Authorisation / DFIA > Apply for Advance Authorisation (ANF 4A).

scheme_name: Advance Authorisation(AA)
question: What is RCMC and why is it necessary?
answer: Please follow the given path: | RCMC (Registration cum Membership Certificate) from the relevant Export Promotion Council is required to claim export benefits and apply for restricted licenses.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: What is the "Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY)"?
answer: The "Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (AABY)" is a social security scheme launched by the Government of India to provide life and disability insurance to members of identified occupational groups, rural landless households, and unorganized workers.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: Who implements the AABY scheme?
answer: The scheme is implemented by the Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) of India through nodal agencies such as state governments, central ministries, or other institutional arrangements.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: What is the age limit for beneficiaries under AABY?
answer: Beneficiaries must be between the ages of 18 and 59 years to be eligible for the scheme.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: Who is eligible to apply for AABY?
answer: The head or earning member of a family below the poverty line (BPL) or marginally above the poverty line (APL) in identified occupational groups or rural landless households is eligible to apply.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: What benefits does AABY provide in case of natural death?
answer: In case of natural death, AABY provides an insurance cover of ₹30,000/- to the nominee of the deceased.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: What benefits are provided under AABY for disability?
answer: The scheme offers ₹75,000/- for total permanent disability and ₹37,500/- for partial permanent disability due to an accident.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: What is the scholarship benefit under AABY?
answer: Two children of the insured, studying in grades 9 to 12, are eligible for a scholarship of ₹100 per month, payable half-yearly.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: How are claims processed under AABY?
answer: Claims are processed by LIC and are directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account via NEFT or other approved modes after verification by the nodal agency.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: What documents are required for accident claims?
answer: Accident claims require additional documents, including a copy of the FIR, Post Mortem Report, Police Inquest Report, and Police Final Report or Conclusion Report.

scheme_name: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
question: When are scholarships disbursed under AABY?
answer: Scholarships are disbursed twice a year, on 1st July and 1st January, directly to the bank accounts of eligible students through NEFT.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Will beneficiaries have to pay anything to get covered under this scheme?
answer: No. All eligible beneficiaries can avail free services for secondary and tertiary hospital care for identified packages under PM-JAY at public hospitals and empaneled private hospitals. Beneficiaries will have cashless and paperless access to health services under PM-JAY.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: What is the enrollment process? Is there any time period for enrollment?
answer: PM-JAY is an entitlement based mission. There is no enrollment process. Families who are identified by the government on the basis of deprivation and occupational criteria using the SECC database both in rural and urban areas are entitled for PM-JAY.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Will a card be given to the beneficiary?
answer: A dedicated PM-JAY family identification number will be allotted to eligible families. Additionally, an e-card will also be given to beneficiary at the time of hospitalization.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Are Already existing illnesses covered under this scheme?
answer: Yes. All existing medical conditions / Illnesses are covered under this scheme.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Are Benefits available for New born child under this scheme?
answer: Yes. New born child can be provided treatment under this scheme. They can also be added into beneficiary family after providing necessary documents.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Are RSBY cardholders covered under the scheme?
answer: Any family that has an active RSBY card as of 28 February 2018 is covered under the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan mantra Jan Arogya Yojana.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Can benefits under this scheme be available without Aadhar Card?
answer: Yes. Aadhar card is not mandatory for availing services under this scheme.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: What Who Is Aarogya Mitra?
answer: An Ayushman Mitra (AM) is a certified frontline health service professional who is present at each of the EHCP and serves as a first contact point for beneficiaries. They will help in processing documents for Beneficiary identification as well as complete claim process along with Medical Coordinator. They are available at Ayushman Bharat Kiosk in every EHCP to assist patients.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: How does Claim Submission process work?
answer: Once patient is discharged from the EHCP, the claim submission process is initiated by raising request on online portal with patient's discharge summary along with other necessary clinical notes and investigation reports. EHCP is required to submit claims within 24 hours of discharge of patient.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: What Is Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana(PM-JAY)?
answer: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana(PM-JAY) is a pioneering initiative of Prime Minister Modi to ensure that the poor and vulnerable population is provided health coverage. This initiative is part of the Government's vision to ensure that its citizens - especially the poor and vulnerable groups have universal access to good quality hospital services without anyone having to face financial hardship as a consequence of using health services.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: What Health Services Are Available Under PM-JAY?
answer: The health services covered under the program include hospitalization expenses, daycare surgeries, follow-up care, pre and post-hospitalization expense benefits, and newborn child/children services. The comprehensive list of services is available on the website.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Where Can Beneficiaries Avail Of Services Under PM-JAY?
answer: Services under the scheme can be availed at all public hospitals and empaneled private healthcare facilities. Empanelment of the hospitals under PM-JAY will be conducted through an online portal by the state government. Information about empaneled hospitals will be made available at through different means such as government website, mobile app. Beneficiaries can also call the helpline number at 14555. Regular updates will also be provided through ASHAs, ANM and other specific touch points This information will be activated shortly.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Will Beneficiaries Have To Pay Anything To Get Covered Under This Scheme?
answer: No. All eligible beneficiaries can avail free services for secondary and tertiary hospital care for identified packages under PM-JAY at public hospitals and empaneled private hospitals. Beneficiaries will have cashless and paperless access to health services under PM-JAY.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: How Are The Beneficiaries Identified?
answer: The beneficiaries are identified based on the deprivation categories (D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, and D7) identified under the SECC (Socio-Economic Caste Census) database for rural areas and 11 occupational criteria for urban areas. In addition, RSBY beneficiaries in states where RSBY is active are also included.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Can Those Families Whose Names Are Not On The List Avail The Benefits Under PM-JAY?
answer: In this phase, no additional new families can be added under PM-JAY. However, the names of additional family members can be added for those families whose names are already on the SECC list.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: What Is The Maximum Time Required For Approval Of Claim Submission Requests?
answer: Once all claims documents are submitted, the claim must be approved within 15 days to SHA for final approval and payment processing. SHA will make payment of claims within 15 days after being authenticated by their internal team.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
question: Who Are The Members Of Various Grievance Committees?
answer: AB PMJAY has a three-tier grievance redressal structure to ensure the timely redressal of grievances. This section of the guidelines lays down these structures, their constitution, and their functions. District Grievance Redressal Committee (DGRC) - will be constituted by the SHA in each district and this is chaired by Head of the District or District Magistrate or District Collector or Deputy Commissioner. The State Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC) is chaired by CEO of SHA / State Nodal Agency (SNA). The SGRC shall perform all functions related to handling and resolution of all grievances received either directly or escalated through the DGRC. The National Grievance Redressal Committee (NGRC) will be chaired by Deputy CEO of National Health Agency (NHA). The NGRC shall act as the final Appellate Authority at the national level. The NGRC shall only accept appeals and petitions against the orders of the SGRC of a State. The decision of NGRC will be final.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: What is the "ABVKY" Scheme?
answer: The scheme "Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana (ABVKY)" was introduced by the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) on a pilot basis for a period of 2 years w.e.f. 01.07.2018 for providing relief to the Insured Persons (IPs) who have become unemployed. Under this scheme relief in the form of cash compensation to the extent of 50% of the average per day earnings was paid up to a maximum of 90 days of unemployment subject to conditions that the employee should have completed two years of Insurable employment and has contributed not less than Seventy-Eight (78) days in each of the three consecutive contribution periods immediately preceding to the claim of the relief.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: Which is the implementing agency of this scheme?
answer: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: What are the eligibility criteria to apply under the scheme?
answer: The Insured Person (IP) should have been rendered unemployed during the period the relief is claimed. | The Insured Person should have been in insurable employment for a minimum period of two years. | The Insured Person should have contributed not less than 78 days during each of the preceding four contribution periods. | The contribution in respect of him/her should have been paid or payable by the employer. | The unemployment contingency should not have resulted from any punishment for misconduct, superannuation, or voluntary retirement. | The Aadhaar and Bank Account of the Insured Person should be linked with the insured person database.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: What are the conditions for the Disqualification/Termination of relief under ABVKY?
answer: - During lockout | - Strike resorted to by the employees declared illegal by the competent authority | - Voluntary abandonment of employment/ voluntary retirement/ premature retirement | - Less than two years of contributory service | - On attaining the age of superannuation | - Convicted (i.e. punished for false statement) under the provisions of Section 84 of the ESI Act read with Rule 62 of the ESI (Central) Rule | - On being re-employed elsewhere during the period he/she is in receipt of Relief under ABVKY | - Dismissal/termination under disciplinary action | - On the death of IP

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: What are the benefits of this scheme?
answer: The scheme provides relief to the extent of 50% of the average per day earnings of employees during their last employment. | The relief amount to be paid up to a maximum of 90 days of unemployment subject to conditions that the employee should have completed two years of Insurable employment and has contributed not less than Seventy-Eight (78) days in each of the three consecutive contribution periods.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: What is the minimum employment period required to be eligible for Unemployment Insurance?
answer: The insured person should have been in insurable employment for a minimum period of two years immediately before their unemployment.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: How many days of contribution are required in the contribution period preceding unemployment?
answer: The insured person should have contributed for not less than 78 days in the contribution period immediately preceding the unemployment.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: Are there any additional contribution requirements in the two years prior to unemployment?
answer: Yes, in addition to the 78 days in the immediate preceding contribution period, the insured person must also have a minimum of 78 days of contribution in one of the remaining three contribution periods within the two years prior to unemployment.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: When does an Unemployment Insurance claim become due?
answer: An Unemployment Insurance claim becomes due 30 days after the date of unemployment.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: Can an individual covered under the ESI scheme be considered unemployed if working for more than one employer?
answer: No, under the ESI scheme, an individual working for multiple employers will be considered unemployed only if they are rendered unemployed with all employers simultaneously.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: What happens if an individual covered under the ESI scheme is unemployed with only one of the multiple employers?
answer: If an individual covered under the ESI scheme is unemployed with only one of the multiple employers, they will not be considered unemployed for the purposes of ESI benefits. Unemployment status is determined when an individual is unemployed with all employers simultaneously under the scheme.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: Do all Insured Persons covered under the ESI Act need to register separately to avail themselves of the scheme benefits?
answer: No, all Insured Persons covered under the ESI Act are automatically entitled to the scheme benefits, and no separate registration is required. The entitlement is based on the coverage under the ESI Act, and eligible individuals are granted access to the benefits without the need for additional registration.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: Does the scheme cover the IPs who was unemployed during the lockdown but are now working?
answer: Such employees, if fulfil the required eligibility conditions are eligible for relief under the scheme. But the claimant must have been unemployed during the period of claim.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: What is the age of superannuation?
answer: The age of superannuation of any insured person is company specific as per company's policy in accordance with law. As per the explanation under Section 56 of the ESI Act the age of superannuation can be taken as age of sixty years.

scheme_name: Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana
question: How to apply under the scheme?
answer: The application for the claims benefits can be made online at website www.esic.in along with submission of the physical claim with an affidavit, photocopy of Aadhaar Card and Bank Account details to the designated ESIC Branch Office by post or in person.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
question: How much is a crop loan per acre?
answer: DBT will be given at the rate of Rs 4,000 per acre per season for cropping while zero-interest loan will be at the rate of Rs 50,000 per hectare to be capped at Rs 1 lakh per farmer, sources told BusinessToday.In. The crop loan is already offered to farmers at a subsidized rate of 4 percent only.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
question: What is the lock in period for bank loans?
answer: A beneficiary cannot close the bank loans within three years from the date of availing loans.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
question: What is the subsidy pattern?
answer: The subsidy is 36% of the Total Financial Outlay (TFO) for General Category candidates and 44% for Women, SC/ST/NE and Hilly State Candidates.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
question: Is there any other condition for eligibility?
answer: Yes, retired employees getting pensionary benefits are not eligible for subsidy. However, they can undergo training and establish self financed projects.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
question: Is there any upper ceiling for the project cost?
answer: Yes, the upper ceiling for the project cost eligible for subsidy is Rs. 20 Lakhs for individual projects and Rs. 100 Lakh for group projects. For extremely successful individual projects the ceiling is Rs. 25 Lakh.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
question: Can the candidates undertake group projects?
answer: Yes, the candidates are allowed to undertake group projects, if the group consists of a total of five or more persons trained under the scheme.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
question: What will happen if the project is not completed?
answer: If the project is not completed within the stipulated period, benefit of subsidy shall not be available and advance subsidy placed with the participating bank, if any, will have to be refunded forthwith to NABARD.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
question: What is the duration of the training?
answer: 45 days of residential training for the students who are desirous of setting up agri-clinics and agri-business centers.

scheme_name: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
question: What is the objective of the AICTE-Distinguished Professionals Scheme (DPS)?
answer: The objective of the AICTE-Distinguished Professionals Scheme (DPS) is to utilize the expertise of highly qualified professionals to motivate and inspire students and faculty members of AICTE-approved institutes.

scheme_name: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
question: Who is eligible to apply for the DPS?
answer: Eligible applicants must have made unparalleled, exceptional technical/professional contributions to society in their respective fields/disciplines and be acknowledged leaders in their specializations.

scheme_name: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
question: What is the tenure for professionals selected under the DPS?
answer: Professionals selected under the DPS have a tenure of three years or until they reach the age of 75, whichever comes earlier, with the possibility of extension subject to fitness.

scheme_name: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
question: How much honorarium is provided to the professionals per day of interaction?
answer: AICTE provides an honorarium of ₹15,000 per day for full-day interactions with faculty members/students of the host institute and nearby institutions.

scheme_name: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
question: How does AICTE create a pool of experts for the DPS?
answer: AICTE creates a pool of experts from industry, institutes, research labs, and senior civil service officers through advertisement, nomination, or self-nomination.

scheme_name: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
question: How can individuals apply for the DPS?
answer: Individuals can apply for the DPS by submitting nominations/applications with all necessary details through a Google form.

scheme_name: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
question: How are the nominations/selections of professionals communicated?
answer: Nominations/selections of professionals are communicated immediately after approval by the competent authority of the Council on a monthly basis.

scheme_name: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
question: What is the duration of the offer for the AICTE-Distinguished Professional Scheme?
answer: The offer for the AICTE-Distinguished Professional Scheme is valid for the period mentioned in the request/invitation letter, and professionals are requested to concur.

scheme_name: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
question: Where can interested experts find the application link for the scheme?

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
question: What is the process for reapplying for new mobility equipment after the initial 10-year period?
answer: After the expiration of the 10-year lifespan of the mobility equipment, beneficiaries are eligible to reapply for new equipment. They would need to follow the same application process and provide updated documentation, including a new financial estimate for the equipment. The application is then reviewed and processed as before.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
question: Are there any restrictions on the type of mobility equipment that can be procured with the financial assistance provided by the scheme?
answer: The financial assistance can be used for any mobility equipment that aids the Ex-Serviceman's mobility needs. This can include wheelchairs, crutches, or other devices deemed necessary.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
question: How can applicants track the status of their applications?
answer: Applicants can check the status of their applications by visiting the official website of the Kendriya Sainik Board and clicking on the "Status of Application" link. They need to enter their DAK ID and verification code to check the status.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
question: How does the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB) process the applications after receiving them?
answer: The KSB Secretariat assigns applications to clerks for data entry and verification. The Section-in-Charge and JD(Welfare) verify and process the applications, and upon approval, they are processed for payment.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
question: What role does the Zila Sainik Welfare Office (ZSWO) play in the application process?
answer: The ZSWO plays a crucial role in scrutinizing the application. If the application is found correct in all respects, it is forwarded to the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB) Secretariat for further processing.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
question: What documents are required for the application?
answer: Applicants need to submit several documents, including their complete Discharge Book/Document/Certificate, ESM Identity Card, Disability Certificate issued by Armed Forces Medical Authority, and financial estimates for the modified scooter, among others.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
question: How much financial assistance is provided under this scheme?
answer: The scheme provides a maximum financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 to eligible disabled Ex-Servicemen.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
question: What is the aim of the "Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen" scheme?
answer: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to disabled Ex-Servicemen who have a disability of 50% or more after their retirement from service. This assistance is for the procurement of modified scooters and other mobility equipment to help them lead independent lives.

scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Procuring Mobility Equipment To Disabled Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)
question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
answer: To be eligible, applicants must be Ex-Servicemen who have become disabled after their retirement from service, with a disability percentage of 50% or more. They should not be covered under a similar scheme by the Army, Navy, or Air Force.

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: What is the "ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship" scheme?
answer: The scheme is launched as an initiative under the ASEAN-India Science & Technology Development Fund (AISTDF) to support young talented researchers/scientists of ASEAN member countries (namely Brunei Darussalam, Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam) to carry out research at any of the Indian research/academic Institution.

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: What is the objective of scheme?
answer: The AI-RTF scheme is a fellowship scheme with the following objectives: | To promote the mobility of scientists and researchers from the ASEAN-Member Countries to India and provide them the opportunity to work at Indian R&D/ academic institutions to upgrade their research skills and expertise. | To facilitate the exchange of information and contacts between the scientists and researchers of India and ASEAN Countries and create a network for building research collaborations.

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: Which is the implementing agency of this scheme?
answer: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI), New Delhi

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: What are the eligibility criteria for applying/availing the Fellowship?
answer: Applicant must be holding the nationality of any of the ASEAN Member Countries. | Applicant should possess at least a Master's Degree in any Natural Sciences or an equivalent degree in Technology/Engineering/Medicine / allied disciplines. | Applicant should be working/studying and/or affiliated with any national R&D or academic institution in his/her home ASEAN Member Country. | The upper age limit for the applicant is 45 years as of the date of submission of the application.

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: Are Indian nationals eligible for the Fellowship?
answer: No, Indian nationals are not eligible for the Fellowship.

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: What are the areas covered under this Fellowship?
answer: The fellowship is available in all fields of natural & engineering sciences, including mathematics & statistics, except humanities and behavioral sciences- | Agricultural Sciences | Biological and Medical Sciences | Chemical Sciences & Engineering | Computer Science & Engineering | Physical Sciences and Mathematics | Ocean, Earth & Atmospheric Sciences | Engineering Sciences | Materials, Minerals and Metallurgy | Science Policy/IPR Management/Technology Transfer & Commercialization | - Other multi-disciplinary areas of Science, Technology and Innovation in alignment with APASTI

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: What is the nature of support for the Fellow?
answer: Full financial assistance will be provided to the selected Fellows which includes the following:- | - Round trip international airfare by lowest economy class and by the shortest route from the international airport in the home country of the applicant to the international airport nearest to the host institution in India; visa fees, overseas medical insurance, etc. | - A consolidated Fellowship amount of Indian Rupees (INR) 60,000/- per month. | - One-time grant of INR 40,000/- as research contingency expenses, airport transfers, domestic travel for attending scientific /events, and field trips within India. | - Institutional overhead charges @ INR 2,500/- per month.

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: How many fellowships are awarded per year under the scheme?
answer: Fifty (50) fellowships per year shall be awarded to young scientists and researchers from ASEAN-Member States to get affiliated with Indian academic and R&D institutions.

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: What is the duration of fellowship?
answer: The duration of the Fellowship will be for a period of two to six months. No request for extension \ reduction in the duration period shall be entertained after the award of the fellowship.

scheme_name: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship
question: How to apply for the fellowship?
answer: The applications are to be submitted only ONLINE at (https://aistic.gov.in/ASEAN/aistdfFellowship). The hard copies of the application are not required. The applications submitted through any other form or channel shall not be considered.

scheme_name: AICTE-INAE Travel Grant Scheme For Engineering Students From AICTE Approved Engineering College/Institution

scheme_name: AICTE-INAE Travel Grant Scheme For Engineering Students From AICTE Approved Engineering College/Institution
question: Is there any age criteria to apply tot this scheme?

scheme_name: AICTE-INAE Travel Grant Scheme For Engineering Students From AICTE Approved Engineering College/Institution

Tech, OR Students pursuing MS Research, M.Sc. in Engineering, dual degree B.Tech and M.Tech or any degree with a minimum of 4 years of engineering studies.

scheme_name: AICTE-INAE Travel Grant Scheme For Engineering Students From AICTE Approved Engineering College/Institution
question: What is the full form of INAE?
answer: INAE stands for "Indian National Academy of Engineering".

scheme_name: AICTE-INAE Travel Grant Scheme For Engineering Students From AICTE Approved Engineering College/Institution
question: Do I need to have a Letter Of Acceptance to apply?
answer: Yes, The student should have a letter of acceptance for presenting a research paper which has been accepted in a conference/serninar/symposiurn/workshop/exhibition abroad.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.1 What Is AICTE Expecting From The Institution?
answer: A. AICTE expects institutions to fund its other clubs in a similar fashion and intensify their activities. Vibrant clubs will attract the attention of other institutions and inspire the latter to emulate. Thus there will be an intensification of club activities across the country.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.2 What Are The Strong Points Which Enhance The Possibility Of Support From AICTE?
answer: A. Past achievements of the club, its interface with industry/professional body, achievements of the Faculty Coordinator, and Credentials of the institute.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.3 Are Student Chapters/Societies Also Eligible To Apply?
answer: A. Yes.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.4 How Many Proposals Can Be Submitted By The Institute?
answer: A. Institute can seek support for one club only, for which it must be willing to support financially also.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.5 Will My Institute Be Eligible To Apply Again If The Project Is Granted Once?
answer: A. No. Institute will be eligible to receive the grant under the SPICES scheme only once. AICTE expects the institute to support other clubs in a similar fashion.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.6 Can Non-Technical/ Non-Engineering Clubs Apply Under This Scheme?
answer: A. Yes, the club from any discipline/ theme/ stream in an AICTE-approved institution can be proposed under this Scheme, provided it fulfills other eligibility conditions.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.7 What Is The Total Duration To Complete The SPICES Project?
answer: A. It's a one-year project which starts from the date of the Offer Letter/Sanction Letter.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.8 When Does The One-Year Project Duration Start?
answer: A. For the 2020-2021 batch, the date of receipt of funds is reckoned as the date of start of the project which must be intimated to AICTE. However, for those sanctioned in 2021- 2022, the date of the Offer Letter is the date of the start of the project.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.9 If Both Coordinator & Co-Coordinator Are Transferred/ Changed, Then How To Update The Details Of Another Coordinator?
answer: A. The institute must appoint another faculty as a coordinator whose qualifications and experience must be matching with the previous one and take approval from AICTE. One needs to go to "Request for Change of Coordinator/Co-coordinator" on the SPICES Review Portal, attach the requisite documents on the SPICES review portal, duly signed by the Head of Institution, and Coordinator, and submit.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.10 Do We Need To Submit Any Report To AICTE After The Completion Of The Project?
answer: A. Yes, at the end of the project duration, the institute must submit a soft copy and hard copy of the project report and original bills for the closure of the project.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.11 Is There Any Requirement On The Minimum Number Of Activities To Be Conducted Under This Scheme? Can We Conduct One Single Event/Activity?
answer: A. Club must conduct as many activities as possible, spread throughout the year. Club members may be encouraged to raise funds from other sponsors.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.12 Can We Conduct The Event/Activities In The Club Online Mode Or Hybrid Mode?
answer: A. AICTE recommends club activities to be held offline to enhance student interaction between peers and experts invited.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.13 Can We Collaborate With Other Councils/Clubs In Our College To Conduct An Activity?
answer: A. We encourage collaborative activities with not just clubs in your institutions but also with those focussed in your area, in nearby institutions (for example if your club is on Robotics, try collaborating with the Robotics club in a nearby institution). We expect these clubs with whom you shake hands also to reciprocate your gesture. This is equally important. By supporting and focussing on one club under the Scheme, our larger intention is to see other clubs also get energized, that's why your club has been selected to be transformed as a model club. Please document and share the success stories emerging out of such collaborations, with all the beneficiaries under SPICES.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.14 Can We Upload The Details Of The Events/Activity Which Were Conducted Before Receiving The Offer Letter From The Institute?
answer: A. Any activity which was conducted before receiving the Offer Letter will not be acceptable.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.15 Can We Consider Taking Our Students For A One-Day Outdoor Experiential Learning Activity
answer: A. Yes, but the expenditures on account of travel cannot exceed 40%. Additional expenditures, (if any) should be borne by the institute.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.16 We Have Been Sanctioned Project In 2021-2022. When Will The Fund Of Rs. 1 Lakh Will Be Released?
answer: A. Your institute will be reimbursed Rs. 1 lakh once the project is completed, but not before one year. Subject to all other conditions being fulfilled.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.17 What Is The Proportion Of Contribution From The Institute And Support From AICTE Over 100% Of Expenses Incurred On The Student's Club Activities?
answer: A. The total project cost is a minimum of Rs. 2 Lakh with Rs. 1 Lakh from AICTE and the rest coming from the institute (minimum Rs. 1 Lakh). If the expenditure within the project duration is less than Rs. 2 Lakh then a grant from AICTE will be reduced to 50% of actual expenses accrued for the club activities.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.18 Can I Get The Payment In Favor Of The Coordinator's Account Name?
answer: A. No. The grant can only be released in favor of the Director/ Principal/ Registrar of the institution. Applicant must provide duly-filled mandate form having the seal and signature of the bank authority.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.19 Can The Grant Be Utilized By The Institute On The Expenditures Pertaining To The Faculty Coordinator/ Co-Coordinator Or Any Other Faculty Member?
answer: A. No. The grant can be utilized only for expenditures pertaining to student members of the club.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.20 Can We Buy Hardware/Software From AICTE's Contribution To The Club's Activities
answer: A. No. The funds cannot be used for Hardware/Software. If required, the same must be bought from institute funds.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.21 Can We Allow Registration Fees To Be Collected From Students For The Event(S)/ Activities?
answer: A. It is up to the institute to decide whether to collect the registration fee or not.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.22 Can We Use The Grant For Publishing Books?
answer: A. The grant can be utilized for the publication/printing of promotional material for events/activities organized by the club.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.23 Visiting Industrial/Technical Hubs Can Be Taken As An Event And Submit The Bills For Consideration.
answer: A. No. The industrial/technical hubs visit is part of academic/departmental activities, and the grant cannot be utilized for this purpose.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.24 Are We Allowed To Spend Institute-Committed Funds On Hospitality To Experts, And Participants From Outside Apart From Expenses On Remuneration To Experts, And Prizes To Participants?
answer: A. The funds pooled (AICTE and college) can be used for events and activities organized by the student club to which the project is offered but not for any other club. Not more than 40% of the pooled amount can be used on travel. It can be used to meet the expenses related to experts/ resource persons invited to the events organized by the club.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.25 Our Club Is Selected For The Grant Of Rs. 1 Lakh, And In The Letter, It Is Mentioned That We Can Utilize Its 40% For The Event Registration And Organizing Event, How We Can Utilize 60% Part Of The Grant?
answer: A. Club can utilize 60% amount in event organization expenses viz. publicity, prize money, club merchandise (such as T-Shirts, Cups, etc.)

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.26 Can The Institute Use The Fund Amount For Two More Clubs?
answer: A. Funds under the project granted to your institute (contributed by your institute and AICTE) have to be spent on the Club mentioned in the Offer Letter; and NOT on the other clubs. The funded club will serve as a model to other clubs in the institute, the experience gained and good practices of which can be applied to at least two more student clubs that are to be proposed to us.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.27 What Is The Process Of Refunding The Unspent AICTE Grant? (Valid For 2020-2021 Project Batch)
answer: A. Any unspent amount with the institute must be immediately returned through NEFT/ crossed Demand Draft drawn in favor of "Member Secretary, AICTE" payable at New Delhi, within 30 days of approved project completion date.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.28 If We Purchased Some Products Related To The Events Activity Online, Will Online Bills Be Acceptable?
answer: A. Yes, but the product should not be Hardware/Software & bills should bear a GST number.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.29 Is There Any Format Given For Bills Of The Events Conducted, For Uploading On The SPICES Review Portal?
answer: A. No format is prescribed. Institute needs to upload the bills as received.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.30 Is It Mandatory To Submit The GST Bills?
answer: A. Yes, it is mandatory to submit bills with GST numbers.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.31 Can We Promote Activities/Events Being Conducted Under The Club On Social Media?
answer: A. Yes, we recommended promoting activities/events being conducted under the funded club on social media using the #aictespices and #aicte.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.32 Can We Use The AICTE Logo?
answer: A. All publicity materials/ advertisements/ brochures/ invitation cards/ any other collaterals/ event backdrop etc. related to the event(s), must carry the AICTE logo and the name SPICES. Likewise, the venue/the stage backdrop/ podium must prominently display the AICTE logo and the name SPICES.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.33 Is It Mandatory To Upload The Acceptance Letter (Available On The SPICES Review Portal) Within 7 Days And Also Need To Send A Hard Copy Of The Acceptance Letter To The AICTE?
answer: A. Yes, you need to upload the Acceptance Letter on the SPICES review portal within 7 days after releasing the Offer Letter to your Institute and also need to send a hard copy of the same.

scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
question: Q.34 Do We Need To Click On The Review Submit Button Every Time After Uploading The Single Event Detail On The SPICES Review Portal?
answer: A. No. You do not need to click on the Review Submit button every time after uploading the single event detail on the SPICES Review portal because once you click on the button, you will not be able to upload anything on your SPICES Review portal. You need to click on that button once you complete your SPICES project.

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
question: What shall be the maximum duration of the scholarship?
answer: Maximum of 4 years duration for first year admitted Degree students and maximum of 3 years for Diploma Students. However, if a student is currently studying in the 2nd /3rd/4th year at degree level the duration of the scholarship will be reduced to 3/2/1 year respectively. Similarly, for students currently studying in the 2nd /3rd year at diploma level the duration of the scholarship will be reduced to 2/1 year respectively.

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
question: I Am Degree/Diploma Student And Recipient Of One Of The Merit Scholarships Of Centre / State Government. Am I Eligible To Apply For SWANATH Scholarship?
answer: NO. Students who are already in receipt of any of the scholarships (Central Govt. / State Govt. / AICTE Sponsored), are not eligible to apply for SWANATH Scholarships.

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
question: I Am First Year B.E Student Along With Beneficiary Of PMSSS Scheme Studying In One Of The Leading Engineering College Having Eligibility For SWANATH Scholarship. Am I Eligible To Apply For SWANATH Scholarship?
answer: NO. You are not eligible, since you are already in receipt of one of the Scholarships of Government of India.

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
question: What Are The Reasons Of Rejection Of Category Certificate?
answer: Followings may be the reasons | Category certificate is not issued by Distt. Magistrate / Deputy Commissioner / SDM / Tehsildar. | Category certificate is not issued in the name of applicant. | Irrelevant document attached in place of category certificate. | Copy of category certificate is blurred. | - Wrong category certificate uploaded i.e. student mentioned in application that he belongs to SC but | category certificate submitted of OBC.

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
question: What Are The Reasons Of Rejection Of Annual Family Income Certificate?
answer: Followings may be the reasons | Annual family income certificate of current year is not submitted. | Annual family income certificate is not in the name of applicant or any his/her family member. | Submitted Annual family income certificate issued by other than competent authority (Tehshildar, | Magistrate, Revenue officer/Block Development officer etc.). | Annual family income certificate submitted without signature/stamp of the competent authority.

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
question: Is There Any E-Mail (Or) Helpline No. For SWANATH Scholarship Queries?
answer: YES. You can avail helpline services on consultant2stdc@aicte-india.org & 011-29581118 for any queries.

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
question: Whom To Contact In Case Of Any Difficulties In Accessing The Portal For Submitting Online Application?
answer: You can avail Helpdesk Service on helpdesk@nsp.gov.in for any queries.

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
question: Is AADHAAR Card A Mandatory Document For SWANATH Scholarship?
answer: Ans: Yes. Aadhaar card and Aadhaar seeded bank account in the name of candidate is mandatory for submitting online application under SWANATH scheme.

scheme_name: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
question: What Is The Mode Of Disbursement Of Scholarship?
answer: Scholarship will be disbursed only through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in the bank account of the student by AICTE. Student must have General Saving Account in his / her name (FRILL/Minor/Joint account will not beaccepted).

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: What is IDEA Lab scheme?
answer: The purpose of IDEA Lab is to provide all facilities under one roof, for conversion of an idea into a prototype. With these facilities in the campus, more students and faculty will be encouraged to take up creative work and in the process, get training on creative thinking, problem solving, collaboration etc.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: For whom the IDEA Lab is meant?
answer: IDEA Lab is meant for students and faculty of the college/ educational campus/University.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: Which institutions are eligible for applying for AICTE IDEA Lab?
answer: Institutions (including part of educational campuses or universities) more than 10 years old are eligible for applying and must have at least one course accredited by the NBA.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: What type of civil infrastructure is required for an IDEA Lab?
answer: Ideally, a built up area of 5000 sq. ft. is required. But the institution must agree to provide a minimum built-up and furnished space of 2000 sq. ft. for the laboratory and an additional 1000 sq. ft. to facilitate activities under IDEA Lab. The installation of equipment has to be done taking into account all safety and environmental concerns.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: What hardware constitutes an IDEA Lab?
answer: In order to support do-it-yourself activities and facilitate translation of ideas into prototypes, each IDEA Lab must be equipped with tools, components and consumables. Equipment and consumables have been identified (in Annexure ) and tools (in Annexure I1) which need to be there for a fully functional IDEA Lab as a complete unit.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: Can the institute contribute in raising IDEA Lab through existing equipment?
answer: The institution can shift permanently equipment/ tools they may be having with them to the IDEA Lab. However, they will not be included in the budget but reflected in the inventory.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: Can more than one institution join?
answer: The utilization of facilities for the purpose they are given, to the maximum extent, | is of paramount concern for AICTE. Towards this, institutions can come together under a lead institution which is eligible to apply. The Lab has to be in the premises of the lead institution which will be responsible for executing the project and ensuring that participating institutions and industries are not a liability on IDEA Lab/ Institution.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: Can the entire non-AICTE funding be from the institution?
answer: Yes, the contribution can be from college but this is an excellent opportunity to reach out to industry inviting them for a national initiative. With gates opened for industry, the revenue generation and hence, prospects for sustenance of Lab enhance significantly. This is besides the live problems/ challenges they can offer to the colleges and technical experts as well.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: Who operates and manages IDEA Lab?
answer: The Head of Institute will be the ex-officio Chief Mentor (CM) of the AICTE IDEA Lab, responsible for overall implementation of the project.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: How are Student Ambassadors to be selected?
answer: Students from the 3rd/ 4th year of UG or any year of PG course who show keen interest in the activities and regularly participate in them, can be nominated. Institute can frame its own set of rules for this. Upto 3 Ambassadors can be there at a time and should be rotated, maintaining gender equity.

scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
question: How can other faculty make use of the facilities?
answer: IDEA Labis as much to be used by faculty, as students, including for their research work. They can work on their ideas independently or by involving students. They can create internship projects or practical work which require significant use of IDEA Lab and also facilities in their own departments. scheme_name: AICTE-Margdarshan scheme

scheme_name: AICTE-Margdarshan scheme

scheme_name: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana

scheme_name: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana

scheme_name: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana

scheme_name: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta Evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana

scheme_name: Atal Pension Yojana

scheme_name: Atal Pension Yojana

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: What is the maximum amount of financial assistance a company owned by a Scheduled Caste entrepreneur can receive as capital, and over what specific duration?

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: Is it a necessary criterion that the innovative idea must be focused on the socio-economic development of society and specifically identified within an incubator?
answer: Yes, applicants must possess innovative ideas focusing on the socio-economic development of the society. These ideas must be identified in the Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) operating in either the public or private sector.

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: If my current business is structured as a Proprietary Firm, Partnership Firm, or a Limited Liability Partnership, can I still receive assistance from the fund?
answer: Proprietary Firms, Partnership Firms, One Person Company (OPC), or Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) must convert themselves into a Private Limited or Public Limited company before receiving assistance under the fund.

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: Can an applicant receive support if their start-up has been nominated and financially backed by a corporation using its Corporate Social Responsibility funds?
answer: Yes, start-ups nominated and supported by corporates through Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funds are explicitly eligible for assistance under the mission.

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: What specific category of youth or individual must the applicant belong to in order to be eligible for support under this mission?
answer: The applicant must be a youth belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Caste Divyang category to be eligible for support under the Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM).

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: Are individuals belonging to Scheduled Tribes (ST), Other Backward Castes (OBC), or the General category allowed to benefit from the funding provided under this initiative?
answer: No, only Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs and youth are eligible for financial assistance under this fund, according to the guidelines.

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: What specific types of projects are covered under this initiative, and are there any negative sectors that are specifically excluded from receiving investment?
answer: Innovations in the Manufacturing and Service sector are eligible for funding. However, the fund cannot invest in negative sectors as defined by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines.

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: Does eligibility extend to youth identified by Technology Parks, Industrial Parks, or Science and Technology Parks of India promoted by the Department of Science & Technology?
answer: Yes, youth identified by the Technology / Industrial Parks or Science and Technology Parks of India (STPI) being promoted by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), or other non-DST incubation centers supported by the Government of India, are eligible.

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: What is the total length of time, or tenure, for which the financial assistance provided under this mission remains active or sanctioned?
answer: The total tenure for the financial assistance provided under the Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM) is 10 years. This period begins starting from the date of the first disbursement of funds.

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)
question: What minimum percentage of the total shareholding of the company must be retained by the Scheduled Caste entrepreneur to maintain eligibility for assistance?
answer: The Scheduled Caste entrepreneur must hold at least 51% of the total shareholding of the company, along with management control. This minimum shareholding must be maintained until the assistance under the mission is no longer present in the company.

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)

scheme_name: Ambedkar Social Innovation and Incubation Mission (ASIIM)

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH and Public Health

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH and Public Health

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH and Public Health

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH and Public Health

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH and Public Health

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH for Sports Medicine

scheme_name: Ayurswasthya Yojana: Up-gradation of Facilities to Centre of Excellence (CoE)

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: What is the Amended Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme (ATUFS)?
answer: ATUFS is a credit-linked Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) scheme launched by the Ministry of Textiles to encourage investment, employment generation, quality improvement, and export promotion in the textile and garment industry.

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: Who is eligible to apply for the ATUFS scheme?
answer: Eligible entities include: | - Handloom sector | - Silk sector | - Jute sector | - Technical textiles | - Garment/made-up manufacturing | - Units involved in processing fibre, fabric, garments, or yarn | - Weaving preparatory and knitting units | Note: Only individual entities, not individual units, are eligible.

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: What is the subsidy rate under the ATUFS scheme?
answer: The Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) is available at: | - 10% (up to ₹20 crore) for weaving using new shuttle-less looms, silk, handloom, jute, etc.- 15% (up to ₹30 crore) for technical textiles and garments- 10% (up to ₹20 crore) for composite units where tech textiles/garments are 50% of the cost

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: What are the key objectives of ATUFS?
answer: - Promote exports and employment, especially for women- Encourage technical textiles- Upgrade loom technologies to improve quality/productivity- Reduce import dependency by enhancing domestic textile quality

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: Is ATUFS applicable to machinery purchase?
answer: Yes, the scheme is linked to capital investment, particularly the installation of new machinery in textile manufacturing, processing, and garmenting units.

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: What is the process to apply under the ATUFS scheme?
answer: - Install the eligible machinery | - Apply online via the iTUFS portal- Application is verified by stakeholders | - UID is generated- Track progress and receive updates via SMS/email- Post-approval, funds are released by the Ministry

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: Is there any fee or document required for applying?
answer: No documents are required at the initial application stage. However, machinery installation and inspection by stakeholders are mandatory for fund release.

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: What kind of textile projects are supported under ATUFS?
answer: The scheme supports projects related to: | - Weaving and knitting | - Technical textile production | - Fibre, fabric, and garment processing | - Apparel and made-up manufacturing | - Loom modernization in silk, handloom, and jute sectors

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: Can I apply for the scheme before installing machinery?
answer: No. The application process can be initiated only after machinery installation, as it requires joint inspection by stakeholders before approval.

scheme_name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
question: How can I track my ATUFS application status?
answer: Once submitted, a Unique Identification Number (UID) is generated. This UID can be used to track your application online and opt for SMS/e-mail alerts about its progress.
