scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: How to find out host industry / industrial research organization in Germany?
answer: Applicants need to find out the German host industry / industrial research organization by their own. Selection and receiving endorsement from the industry/industrial research organization is the responsibility of the applicant. Although the applicant can also visit ongoing and completed 2+2 project pages to get an idea about the industries associated with IGSTC on similar research interest.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: What do you mean by parent organisation and mentor at parent organisation?
answer: The parent organisation is the one where the applicant is pursuing PhD degree. Mentor would be the PhD supervisor(s).

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: Can the Fellowship be extended?
answer: No, the tenure of the individual Fellowship cannot be extended beyond its awarded duration.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: How to apply?
answer: Applicants need to submit the application online through the designated portal on IGSTC website www.igstc.org

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: How many times one can apply for the Fellowship?
answer: An applicant can apply as many times as he/she wants. However, one applicant can avail the Fellowship only once.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: What is the eligibility date?
answer: Eligibility criteria will be considered as on the deadline of the Fellowship call.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: Can anyone apply for this Fellowship while holding another?
answer: Applicants receiving any national/international level recognized doctoral Fellowships are eligible to apply provided the other Fellowship doesn't have any restrictions.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: Can an applicant apply without an endorsement letter from host or permission letter from parent organization?
answer: No, the eligible application must contain the endorsement letter from the host organisation in Germany and the permission/NOC from the parent organisation in India as attachments.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: What is the selection procedure?
answer: Applications will be evaluated by a Scientific Committee.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: How much time does the evaluation take?
answer: IGSTC will complete the evaluation process within 8-12 weeks tentatively after the submission deadline.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: When can awardee start the Fellowship?
answer: The fellow should initiate his/her visit normally within 3 months of the result intimation.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: What if the fellow leaves the position before completing the tenure?
answer: IGSTC will terminate the fellowship upon intimation and the fellow must submit a completion report to close the Fellowship.

scheme_name: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
question: What is the follow-up activity of the fellowship?
answer: On completion of the tenure, the fellow should submit a report to IGSTC in the specific format. The fellow must acknowledge IGSTC for any future online/print documents, communication, reports, publication, PhD thesis or anywhere while using the results/outcomes obtained during the fellowship tenure.

scheme_name: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
question: What is AICTE-ISTE Induction/Refresher Program scheme?
answer: AICTE-ISTE Induction/ Refresher Program provide financial assistance to the institutions/universites for conducting training to teaching faculties working in technical institutions.

scheme_name: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
question: Who manages this scheme?
answer: This scheme is managed by AICTE and ISTE.

scheme_name: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
question: Mention one of the main benefits of the scheme.
answer: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the technical university for the training program.

scheme_name: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
question: What should be the criteria of the institution?
answer: Institutions should be AICTE approved.

scheme_name: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
question: Is there any charges for the proposal?
answer: ISTE will charge ₹ 1500/- per proposal as processing fee. The proposals will be accepted only if institute pays the processing fee through RTGS/NEFT.

scheme_name: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
question: Maximum how many proposals per institute would be considered in a year?
answer: Maximum 2 proposals per institute would be considered in a year.

scheme_name: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
question: What is the duration of the Program?
answer: The duration of the Programme shall be one week (six working days).

scheme_name: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
question: Which types of training will be conducted?
answer: Two types: Induction Training and Refresher Training.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: What Is INSPIRE Fellowship?
answer: INSPIRE Fellowship is one of the components of INSPIRE scheme implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India to strengthen the Science and Technology base of the country. This Component focusses on attracting students to pursue doctoral degree in basic and applied sciences including engineering, medicine, agriculture, veterinary, pharmacy etc. after either master's degree in science/engineering or bachelor/ master's degree in Medicine.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: When can we apply for INSPIRE Fellowship?
answer: Call for INSPIRE Fellowship applications is announced during the 3rd/4th quarter of each financial year. Applications are sought from the eligible students through the given below INSPIRE Web-portal: https://www.online-inspire.gov.in

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: How should I apply for INSPIRE Fellowship?
answer: One can apply for the INSPIRE Fellowship, online mode, only against the call. To apply online, please visit the link ttps://www.online-inspire.gov.in and follow the guidelines as given therein.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: Is It Mandatory To Produce The Rank Certificate In The INSPIRE Fellowship Format Or We Can Submit What We Have Received From The Institution?
answer: Yes. It is mandatory to produce a Rank certificate in the prescribed INSPIRE Fellowship Format only (Format is available at https://www.online-inspire.gov.in Provisional Rank certificate or mark sheet will not be accepted for consideration of INSPIRE Fellowship application.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: What is the tenure of this Fellowship?
answer: Fellowship shall be tenable for a maximum period of five years from INSPIRE Fellowship "Effective Date" or completion of the Ph.D. program (i.e. up to the date of successful Ph.D. viva-voce), whichever is earlier. The fellowship shall be governed by administrative norms and guidelines of the Host University/Institute.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: What Would Be Our Designation After Selection Under INSPIRE Fellowship?
answer: The entry in INSPIRE Fellowship would be only as Junior Research Fellow (JRF). There is no direct entry into Senior Research Fellow (SRF). The JRF or SRF under this scheme shall be termed as an 'INSPIRE Fellow'.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: What is the amount of Fellowship?
answer: The Fellowship shall be governed through the Office Memorandum of this Ministry of Number A.20020/11/97-IFD dated 6th August 2007; 31st March 2010; 21st October 2014 [No. SR/S9/Z-09/2012] and SR/S9/Z-08/2018 dated 30th January 2019. However, HRA to the Fellows shall also be applicable as per GoI norms depending upon the location of the Host Institute.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: What are the norms for Contingency Expenditure?
answer: Expenditure of contingency grant would be governed as per host institution norms. The limit of the contingency grant is Rs. 20,000/annum. The unspent balance of the contingency grant at the end of a year shall be adjusted to the next year with a maximum ceiling of Rs.20,000.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: What is PFMS?
answer: Public Financial Management System (PFMS: https://pfms.nic.in) is being implemented by the Office of Controller General of Accounts, Ministry of Finance in partnership with the National Informatics Centre. PFMS has established a common transaction-based online fund management and payment system for the Schemes of the Government of India.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: Is It Mandatory That Host Institute Should Be Registered Under PFMS For Receiving The Fellowship Grant?
answer: Yes. It is mandatory. Else Fellowship fund transfer shall not be done.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: I Am Already Receiving Another Fellowship What Should I Do To Switching Over To INSPIRE Fellowship?
answer: When you receive the Final offer under INSPIRE Fellowship please resign from the previous fellowship for switching over to INSPIRE Fellowship and put these details in Joining-cum-Acceptance letter (Format provided at https://www.online-inspire.gov.in. Please do not resign unless you receive the Final offer, ofINSPIRE Fellowship.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: I Have To Attend An International Conference, Would INSPIRE Fellowship Pay To And Fro Journey Fare Charges?
answer: No.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: What Should Be Done For Getting The Next Installment Of My Fellowship?
answer: INSPIRE Fellow need to upload a Utilization Certificate (UC), Statement of Expenditure (SE), Claim Bill (if any), and Annual Progress Report in the prescribed format(s) (available at https://www.online-inspire.gov.in) in the INSPIRE web portal at the end of every year of completion for release of the next installment.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: What are things to be remembered while preparing the correct and acceptable SE, UC and claim bill?
answer: The second installment onward release to an ongoing Fellow will be considered if the unspent balance from the previously released Fellowship grant including HRA shall be less than Rs.40,000/-. In case, multiple SE and UC have to be uploaded, please make the single file of multiple SE (s) and another file of multiple UC(s) and upload at the appropriate place. SE and UC without the Seal of Competent Authority shall not be accepted. Uploaded SE and UC should be clearly visible.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: How Much Time Will Be Taken After Uploading SE, UC, And Claim Bill For Processing?
answer: From the date of upload of requisite documents, generally, the fellowship grant will be released within 2months.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: When Will I Be Eligible For The Upgradation Of My Fellowship From JRF To SRF?
answer: The up-gradation of Fellowship from Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) to Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) would normally be considered after completion of two (2) years of INSPIRE Fellowship. However, it can be considered after completion of one year as JRF if INSPIRE Fellow has an acceptance of at least one research paper (as a 1st Author) in any international peer-reviewed journal from the Ph.D. work carried out at the respective Host Institute.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: I am INSPIRE Fellow, I got a government job. Can I join my job and hold my INSPIRE fellowship for some period? I want to join INSPIRE Fellowship again after completing my probation period of job, with permission from Employer?
answer: If you join any job (full-time or part-time), there is no provision of holding INSPIRE Fellowship and rejoining again after some time. Your Fellowship will be discontinued from the date of joining of job.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: I Have To Wait For My Bank Details To Be Approved Before Submitting My Joining-Cum- Acceptance Documents.
answer: Already DST approved bank details of respective institutions are available on the INSPIRE Web-portal. If you select the required bank details from the list, then need not wait for its approval. You can directly upload your joining- cum-acceptance report.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: I was awarded final offer of INSPIRE Fellowship. I had to upload bank details then Joining- cum-acceptance (JCA) within one month of Fellowship Final offer. I could not do it within validity?
answer: If the selected INSPIRE Fellow fails to upload JCA within one month from the date of issue of the final offer letter, the offer shall automatically stand withdrawn.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: My provisional offer validity is now over. I could not upload my Ph.D. admission documentsin online portal?
answer: This is an automated process. If a student fails to upload his/ her Ph.D. admission documents within the validity duration, the portal will get automatically closed and then he/ she will not be able to upload Ph.D. admission documents for consideration for Final Offer. In that case, his/ her provisional offer will automatically stand withdrawn.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
question: I had filled my Bank details after receiving Final offer and waiting for its approval. How wouldI know that my documents are approved?
answer: Once you submit the host institute Bank details, usually it takes one week for approval. You are requested to regularly check your INSPIRE web portal account for updates.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: How Many Candidates Are Awarded The Fellowship Every Year?
answer: Every year, 100 candidates are awarded the fellowship.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: What Is The Duration Of The Fellowship?
answer: The duration of the fellowship is 5 years.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: Which Are The Eligible Research Domains For The Fellowship?
answer: Research in both basic and applied science areas including engineering, medicine, agriculture, and veterinary sciences.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: What Are The Objectives Of This Fellowship?
answer: The objective of the scheme is to encourage young researchers to continue research in areas of S&T, Medicine, Agriculture, Pharmacy, and Veterinary Sciences.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: What Additional Documents Are Required By The Applicants Who Are Not INSPIRE Scholars?
answer: First Rank Certificate is required in the case of applicants who are not INSPIRE Scholars.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: What Is The Full Form Of NTRP?
answer: The full-form of NTRP is "Non-Tax Receipt Portal".

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: Does This Fellowship Provide Lateral Entry Options?
answer: While vertical migration from the other INSPIRE components would be encouraged, the faculty fellowship component also provides the opportunity to meritorious candidates for lateral entry into INSPIRE scheme.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: What Documents Are Required To Be Submitted Upon Selection For The Fellowship?
answer: The following documents are required to be submitted upon selection for the fellowship - | Duly signed "Undertaking from INSPIRE Faculty Fellow" | Undertaking duly signed by both the competent authority from the chosen Host institution and the INSPIRE Faculty Fellow. | Every Faculty Fellow needs to provide budget estimates with year-wise detailed break-up under various Heads such as manpower cost, consumables including chemicals, travel, contingency, overhead costs, etc. and non-recurring cost such as equipment for utilization of the Research Grant to the DST-INSPIRE Programme Division along with joining documents.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: Does This Fellowship Offers A Regular/Permanent Position?
answer: INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship provides an opportunity to post-doctoral fellows for carrying out independent research however does not guarantee a regular position after 5 years.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: What Additional Documents Are Required To Be Submitted By The Fellow On The Case Of Transfer Or Change Of Host Institution?
answer: The Faculty Fellow needs to inform the DST-INSPIRE Programme Division immediately with the following documents to effect the change and smooth facilitation of the transfer of funds etc: | Appointment Letter of permanent employment or justification for a change of Host Institution. | NOC from the present Host Institute and Acceptance Letter from the new Host Institute. | Joining Letter from the new Host Institute due to transfer or permanent employment (either the same or a different Host Institution), | Fresh signed copy of the Undertaking (not required in case of permanent employment in the same Host Institution), | Up-to-date financial documents from the present Host Institute (also in case of permanent employment in the same Host Institute).

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
question: How Do I Submit The Online Application?
answer: To apply ONLINE, please visit the website: https://online-inspire.gov.in and follow the process described therein. After the successful submission of the application online, the candidate may obtain a printout of the application and keep it for his/her personal reference.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: What Is The Objective Of Organizing INSPIRE Internship Camp?
answer: The objective of organizing the INSPIRE Internship camp is to reveal the joys of innovation to the talented youth of the nation to pursue study in science and career in Research and Development.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: Who Can Organize INSPIRE INTERNSHIP Camp?
answer: Institutes/Degree Colleges/ Universities can organize INSPIRE Internship Science Camps.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: What Is The Eligibility Of The Program Coordinator?
answer: The Program Coordinator of the proposed INSPIRE Internship camp should be a regular faculty/employee of the respective Institute with a science background.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: Who Can Participate In These Camps?
answer: Students within the eligibility criteria (Given on the website http://www.inspire-dst.gov.in) in Class X of respective Education Boards and pursuing 11th in Science discipline.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: Whether 12th Standard Students Can Participate In The INSPIRE INTERNSHIP Camp?
answer: 12th Students can participate in the INSPIRE INTERNSHIP Camp before the declaration of the result of class X each year.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: What Is The Budget Of Organizing INSPIRE Internship Science Camp?
answer: The maximum budget for a science camp is based on the number of participating students with a ceiling of maximum to the sanctioned strength i.e., at the rate of Rs.6500 per Student. This cost is inclusive of all expenses. No additional grant will be sanctioned beyond the norms.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: What Is The Minimum And Maximum Size Of The INSPIRE Internship Science Camp?
answer: The minimum and maximum INSPIRE Internship Science Camp limit is not there. It depends on the infrastructural capacity of the organizing institute. But the preferred camp size is 150 students participation.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: How Many Mentors Need To Be Called For A Camp ?
answer: 10-12 eminent mentors covering the disciplines of Physics, Chemistry, Life Science, Earth Sciences, and Mathematical Science need to be called.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: What Is The Infrastructural Requirement For Organizing The INSPIRE Internship Camp?
answer: The infrastructural requirement for organizing the INSPIRE Internship Camp is lab infrastructure in the area of Physics, Chemistry, Life Science, Earth Sciences Mathematical Sciences etc., an Auditorium with a sound system, a Guest House, Hostel accommodation for boys and girls.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: Should The Nature Of INSPIRE Internship Science Camp Necessarily Be Residential?
answer: Yes, It should be residential in nature.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: After The Approval Of INSPIRE Internship Science Camp, When Will Be The Grant Released?
answer: The initial grant will be released within two months of the date of commencement of the Program after seeking its formal approval following the normal approval process. The final installment will be received upon receipt of the INSPIRE Internship Science camp completion report.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
question: Do I Have To Wait For My Bank Details To Be Approved?
answer: The bank detail submission page consists of a selected bank details list already approved by DST. If you select the required bank detail from the list, you do not have to wait for its approval.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
question: What Shall Be The Tenure Of The Scholarship?
answer: Selected candidates will be supported for a maximum period of five years, starting from the 1st year B.Sc., B.S., Int. M.Sc./Int.M.S. or until the completion of the course, whichever is earlier.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
question: What Are The Criteria For The Continuation Of The Scholarship?
answer: Continuation of the scholarship for the selected candidates is based on good academic performance in the examinations conducted by the University and upon the recommendation by the Head of the Institution.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
question: What Is The Amount Of The Scholarship?
answer: The scholarship is valued at ₹ 80,000/- per annum.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
question: How Much Shall The Summertime Mentorship Grant Be?
answer: The Summertime Mentorship Grant of ₹ 20,000/- will be paid every year.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
question: How Will The Amount Of The Scholarship Be Disbursed?
answer: The scholarship will be transferred to the scholar's State Bank of India (SBI) bank account directly through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
question: Where Can I Find The URL To The PDF Document Of The User Manual Of The Application Process?
answer: The PDF document of the User Manual of the Application Process can be found at: https://online-inspire.gov.in/Content/guidelines.pdf

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
question: Under Whom Can The SHE Scholars Undertake Summer Research Projects?
answer: All the SHE scholars are required to undertake summer research projects under an active researcher in any recognized research centre across India.

scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
question: What Are The Full Names Of KVPY And NTSE?
answer: The full name of KVPY is "Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana". | The full name of NTSE is "National Talent Search Examination".

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: In which year was the MEA Internship Programme started?
answer: The Ministry of External Affairs of the Govt. of India launched the first edition of its Internship Programme in 2022.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: What are the objectives of this Internship Programme?
answer: The MEA Internship Policy 2022 aims to take foreign policy closer to the people; bring in more focus on MEA; provide value to the interns; ensure better gender inclusivity and increase diversity in terms of qualifications, domicile, and socio-economic status in the cohort of interns engaged by the Ministry.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: What shall be the Obligations Of The Intern?
answer: The Obligations Of The Intern shall be as described below: | - The internship program provides an introduction to the process of formulation of foreign policy and its implementation by the Government of India. Interns will be assigned specific topics of work by the concerned Head of the Division (HOD) and may be required to conduct research, write reports, analyze evolving developments or carry out any other task entrusted to them by the HOD. | - At the end of the internship, each intern shall submit a detailed report on the work carried out and, if required, make a presentation on it. The outcome of the study during the internship will remain as intellectual property of the Ministry of External Affairs and interns shall not use it without prior approval of the Ministry. The intern shall maintain full confidentiality of any information relating to the Ministry of External Affairs.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: Under what circumstances can the internship be terminated?
answer: Termination Of Internship | - Selection To The Internship Programme At The Ministry Of External Affairs Is Strictly Subject To Necessary Security Clearances. | - The Ministry May Terminate The Engagement Of An Intern At Any Point In Time As It Deems Fit, Without Giving Any Reason. | - Decision Of The Ministry Shall Be Final In This Regard. An Intern Can Choose To Terminate The Internship by Giving Prior Notice Of One Week To The Ministry.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: Will the interns be provided any weekly/monthlystipend/honorarium during the course of the internship?
answer: An honorarium of INR 10,000 per month will be paid to each intern to defray basic costs.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: Is there a provision of providing airfare to the interns?
answer: Yes, the Cost Of One-Time To And Fro Air Travel Subject To A Ceiling Of The Prevailing Economy Class Airfare Between The State Capital And Delhi, From The Domicile State Or From The College/University Of The Selected Candidates Will Be Provided. The Interns Would Be Responsible For Their Boarding And Lodging In Delhi During The Period Of Their Internship.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: Will the interns be allowed to Visit One Of The Missions Abroad?
answer: Yes, a visit to one of the Missions abroad will be possible, subject to the prevailing conditions.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: What shall be the assignments of the interns?
answer: Interns will be assigned specific topics of work by the concerned Head of the Division (HOD) and may be required to conduct research, write reports, analyze evolving developments, or carry out any other task entrusted to them by the HOD.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: How many Internships are Offered In A Year?
answer: A total of 75 internships will be offered in a year in a single term of three months from April to June.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: Is there a Minimum Educational Qualification in order to be eligible to apply to the internship?
answer: The internship shall generally be open to Indian citizens with a minimum educational qualification of a graduate degree from a recognized university at the time of applying.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: Is there an age limit In Order To Be Eligible To Apply To The Internship?
answer: Yes, The age of the candidate should not exceed 25 years as on 31 December of the year of internship.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: Are there any sections of the society that Shall Be Given Priority in the selection process?
answer: Yes, the candidates from districts under the Transformation of Aspirational Districts Programme (TADP) and those belonging to SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories shall be given priority at different stages in the selection process.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: How is diversity ensured among the group of the selected interns?
answer: In line with the goal of taking the Ministry and foreign policy closer to the people from all parts of the country, the policy aims to ensure increased diversity amongst the group of interns with respect to gender, underprivileged sections, geographical domicile, and representation from both urban and rural areas.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: Is there a limit to the number of candidates to be Called For Interviews?
answer: Yes, The total number of candidates called for interviews will be three times the number of interns to be engaged in each term.

scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
question: What shall be the procedure in case a Selected Candidate Opts Out?
answer: If any selected candidate opts out, the next candidate in the merit list from the individual state will be offered the opportunity.

scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
question: What Is The Mode Of Application For This Internship Program?
answer: The Mode of Application for this Internship Program is ONLINE.

scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
question: To Whom Should The Application Be Addressed?
answer: The applicants are requested to email their applications to cgoffice-mh@nic.in.

scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
question: What Documents Are Required To Be Attached To The Email?
answer: The applicants are requested to submit their CV and a cover letter containing a brief synopsis of the proposed topic of study during the internship.

scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
question: Can The Individuals Who Have Completed Their Degree Program From Also Apply To This Internship?
answer: Yes, in order to be eligible to apply, the applicant should be pursuing or have completed one of the following programs from a University established under law in the territory of India.

scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
question: In The Case Of Candidates Pursuing Graduation / Post-Graduation / Doctoral Studies, Is It A Mandatory Requirement That The Internship Should Be A Requirement Specified Under Their Course Curriculum?
answer: Yes, in the case of candidates pursuing graduation / post-graduation / doctoral studies, the internship should be a requirement specified under their course curriculum.

scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
question: Are The Interns Provided With A Stipend/Honorarium?
answer: No honorarium of any sort shall be paid to the interns.

scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
question: How Many Leaves Will Be Provided To The Interns?
answer: A leave of three days per month, excluding medical leave, will be provided to the intern.

scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office
question: Where Can I Find The URL To The Scheme Guidelines?
answer: The URL to the Scheme Guidelines can be found at - | https://ipindia.gov.in/writereaddata/Portal/Images/pdf/Internship_Program_at_the_Indian_Patent_Office.pdf

scheme_name: Internship Program At The Indian Patent Office

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

The applications will be scrutinized by a Selection Committee, and selected candidates will be offered internships based on the availability of slots. scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)
question: Can The ICCR Terminate The Internship Program At Any Time?

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

scheme_name: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)

answer: ICCR can instruct interns to terminate the program at any time if deemed fit, without providing a reason. ICCR's decision in this regard is considered final.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: For whom the J.C. Bose Fellowship is meant for?
answer: The J.C. Bose Fellowship is meant to recognize active scientists for their outstanding performance. The fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: What are the eligibility criteria for applying/availing J.C. Bose Fellowship?
answer: Should be an active scientist with a record of outstanding performance apparent from the award of SS Bhatnagar prize and/or fellowship of science academies (including engineering, agriculture and medicine). | The scientist should be in service at the time of nomination to this fellowship. | The nominee should be an Indian national working in institutions in India.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: What are the areas covered under J.C. Bose Fellowship?
answer: All Areas of Science (in the broadest terms) are covered by this Fellowship.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: What is the nature of support for the J.C. Bose Fellow?
answer: The J.C. Bose Fellow will receive a personnel Fellowship of ₹25,000/- per month and a Research Grant of ₹15.00 Lakh per annum. ₹1.00 Lakh is provided as Overheads for the host institute.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: What is the upper age limit up to which the J C Bose fellowship can be availed?
answer: 68 years.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: Can the JC Bose fellow continue the fellowship after superannuation?
answer: The JC Bose fellowship can be continued after superannuation provided a host institution is willing to accept the fellowship and provide all necessary infrastructure and administrative support.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: When can a person apply for the J.C. Bose Fellowship? What is the last date of acceptance of the application?
answer: The nominations for the J.C. Bose Fellowship are accepted throughout the year and there is no last date of acceptance of the nomination.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: Who can nominate for J C Bose Fellows?
answer: Heads of Institutions, JC Bose fellows, Presidents of Science Academies can send the nominations.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: What is the duration of the J.C. Bose Fellowship?
answer: The J.C. Bose Fellowship duration is 5 years.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: How/When can the individual start his J.C. Bose Fellowship?
answer: A letter is sent by the Science & Engineering Research Board to the Individual as well as to the host Institute informing the award of J.C. Bose Fellowship. On receipt of this offer letter, the Individual has to send acceptance letter indicating the month when he/she wants to start the Fellowship, and then the Institute will forward the acceptance letter to the Science & Engineering Research Board. Based on this letter, the Board will process for necessary approvals and a Sanction Order will be issued to the host institute (and a copy to the J.C. Bose Fellow). The start date of fellowship will be the date of receipt of grant at host institute.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: How does a J.C. Bose Fellow get his subsequent Grant?
answer: The Grant for the subsequent years is released after receiving Statement of Expenditure (SE) and Utilization Certificate (UC) along with activity report through the online portal(www.serbonline.in). The SE and UC are to be submitted financial year wise i.e. from 01st April to 31st March. For the first year it would be from the Date of Start (DOS) to 31st March and subsequently from 01st April to 31st March.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: Is the personal fellowship received in J.C. Bose Fellowship scheme taxable?
answer: Yes, it is taxable.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: Can a fellow change the host institute during implementation of J.C. Bose Fellowship?
answer: A J C Bose fellow can change the host institute during implementation of J.C. Bose Fellowship. He has to forward NOCs from both the Institutes along with final financial papers indicating balance unspent grant from the old institute and endorsement certificate(format available on SERB website) and appointment letter from the new Institute indicating the joining date and duration of the appointment.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: What are the guidelines for superannuated fellows availing of the JC Bose fellowship along with any other fellowship/ honorarium?
answer: Superannuated JC Bose fellows can avail the award money provided for SS Bhatnagar Prize/Academy fellowships and honorarium/salary being provided by the host institution in addition to JC Bose fellowship. However, they are not allowed to avail any other fellowship of a similar kind such as DAE Raja Ramanna Fellowship. Any misinformation in this regard may lead to full recovery of J C Bose fellowship with penal interest from the awardees.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: Is there a provision for extension of the fellowship?
answer: The fellowship can be renewed for a period of 5 years after rigorous assessment of research performance of the fellow during the tenure of the fellowship. The fellows will be required to submit a document highlighting the research work done during the previous 5 years, with complete list of publications/patents, and research personnel trained during the tenure of the fellowship. The criteria for renewal will be based on research performance. Any other accomplishment such as occupying leadership position will not be counted as factors. | Minimum exit of 25% of the fellows will be enforced while giving the extension of the fellowship.

scheme_name: J.C. Bose Fellowship
question: Is there any flexibility to utilize the research grant available from the J C Bose fellowship?
answer: There is complete flexibility in using the research grant of Rs. 15.00 lakh. Funds under this "Research Grant" head (Rs. 15.0 Lakh) can be utilized for hiring of manpower, consumables, national travel for self, students, other research staff, visiting scientists and international travel and per diem per year for self for research purposes, chemicals, equipment items, other unforeseen contingencies, repair of equipment, books and journals, etc. and any other research and academic activity, subject to the ceiling of sanctioned Research Grant budget head.

answer: In such areas, local innovations/ technological solutions will be explored. Suggestive technological solutions to address challenges in the supply of drinking water are as under: | Solar energy based stand-alone water supply systems for scattered/ isolated/ tribal/ hilly villages. | Community Water Purification Plant (CWPP) in groundwater contaminated areas. | In cold deserts, solutions may be explored to enhance and store run-off water in small tanks - traditional water harvesting structure, i.e. Zings of Ladakh. Further, artificial glacial reservoirs may be created by diverting the run-off to freeze & store as glacier. | In hard rock areas, bore-blast technique, fracture seal cementation, stream blasting, etc. may be explored. | In hilly areas, adopting spring-based sources, rain water harvesting and standalone bore-well systems (if feasible) will be explored. | In coastal areas, energy efficient small desalination plants with high recovery ratio will be explored, along with construction of sub-surface dykes in rivers. | Use of Internet of Things (IoT), Geographic Information System (GIS) software, etc., will be required for planning and monitoring.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What is the Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre (JRCPC) scheme?
answer: The JRCPC scheme is an initiative by the National Jute Board (NJB) to set up jute training and production centres across India in collaboration with experienced agencies. It aims to promote jute diversification, empower women, and generate sustainable employment through the manufacturing of Jute Diversified Products (JDPs).

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: Who can apply to set up a JRCPC?
answer: Bonafide Indian agencies such as registered jute entrepreneurs, NGOs, cooperative societies, federations, PSUs, exporters, and other organizations with at least three years of experience in jute-related training, production, or marketing are eligible. Preference is given to those experienced in Women SHG development and the textile/handloom/handicrafts sector.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What are the main benefits of the JRCPC scheme?
answer: - Promotes eco-friendly jute alternatives to plastic | - Provides training, raw material, design, and marketing support | - Generates sustainable employment for 10,800+ beneficiaries | - Empowers women (over 70% of trainees will be women) | - Offers backward and forward linkages for JDPs | - Supports inmates of correctional homes and families of security personnel

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: Who are the intended beneficiaries of the training and support under JRCPC?
answer: Potential beneficiaries include artisans, women self-help groups (WSHGs), NGOs, cooperative society members, Trusts, correctional home inmates, and families of Police/Para-Military/Armed Forces Welfare Societies interested in JDP production.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What are the infrastructure requirements for collaborating agencies?
answer: The agency must have: | - An office of at least 250 sq. ft.- A JRCPC space of at least 500 sq. ft.- Basic amenities like telephone, computer/laptop, and email facilities

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: How many people are expected to be trained under the scheme?
answer: The scheme targets training around 18,000 individuals in the production of Jute Diversified Products, out of which more than 70% will be women.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What is the application process for interested agencies?
answer: Applications must be submitted online via the NJB website (https://www.jute.com), followed by the submission of hard copies with required documents to the Head or Regional Office of NJB as per jurisdiction.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What documents are required for the application?
answer: Some key documents include: | - Ownership document (MoU/ AoA of Companies/ Registered Deed of Partnership/ Registration of Societies (or) Trade License, etc., and Adhaar Card / Address Proof of the authorized representative of the agency). | - Income Tax Return for last financial year along with PAN number | - Details of PAN, GST returns for the last 3 financial years | - Annual Reports for last three financial years | - Audited financial statements for last three years | - Any other documents establishing the credential of the agency | - Other supporting documents ( Project experience certificates etc.) | - Recommendation from Dist. Magistrate/Dist. Collector/DIC/ NABARD/ DRDA/BDO may be submitted | - Details of experience in Trainings, Designing/ Product development, Production and Marketing of JDP sector including Award Won and details of its creativity, work done in the past in connection to the scope of the work suggested. | - Proof of Experience and handling relevant activities to be mentioned; | - An Concept / Approach note, (As per guidelines indicated below) highlighting the need of the quality training focusing on development of Jute Diversified Sector through product identification, quality training with design inputs, bulk production and market sales, promotion of these JDPs in domestic and international market. | - An Undertaking from the Agency, that the JRCPC, if allotted, will be operated for atleast one year until and unless terminated by NJB earlier.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: What kind of training will be provided at the JRCPCs?
answer: Training will focus on the design, development, production, and marketing of JDPs. It will include quality training with design inputs, product identification, and promotion strategies for domestic and international markets.

scheme_name: Jute Resource-Cum-Production Centre
question: How does the scheme support the marketing of JDPs?
answer: The scheme offers forward linkages by facilitating sales through Jute Retail Outlets, NJB-organized fairs, and exhibitions, and backward linkages by ensuring supply of raw materials through JRMB (Jute Raw Material Bank).

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the JRF program?
answer: The JRF program is a fellowship program that provides financial support to students who are pursuing doctoral research in biotechnology and life sciences. The program is funded by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: Who is eligible for the JRF program?
answer: - Be an Indian national. | - Have a master's degree in biotechnology or a related field from a recognized university. | - Have a valid BET score.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the application process for the JRF program?
answer: To apply for the JRF program, you must first qualify in the Biotechnology Eligibility Test (BET). The BET is a national-level entrance exam conducted by the DBT once a year. | Once you have qualified in the BET, you can apply for the JRF program online. The online application process typically opens in the month of July and closes in the month of August.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What documents are required for the RF program?
answer: - BET exam scorecard. | - Research proposal. | - No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer (if applicable). | - Personal details and educational qualifications. | - Category certificate (if applicable). | - Persons with Disability (PWD) certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the selection process for the JRF program?
answer: - BET exam score | - Research proposal | - Interview performance

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the duration of the JRF program?
answer: The JRF program is a five-year program.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What is the fellowship amount for the JRF program?
answer: The fellowship amount for the JRF program is ₹31,000 per month for the first two years and ₹35,000 per month for the remaining three years.

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What are the career prospects after completing the JRF program?
answer: After completing the JRF program, you can pursue a career in research, academia, industry, or government. Some of the specific job roles that you may be eligible for include: | Research scientist | Professor | Lecturer | Science communicator | Technical writer | Patent agent | Regulatory affairs specialist | Quality assurance manager | Business development manager

scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship
question: What are the responsibilities of a JRF fellow?
answer: The responsibilities of a JRF fellow include: | Conducting research in biotechnology or a related field | Publishing research papers in peer-reviewed journals | Presenting research findings at conferences and seminars | Completing PhD degree within the stipulated time frame
