answer: For Category 2: The minimum duration of the internship shall be of six months, extendable up to a maximum of twelve months.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: Is the duration of the internship extendable?
answer: Yes, extension beyond six months shall be permitted, on the application of an intern duly recommended by the concerned Head of Division and with the approval of the Head of NCCS.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: Will there be an induction/orientation program for the students selected for the internship?
answer: Yes, an orientation workshop will be held for interns at the beginning of the internship.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: By whom shall the attendance record of the students be maintained?
answer: The attendance record and the details of work supervision shall be maintained by the Divisions/Units in NCCS.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: Is the submission of paper a mandatory requirement for the successful completion of the internship?
answer: Yes, the interns will be required to submit a Report/Paper on the work undertaken at the end of the internship to the respective Division. The Report shall be signed by the concerned Officer with whom the intern is attached, as an acceptance of the successful completion of the Internship.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: How much shall be the token remuneration for 'Category 1' Interns?
answer: Interns selected under Category 1 will be paid a token remuneration @ ₹ 7,500/- per month on prorate basis.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: How much shall be the token remuneration for category 2 interns?
answer: Interns selected under Category 2 will be paid a token remuneration @ ₹ 15,000/- per month on prorate basis.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: When shall the amount of the token remuneration become payable?
answer: The remuneration shall be paid after the completion of the month subject to satisfactory progress of work duly accepted by the concerned division from the earlier "Professional Services" head of Accounts, which has now been revised to " Salaries" Head of account in view of Operationalization of revised/new object heads under Rule 8 of DFPR,1978.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: Will any logistics & support be provided by NCCS to the interns?
answer: NCCS shall provide them with working space, workplace Internet facility and other necessities as deemed fit by the concerned Head of Division.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: Will the laptop/desktop be provided by NCCS?
answer: No, the Interns will be required to have their own laptops.

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: Where can I find the link to the scheme guidelines?
answer: The link to the Scheme Guidelines is: https://nccs.gov.in/public/latest_updates/NCCS%20Internship%20Notification%20-%20Q4%2025%20Signed.pdf

scheme_name: National Centre For Communication Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
question: Is there any kind of reservation / preference / priority in the selection of the candidates?
answer: Candidates having exposure in the area of intended internship with good academic background and having higher qualifications, based on need shall be given preference.

scheme_name: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme

scheme_name: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme

scheme_name: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme

scheme_name: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme
question: Is the contract period extendable?

scheme_name: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme

scheme_name: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme
question: What is the methodology for shortlisting of candidates?
answer: Refer to the Annexure II of RA notification published on NCCS website.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: What is the "National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship" scheme?
answer: The "National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship" scheme is an initiative by the Earth System Science Organization, Ministry of Earth Sciences, to provide opportunities for school and college students to familiarize themselves with and pursue research in different branches of earth sciences.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Who can apply for this internship?
answer: The internship is open to school students as well as college students who are interested in exploring and conducting research in the field of earth sciences.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: What kind of research opportunities are available under this scheme?
answer: The scheme offers opportunities to work on various branches of earth sciences, including but not limited to geology, oceanography, meteorology, and environmental science. Students can engage in hands-on research projects and gain exposure to advanced scientific methodologies.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Is the National Centre for Earth Science Studies (NCESS) recognized for any academic programs?
answer: Yes, NCESS is an R&D institution recognized for doctoral programs in science, environmental, and interdisciplinary topics. It also offers opportunities for Ph.D. registration announced by universities.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Are there any programs for scientific exchange at NCESS?
answer: Yes, NCESS hosts eminent scientists for scientific exchange programs, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing within the scientific community.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: What opportunities does NCESS offer for students?
answer: NCESS provides various opportunities for school and college students to familiarize themselves with and pursue research in different branches of earth sciences. These include an open day for school students, internship/summer training, and dissertation programs for university students.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: When is the open day for school students held?
answer: The open day is observed in April every year, coinciding with Earth Day celebrations.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: What programs are available for university students at NCESS?
answer: NCESS offers Internship/Summer training and Dissertation programs to selected candidates as part of their curriculum. Additionally, research scholars can register for Ph.D. programs under science, environmental, and interdisciplinary topics when announcements are made by the universities.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: When can students apply for internships/training/dissertation at NCESS?
answer: Applications can be submitted during February and September every year. The online form is active from 01 February to 28 February and from 01 September to 30 September.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: How should interested candidates apply?
answer: Candidates must apply in the prescribed format available on the NCESS website. Selected candidates need to bring a printout of their application forms, duly signed by the HOD of their respective department with an official seal, at the time of arrival for training.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: What is the selection process?
answer: Shortlisted candidates, approved by the Director of NCESS, will be announced on the website in the first week of May and the first week of December. The list will also mention the allocated supervisor/group and the title of the internship/training/dissertation.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Can candidates choose their supervisors?
answer: No, supervisors and Internship/Training/Dissertation students are not allowed to select each other. A suitable supervisor will be allotted based on the applications and the applicant's research interests.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: What is the duration of the internship/ training/ dissertation?
answer: Students must undergo at least 8 weeks of training continuously at NCESS.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Are field trips allowed during the program?
answer: Only day field trips (no overnight stay) are allowed for visiting students. Prior approval from the Visiting Students Committee and the Director of NCESS is mandatory for any field work.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Are students allowed on the NCESS campus during weekends and holidays?
answer: Visiting students are allowed on the NCESS campus on working days only. In exceptional conditions, they may be allowed on weekends and holidays with prior approval from the Supervisor and Group Head.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: What are the requirements for completing the internship/training/dissertation?
answer: Students must deliver a 15-minute presentation (10-minute presentation + 5-minute discussion) at the end of their training/dissertation period. Post-presentation, students can get their report/dissertation signed by the supervisor and submit it to the visiting students' committee for issuing the certificate. The report/ dissertation must also be submitted to the NCESS library for future reference.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Is consent required for publishing work resulting from the project?
answer: Yes, any publication or communication to a journal that results from the project work must have the consent of both the Guide and NCESS.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Will accommodation and transport be provided to project students?
answer: No, NCESS does not provide accommodation or transport for project students.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Is there a fee for carrying out project works at NCESS?
answer: No, there is no fee for carrying out project works at NCESS.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Can NCESS decline or discontinue project requests?
answer: Yes, NCESS reserves the right to not consider any or all requests and to close or discontinue the program without assigning any reasons.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: Within what time frame the visiting students have to accept the Internship/ Training/ Dissertation offer?
answer: Visiting students need to accept the Internship/Training/Dissertation offer within 7-10 working days from the date of the offer.

scheme_name: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
question: What happens if a visiting student does not accept the offer within the specified time frame?
answer: If no reply is received within 7-10 working days, the offer will be transferred to other applicants depending on the waiting list.

scheme_name: National Career Service Centers For SC/STs (erstwhile Coaching-cum-Guidance Centre for SC/STs)
question: Is this training program available to everyone, or is it specifically reserved for candidates belonging to certain social categories?
answer: This scheme is specifically designed for unemployed jobseekers belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories.

scheme_name: National Career Service Centers For SC/STs (erstwhile Coaching-cum-Guidance Centre for SC/STs)
question: What is the minimum educational qualification required to be eligible for the special coaching schemes and computer training courses?
answer: You must have passed the 10+2 examination to be eligible for the special coaching schemes or training courses offered.

scheme_name: National Career Service Centers For SC/STs (erstwhile Coaching-cum-Guidance Centre for SC/STs)
question: Will I receive any monthly financial assistance to support my expenses while attending the training or coaching classes?
answer: Yes, enrolled candidates receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- paid through the Direct Benefit Transfer scheme.

scheme_name: National Career Service Centers For SC/STs (erstwhile Coaching-cum-Guidance Centre for SC/STs)
question: What are the attendance requirements I must fulfill to ensure I receive the monthly stipend without any deductions?
answer: You must maintain a minimum of 80% attendance in a particular month to be eligible for the stipend of ₹1,000/-.

scheme_name: National Career Service Centers For SC/STs (erstwhile Coaching-cum-Guidance Centre for SC/STs)
question: Is there a specific limit on my family's annual income that determines my eligibility for the coaching and training program?
answer: Yes, your family's annual income must not exceed ₹3,00,000/- per annum to be eligible for the coaching or courses.

scheme_name: National Career Service Centers For SC/STs (erstwhile Coaching-cum-Guidance Centre for SC/STs)
question: Do I need to purchase my own study materials, or does the center provide books and stationery for the course?
answer: The center provides free books and stationery worth ₹1,000/- per candidate for the entire duration of the course.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: What is the National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award?
answer: It is an award to recognize and honor vaidyas and Ayurveda experts for their outstanding contributions in the field.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: Who is eligible for this award?
answer: Renowned Ayurvedic practitioners with significant contributions and at least 20 years of professional experience.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: What is the minimum age for applicants?
answer: The applicant must be at least 40 years old.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: What qualifications are required?
answer: A recognized degree in Ayurveda under the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine Act, 2020 or Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: Can past awardees apply again?
answer: No, past recipients of the award are not eligible for the same award again.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: How many awards are given annually?
answer: Three awards are presented every year.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: Who can nominate for the award?
answer: Eligible Ayurveda practitioners can be nominated by themselves or by another individual.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: Is there an online application process?
answer: Yes, nominations are submitted and processed online.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: What type of contributions are considered?
answer: Promotion and propagation of Ayurveda, teaching, research and development, policy planning, or integration into national health programs.

scheme_name: National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award
question: Can non-Indians apply?
answer: No, the award is only for Indian citizens.

scheme_name: NDRI Institute Scholarship For M.Sc. And Ph.d
question: What are the benefits for the scholarship ?
answer: All eligible Master's students on the rolls of NDRI will receive Rs. 7560/- per month.All eligible Doctoral students on the rolls of NDRI will receive Rs. 10,500/- per month during the period of Ph.D. tenure. scheme_name: NDRI Institute Scholarship For M.Sc. And Ph.d

scheme_name: NDRI Institute Scholarship For M.Sc. And Ph.d

scheme_name: NDRI Institute Scholarship For M.Sc. And Ph.d
question: What are the documents are required ?

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: What is the objective of the NEBPS?
answer: The objective of the Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme is to promote the establishment of Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Information Technology Enabled Services (ITeS) operations in the North-Eastern region of India and create employment opportunities for local youth. | The scheme also aims to encourage investment in the Information Technology (IT) and ITeS sector, expand the industry base in the North-Eastern states, and promote balanced regional growth.

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: Which ministry launched the Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme?
answer: The scheme was launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology under the Digital India Programme.

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: What financial support is provided under the scheme?
answer: The scheme provides financial support of up to 50% of Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operational Expenditure (OPEX), subject to a maximum limit of ₹1,00,000 per BPO/ITeS seat.

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: What is the employment target under the scheme?
answer: The scheme aims to support the establishment of 5,000 BPO/ITeS seats in the North-Eastern region, which can generate significant employment opportunities.

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: Which states are covered under the scheme?
answer: The scheme covers the following North-Eastern states: | • Assam | • Arunachal Pradesh | • Manipur | • Meghalaya | • Mizoram | • Nagaland | • Sikkim | • Tripura

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: Who can apply for the scheme?
answer: Companies registered in India under the Companies Act, 1956 or 2013, or entities registered under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, can apply for the scheme.

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: What is the minimum seat capacity required to participate in the scheme?
answer: The applicant should establish BPO/ITeS operations with a minimum capacity of 25 seats at one location.

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: What is the maximum number of seats that can be applied for under the scheme?
answer: A bidder may apply for up to 1,500 seats, either at one location or across multiple locations in the North-Eastern region.

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: What is the minimum operational period required under the scheme?
answer: The applicant should commit to operating the BPO/ITeS unit for at least 3 years.

scheme_name: Northeast BPO Promotion Scheme
question: Are there additional incentives under the scheme?
answer: Yes. Additional incentives may be provided for: | • Employing women employees | • Employing persons with disabilities | • Generating employment beyond the approved target | • Local entrepreneurs establishing BPO/ITeS units

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: What is the National Energy Conservation Award?
answer: The National Energy Conservation Award recognizes organizations for their outstanding efforts in energy conservation and energy efficiency.

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: Which ministry is responsible for this award?
answer: The award is administered by the Ministry of Power, Government of India through the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE).

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: Which sectors are covered under this award?
answer: The award covers industries, buildings, transport, institutions, and equipment sectors contributing significantly to electricity consumption.

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: Who is eligible to apply for the award?
answer: All organizations can apply free of cost, provided their sector is eligible for the award in that particular year.

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: Are there any organizations that are not eligible to apply?
answer: Yes, organizations with legal issues, blacklisted entities, or defaulters under government schemes are not eligible.

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: Can defaulters under the PAT scheme apply?
answer: No, repeated defaulters under the Perform Achieve and Trade (PAT) scheme are not allowed to apply.

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: How many awards are given under this scheme?
answer: A total of 65 awards are given across various sectors and categories.

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: Who can nominate for the award?
answer: Any eligible organization can nominate itself for the award.

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: How is the final selection made?
answer: The Selection Committee evaluates the data and recommends candidates to the Award Committee for final approval.

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: Who approves the final list of awardees?
answer: The Competent Authority/Award Committee chaired by the Secretary, Power, approves the final list.

scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award
question: Why is this award important for organizations?
answer: It encourages organizations to adopt energy-efficient practices and contributes to reducing overall energy consumption in India.

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
question: Is There Is Any Reservation / Quota Under The Scheme?
answer: There will not be any reservation/quota on the basis of category/religion/gender.

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
question: Is There Any Income Criteria Under The Scheme?
answer: Yes, the scholarship shall be admissible to the students whose parent / guardian's annual income from all sources shall not exceed ₹8,00,000.

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
question: What Is The Criterion For Selection Of Students For Scholarships?
answer: The scholarship is purely on merit basis. The merit list will be prepared exclusively on | the basis of marks obtained by the candidate in the qualifying exams and complying with the | level-of-course-wise slots allotted to the states. Selection of students for M. Phil and Ph. D. will | be done on the basis of topic of research/Synopsis which has relevance to the problems/issues | related to NE Region. For further details, please see the "Rules for Award for NEC Merit | Scholarship" on NSP.

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
question: I Have Enrolled In M/Phil / PhD, But My Topic Is Not Finalized, Can I Apply For Scholarships?
answer: No, only students whose MPhil / Ph.D. topic is submitted and are registered with that topic can apply for the scholarship.

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
question: I Have Got Scholarship For The 1st Year, Will I Automatically Be Provided Scholarships In The Subsequent Years Of My Study?
answer: No, all existing and eligible beneficiaries of the scholarship are required to fill up the | renewal form on NSP every year during their entire course period. Every renewal of the scholarship | is for a period of one academic year only, if not otherwise specified.

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
question: Am I Eligible To Get Scholarship For The Entire Period Of My Study?
answer: Once selected, the scholarship shall be available to a selected student for the prescribed | duration of a course subject to fulfillment of renewal conditions. The scholarship for M.Phil. will | be available for 2 years and for Ph.D scholarship shall be for 3 years. For further details, please | see the "Rules for Award for NEC Merit Scholarship" on NSP.

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
question: How Can I Apply Online For A Scholarship?
answer: In order to apply online, please visit the website through the URL www.scholarships.gov.in | or through the mobile app of NSP or UMANG. You may click on a particular Scheme displayed | in the on-Boarded schemes section on the Home page to apply

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
question: Can I Edit The Information Already Saved And Up-To What Time?
answer: All the information can be edited till the closure of the application form. After final submission, your application will be forwarded to the next level and the application hereby cannot be edited.

scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
question: Which Fields Institute/State Can Edit?
answer: The Fields which can be edited are Gender, Religion, Category, Profession, Annual Income, Aadhar Number, Disability, Day Scholar/Hostlar, Mode of Study, IFSC Code, Account No.,Admission Fees and Tuition Fees. However, corrections made by the Institute/State, if any, would be conveyed instantly to the student through SMS/email.

answer: Students can check the status of their Online Application by logging in using his/her Permanent id and Date Of Birth and opening the link "Check your Status".

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students

answer: The candidates belonging to Scheduled Tribes (ST) who have passed the Post-Graduation examination and fulfilled the Scheme guidelines of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA) are eligible to apply for these fellowships.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: How Many Slots/Seats Available For Fellowship?
answer: There are 750 slots/seats available for fresh fellowship each year.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: Is There Any Family Income Criteria Required For Availing Scholarship?
answer: There is no family income criteria required for availing scholarship.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: If A Student Is Unable To Complete His /Her Course, What Will Happen In That Case?
answer: If a student is unable to complete the course for any reason, he/she is liable to refund 50% of the total fellowship amount received by him/her to the Ministry.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: What Is The Starting Date Of The Fellowship?
answer: The starting date of fellowship for the selected year is the date from which they have taken admission/joined an M.Phil/Ph.D. course in the same election year. Otherwise, the fellowship will be eligible for the remaining period of the course duration in case of the students have joined prior to the Selection year.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: Is There Any Gap Period For The Registration In Ph.D. After Completion Of M.Phil Course?
answer: The gap period for the registration in Ph.D. after completion of M.Phil in the case of Integrated M.Phil. + Ph.D. is one year and the Fellowship will lapse if the gap period is more than one year. In the case of a Ph.D., the candidate is required to apply as afresh, even though he/she has completed M.Phil.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: Can I Avail Of Any Other Scholarship From The Central/ State Government For The Same Study?
answer: The ST students once considered eligible for the Fellowship shall not be entitled to any other scholarship of the Central or State Government for the same study. If selected, the candidate should refund the money to the concerned agency for the selected year.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: Can I Transfer The Fellowship From One Universities/Institutes/Colleges To Other Universities/Institutes/Colleges?
answer: Answer: The Selected Students of Fellowship will be permitted to transfer the | fellowship from one Universities/Institutes/College to another Universities/Institutes/College subject to online submission of `No Objection Certificate from both the Universities/Institutes/Colleges. Thereafter, approval of the Ministry is required to complete the process of transfer.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: How Can A Student Upgrade A Course From M.Phil To Ph.D?
answer: The Student is required to submit an upgradation certificate issued by the Committee of three members comprising of the Head of the Department, Supervisor, and one outside subject expert to be constituted by the concerned Department of the University/Institution/College for evaluation of the work of student.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: What Are The Reasons For The Cancellation Of The Fellowship?
answer: There are the following reasons for the cancellation of the fellowship: | If the awardee is found to be ineligible to receive the award, at any point of time during the entire duration of the fellowship. | Misconduct of awardee. | Unsatisfactory progress of research work. | Any other fellowship is drawn from other sources (s)/ drawn fellowship or selected by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for Fellowship earlier. | Concealment of facts and any other ground of misconduct.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: What Should Students Do, In Case They Face Any Problems While Filling The Application Form In Google Chrome?
answer: Answer: If students face any problems while filling out the application form in Google Chrome, students are advised to use internet explorer. In case of any issue/error in internet explorer as well, they are advised to clear browser history /cache and try again. They can send mail given in portal at "Contact us".

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: What Should Be The Type And Size Of The Documents And Profile Photo To Be Uploaded?
answer: All documents should be uploaded in pdf file and the Profile Photo should be in .jpg/.jpeg format (Size: - 50 KB-100KB).

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: Which Fields I Can Edit Before The Final Submission Of The Application?
answer: You can edit all details except "Registration Details" except Pre-filled | information. It may be noted that once you 'finally submit your application it will be forwarded to the next level and after that editing is not possible. Therefore before Final Submission, it should be ensured that details are filled in correctly and documents uploaded.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: Which Fields In The Application Form Are Mandatory?
answer: Fields provided with a black asterisk (*) mark are mandatory fields.

scheme_name: National Fellowship & Scholarship For Higher Education Of Scheduled Tribe (ST) Students
question: Do I Have To Fill Up The Online Application In One Sitting?
answer: No, you can fill up the online application in many settings by clicking the 'Save & Next' button from the Personal Information to Candidate Document Tab. The application is at every stage until you click on the ' Final Submit' button finally.

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme
question: Will the benefits be provided monthly or as lump sum?
answer: The one-time financial assistance under this scheme will be provided as lump sum.

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme
question: How will it be decided which member of the family should be provided the amount of assistance be provided?
answer: The assistance will be provided to such surviving member of the household of the deceased poor , who after local inquiry, is found to be the head of the household.

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme
question: What is the maximum amount of financial assistance that a household can receive through NFBS?
answer: Under this scheme, a household will receive a one-time assistance of ₹ 20000.

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme
question: My mother passed away this month. She and my father were both earning members of the family. However, my mother earned more than my father. Will she be considered as the Primary Breadwinner of the family?
answer: Yes, Your mother will be considered as the Primary Breadwinner. Irrespective of the gender, the Primary Breadwinner is the family member whose income constitutes a major share of the family's total earnings.

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme
question: Will my uncles & aunts and their children will also be considered as part of the household?
answer: No, the term "household' in this case strictly includes spouse, minor children, unmarried daughters and dependent parents.

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme
question: I have duly filled and signed the application form for NFBS. I have also attached the necessary documents and passport sized photograph. Where/Whom am I supposed to submit the form?
answer: The duly filled and signed form (along with the copies of the required documents) need to be submitted to either the District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) or Tehsil Social Welfare Officer (TSWO).

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme
question: After my father passed away, my mother became the main breadwinner of the family. She is eligible to apply for NFBS but she is illiterate and cannot sign. Does the form has the option of thumb impression instead of signature?
answer: Yes, for the applicant who is unable to sign the form, there is the option for providing the thumb impression.

scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme
question: Where do I find my Family ID and Member ID?
answer: The details reg. the Family ID and Member ID can be found in your BPL Card.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: How Many Slots Of Fellowship Are There In This Scheme?
answer: The scheme is designed to provide a total number of 300 Junior Research Fellowships per year from the year 2014-15 and 300 Senior Research Fellowships from 2016-17 to Other Backward Class (OBC) students. The number of intake of JRF has been enhanced from 300 to 1000 per year onwards to undertake advanced studies and research leading to M.Phil./Ph.D. Degrees.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: Which Universities/Institutions Are Covered In This Scheme?
answer: The scheme covers all universities/institutions recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and are implemented by the UGC itself on the pattern of the scheme of UGC Fellowship being awarded to research students pursuing M.Phil. and Ph.D.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: What Is The Objective Of This Scheme?
answer: The objective of the scheme is to increase the opportunities for the students of Other Backward Classes (OBCs) for pursuing higher education leading to acquiring degrees such as M.Phil. and Ph.D. The scheme aims at providing financial assistance to the OBC students in obtaining quality higher education leading to degrees such as M.Phil. and Ph.D. in universities, research institutions and scientific institutions.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: Who Is The Nodal Agency For Implementing The Scheme?
answer: UGC is the nodal agency for implementing the scheme.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: Will The Selected Candidate Be Entitled To Any Other Benefits From Central Or State Government?
answer: No, the students belonging to Other Backward Class (OBC) category once considered eligible for the fellowship shall not be entitled to any other benefits from Central or State Government or any other body like UGC offering similar benefit to avoid duplication and increase coverage.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: Is The Tenure Of The Fellowship Extendable?
answer: After two years, if the progress in the research work of the awardee is found satisfactory, his/her tenure will be extended for a further period of three years as Senior Research Fellow (SRF). The research work will be assessed as per the UGC norms. The total period of award of JRF and SRF shall not exceed a period of 5 years.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: Are There Any Reservations For PwDs?
answer: Yes, at least 4% of the total seats should be reserved for students with disabilities while making selection of candidates for award of fellowships by the UGC.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: Are The Employees Of Any University/College/Educational Institution/Central/State/UT Government Allowed To Avail The Fellowship?
answer: No, the employees of any University/College/Educational institution/Central/State/UT Government shall be excluded from availing the fellowship, even if they are on study leave or Extra Ordinary Leave (EOL) to pursue M.Phil./Ph.D.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: What Is The Amount Of Fellowship For Science Humanities And Social Science?
answer: @ Rs.31,000/- p.m. for initial two years (JRF), @ Rs.35,000/- pm. for remaining tenure (SRF)

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: What Is The Amount Of Fellowship For Engineering & Technology?
answer: @ Rs.31,000/- p.m. for initial two years (JRF), @ Rs.35,000/- pm. for remaining tenure (SRF)

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: What Is The Amount Of Contingency For Humanities & Social Sciences?
answer: @ Rs.10,000/- p.a. for initial two years, @ Rs.20,500/- p.a. for remaining tenure

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: What Is The Amount Of Contingency For Sciences, Engineering & Technology?
answer: @ Rs.12,000/- p.a. for initial two years, @ Rs.25,000/- p.a. for remaining tenure

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: What Is The Amount Of Escorts/Reader Assistance?
answer: (All subjects) @ Rs.2,000/- p.m. in cases of physically and visually handicapped candidates

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: Will HRA Be Provided To The Student?
answer: House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be on the UGC pattern and will be payable to those students who are not provided with hostel accommodation. In case hostel accommodation offered by the University/institution is refused, the student will forfeit his claim of HRA, other facilities such as medical facilities, leave including maternity leave will be governed as per the guidelines of the UGC in case of their fellowship programme.

scheme_name: National Fellowship For OBC Students
question: How Is The Monitoring & Evaluation Of The Scheme Performed?
answer: A dashboard to monitor progress, geographic spread, discipline-wise students enrolled, sanctions, completion of courses, etc. shall be put in place by UGC on its portal to be accessed by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment via login credential.

scheme_name: National Food Security Mission NFSM
question: Is there any age criteria for availing scheme benefits?
answer: Any farmer who owns the land can avail benefits under the scheme.

scheme_name: National Food Security Mission NFSM
question: Is there a preference for certain gender /caste of farmers?
answer: All farmers are to be considered under the scheme, however, as per GoI norms, women farmers, and SC/ST farmers may be given preference.

scheme_name: National Food Security Mission NFSM
question: Is there a minimum education qualification for the scheme?
answer: No, any farmer meeting requisite criteria may be considered under the scheme.

scheme_name: National Food Security Mission NFSM
question: Is there a fee for availing the benefits?
answer: No, there is no fee.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: What are the National Geoscience Awards?
answer: The National Geoscience Awards recognize individuals and teams for outstanding contributions in geosciences, mining, and mineral exploration.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: Which ministry administers these awards?
answer: The awards are administered by the Ministry of Mines, Government of India.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: Who is eligible to apply for these awards?
answer: Any Indian citizen with significant contributions in geosciences or related fields is eligible.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: What are the categories of awards?
answer: The awards include Lifetime Achievement, National Geoscience Award, and Young Geoscientist Award.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: Can teams apply for the awards?
answer: Yes, teams can apply for the National Geoscience Award with a maximum of four members.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: Is there any age limit for applicants?
answer: Yes, for the Young Geoscientist Award, the applicant must be below 35 years of age.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: Can a person apply more than once?
answer: A person cannot receive the award twice in the same field but may apply in other fields.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: Are previous awardees eligible to apply again?
answer: Lifetime Achievement awardees are not eligible to apply for any other awards.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: Is work done outside India considered?
answer: Only work primarily carried out in India is considered for most award categories.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: Is there any requirement for experience duration?
answer: Yes, contributions made in the last ten years are considered, except for Lifetime Achievement.

scheme_name: National Geoscience Awards
question: How many awards are given under this scheme?
answer: A total of 12 awards are given across different categories.

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: What Are The Objectives Of National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards ?
answer: The objectives provide awards for one's creativity, without any technical support from external agencies. Creative ideas for innovative technologies/ techniques solving persistent problems of society, which may not have been developed into prototypes, may also be submitted.

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: Who organizes these awards?
answer: The National Innovation Foundation (NIF), an autonomous body under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, organizes these awards.

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: What is the purpose of these awards?
answer: The awards aim to acknowledge and honor innovators and practitioners who have made noteworthy contributions to indigenous knowledge and grassroots innovation.

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: In which categories are the awards conferred?
answer: The awards are given in various categories, including agriculture, health, energy, engineering, and other sectors that showcase grassroots innovations and traditional knowledge.

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: What role do these awards play in preserving indigenous cultures?
answer: By acknowledging and rewarding outstanding traditional knowledge practices, these awards play a pivotal role in preserving and promoting indigenous cultures, ensuring their continuity and relevance.

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: Who can get the scheme benefits?
answer: - Uneducated or school dropout. | - School students (up to class 12) or those out of school and up to 17-18 years of age). | - ITI/ Polytechnic diploma students or Diploma holders. | - Individual innovators with no professional/ technical training or science/ technology related education. | - Individuals affiliated with any formal institution and without duties related to Scientific, Technological (S&T)/ Technical or Research and Development (R&D) related work. | - Retired individual innovators with no science/ technology related education and without professional experience of S&T/ R&D activities.

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: What is the application process?
answer: - Applicant need to complete the registration process. | - Fill the application form. | - Provide the required documents.

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: Who can apply for the awards?
answer: - Individual | - Organization

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: How Individuals can register ?
answer: Step-1: Visit the official website. | Step-2: Click on the Registration button. | Step-3: Choose type Individual. | Step-4: Provide the required details. | Step-5: Submit.

scheme_name: National Grassroots Innovation and Outstanding Traditional Knowledge Awards
question: What documents are required ?
answer: - Aadhaar Card. | - Photograph. | - Proof of Age. | - Proof of Address. | - Proof of Educational Qualification (Passing Certificate, Marksheet). | - Proof of Professional Experience. | - Details of work done in the last three years in the field. | - Details of Awards and Honors Received.

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: What is the objective of the National Gopal Ratna Award?
answer: The award aims to motivate farmers to enhance the productivity of indigenous milch breeds scientifically, encourage Artificial Insemination Technicians for 100% AI coverage, and promote competitiveness among dairy cooperatives and milk producer companies.

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: Who can apply for the National Gopal Ratna Award?
answer: Dairy farmers, Dairy Cooperative Societies/Farmer Producer Organisations/Milk Producer Companies, and Artificial Insemination Technicians can apply under their respective categories.

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: Can applicants apply through self-nomination?
answer: Yes, self-nomination is allowed for both individuals (farmers and AI technicians) and organisations (DCS/FPO/MPC).

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: How many awards are given each year?
answer: A total of 12 awards are given annually, with 4 awards in each of the 3 categories.

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: What are the monetary benefits under the scheme?
answer: For Best Dairy Farmer and Best DCS/FPO/MPC categories: | - ₹5,00,000 for 1st rank | - ₹3,00,000 for 2nd rank | - ₹2,00,000 for 3rd rank | - ₹2,00,000 as a special award for NER and Himalayan states

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: Is there any cash prize for Artificial Insemination Technicians?
answer: No, the AIT category receives only a certificate of merit and a memento, with no cash prize.

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: What is the minimum eligibility for dairy organizations?
answer: Organisations must be registered and engaged in dairy activities, collecting at least 100 litres of milk per day with 50 members (Non-NER states) or 20 litres per day with 20 members (NER states).

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: Are Veterinary Doctors eligible for the AIT category?
answer: No, Veterinary Doctors are not eligible for the Artificial Insemination Technician category.

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: How are the awardees selected?
answer: Applications are screened by an agency like QCI, verified through field visits by NDDB or others, and then evaluated by Screening and National Award Committees.

scheme_name: National Gopal Ratna Award
question: When are the awards announced and presented?
answer: The awardees are announced on 25th November, and the awards are presented on 26th November (National Milk Day).

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: How is the financial assistance disbursed to selected artisans?
answer: Financial assistance is disbursed through the In-charge in the respective field formation of the Office of the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts) following the finalization of selection by the Core Committee.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: How are the applications by the artisans processed after submission?
answer: Upon receipt, applications undergo inspections by field officers. Completed applications are processed within 30 days, and a Core Committee finalizes the selection of master craftspersons for financial assistance based on recommendations from the Regional Director.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: How often do artisans need to submit income certificates and affidavits for seeking financial support?
answer: Master craftspersons are required to submit income certificates and affidavits duly countersigned by a First-Class Magistrate every financial year to continue receiving financial support.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: What documents are required to be submitted along with the application form?
answer: Applicants need to submit documents such as a photograph, self-attested copy of handicrafts award certificate, income certificate, proof of age, disability certificate (if applicable), and an affidavit in the prescribed format attested by a First-Class Magistrate.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: How much financial assistance is provided to eligible artisans under this scheme?
answer: Eligible artisans can receive assistance of up to ₹8,000/- per month in the form of a monthly allowance or lump sum grant, facilitated through PFMS/DBT.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: What is the primary objective of the "Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances" scheme?
answer: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to master craftspersons facing indigent circumstances during their old age, thereby supporting their livelihood and welfare.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: Can artisans receive financial assistance from other sources while availing benefits under this scheme?
answer: No, artisans receiving similar financial assistance from any other source are not eligible to receive benefits under this scheme.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: Can the financial assistance be revoked if the artisan's income exceeds the specified limit?
answer: Yes, if the artisan's income exceeds ₹1,00,000/- in the preceding financial year, they may no longer be eligible to receive financial assistance under the scheme.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: Can artisans use the financial assistance for any purpose?
answer: Yes, artisans are free to use the financial assistance for their livelihood and welfare needs as they deem fit.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: Is there any restriction on the duration for which artisans can receive financial assistance?
answer: As long as the artisan meets the eligibility criteria and submits the required documents annually, they can continue to receive financial assistance.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: How is the financial assistance disbursed to eligible artisans?
answer: Financial assistance is disbursed through PFMS/DBT in the form of a monthly allowance or lump sum grant, depending on the preference of the artisan.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Direct Benefit to Artisans - Supports to Artisans in Indigent Circumstances
question: What is the maximum amount of financial assistance provided to eligible artisans?
answer: Eligible artisans can receive financial assistance of up to ₹8,000/- per month in the form of a monthly allowance or lump sum grant.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: What Is The Full Form Of NHDP?
answer: The Full Form of NHDP is "National Handicrafts Development Programme".

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: What Are The Objectives Of This Scheme?
answer: The basic objective of the component is to provide a marketing platform to the Local Handicrafts Artisans in their respective area through the outlet and emporia.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: At What Locations Shall The EMPORIA Be Set Up?
answer: These would be set up in commercially viable locations in the implementing agencies' own/rented buildings.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: For What Purposes Is The Financial Assistance Provided To The Implementing Agencies?
answer: Under this component, assistance would be provided for the setting up of emporia.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: What Shall Be The Financial Ceiling For Setting Up A New Emporia?
answer: For setting up a New Emporia (Rented/Own building), the Per Unit Cost shall be ₹ 60,00,000.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: What Shall Be The Financial Ceiling For Strengthening / Renovation?
answer: For Strengthening / Renovation, the Per Unit Cost shall be ₹ 15,00,000.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: What Percentage Of The Admissible Amount Shall Be Borne By The O/O The DC (H)?
answer: 80% of the admissible amount shall be borne by the O/o the DC (H)

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: What Percentage Of The Admissible Amount Shall Be Borne By The Implementing Agency?
answer: 20% will be contributed by the implementing agency subject to the ceiling specified.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: What Percent Of The Assistance Shall Be Borne By The Office Of The DC (Handicrafts) For The Strengthening / Renovation Of The Existing Emporia?
answer: 100% assistance will be borne by the Office of the DC (Handicrafts) for the Strengthening / Renovation of the existing Emporia.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: Where Can I Find The Link To The Scheme Guidelines?
answer: The scheme guidelines can be found at this link - http://handicrafts.nic.in/pdf/Scheme.pdf#page=1

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: Where Can I Find The Link To The Proforma For Proposal?
answer: The Proforma For Proposal can be found at this link - http://www.handicrafts.nic.in/cmsUpload/20221026154722Emporia.pdf

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: To Whom Shall The Proposal Be Addressed?
answer: The proposals in the prescribed proforma along with all the (self-attested) supporting documents in hard copy should be addressed to the concerned Handicraft Service Center (HSC), O/o the DC (HC).

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: Are The National Level Apex Societies (Registered Under The Society Act/ Trust Act, Etc.) Also Eligible To Apply?
answer: Yes, the National level Apex Societies (registered under the society act/ trust act, etc.) are also eligible to apply for the role of Implementing Agency.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: EMPORIA
question: Does This Scheme Accept Online Applications?
answer: No, this scheme accepts offline applications.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Is The Full Form Of NHDP?
answer: The Full Form of NHDP is "National Handicrafts Development Programme".

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Are The Objectives Of The "Urban Haat" Component Of The Infrastructure & Technology Support Scheme Of NHDP?
answer: The scheme "Infrastructure & Technology Support: URBAN HAAT" is introduced to set up a permanent marketing infrastructure in towns/ metropolitan cities to provide direct marketing facilities to handicrafts artisans/handloom weavers, enabling them to sell their products to a wider target audience.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Shall Be The Area Of The Haat?
answer: The haat shall be constructed in an area of not less than 8,000 sq. m. and will have a display gallery, food court, etc.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: Will The Allotment Of The Stalls To The Artisans Be Fixed Or Will It Be On A Rotational Basis?
answer: The stalls are allotted to artisans on a rotational basis for a nominal rent.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Is The Full Form Of "SPV"?
answer: The Full Form of "SPV" is "Special Purpose Vehicle".

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Shall Be The Purpose Of The SPVs?
answer: The implementing agencies will be encouraged to form SPVs with the active participation of the various agencies dealing with the promotion of Tourism, Culture, Food, Processing Industry, etc., involving the tour operators, and hotel operators in addition to those dealing with handloom and handicrafts for broad basing and ensure utilization of facilities for a long duration for management and day-to-day running of the same.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Shall Be The Financial Ceiling For The Implementing Agencies?
answer: The financial ceiling for urban haat is ₹ 8,00,00,000 for each unit.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Percentage Of The Financial Assistance Shall Be Borne By The O/O The DC(HC)?
answer: 40% of the admissible amount shall be borne by the O/o the DC(HC) and DC(HL) each.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Percentage Of The Financial Assistance Shall Be Borne By The Implementing Agency?
answer: 20% of the admissible amount will be contributed by the implementing agency.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: In The Case Of Andaman & Nicobar Islands, What Percentage Of The Financial Assistance Shall Be Borne By The O/O The DC(HC)?
answer: In the case of NER, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, and Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep - 45% of the admissible amount will be borne by the O/o the DC (HC) and DC(HL) each. 10% of the admissible amount shall be contributed by the implementing agency.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Shall Be The Amount Of The Financial Assistance For Strengthening/Renovation Of Existing Urban Haats?
answer: Assistance will also be given for strengthening/renovation of existing Urban Haats subject to a maximum financial limit of ₹ 2,50,00,000 (100% assistance will be borne by the Office of the DC (Handicrafts) & DC (Handlooms).

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Shall Be The Amount Of The Financial Assistance For "Mini Urban Haats"?
answer: Assistance will also be given for Mini Urban Haats on need-based and feasibility. The financial assistance will be based on the number of stalls, land area & other deliverables in a proportionate manner.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: How Many Stalls Shall Be Erected By The Implementing Agency?
answer: 50-80 Stalls of 10x8 sq. ft. each shall be erected by the Implementing Agency.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: How Many Toilets Shall Be There In The Haat?
answer: There shall be 2 Toilets each for Ladies and Gents.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Additional Facilities Shall Be There In The Haat?
answer: The following facilities shall be there in the haat: | Dormitory for Craftspersons with provisions for a minimum of 100 people | Food Court | Pavilion/Stage for Cultural Programme | Store Room | Meeting/Conference Room | Souvenir Shop

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: What Shall Be The Benefits For The Buyers/Tourists?
answer: The Food & Craft Bazaar will provide leisure & recreational facilities for domestic as well as international tourists on the lines of Dilli Haat, which has already attained a prominent status amongst domestic & International buyers/ tourists.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: Where Can I Find The Link To The Scheme Guidelines?
answer: The scheme guidelines can be found at this link - http://handicrafts.nic.in/pdf/Scheme.pdf#page=1

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT
question: Where Can I Find The Link To The Proforma For Proposal?
answer: The Proforma For Proposal can be found at this link - http://handicrafts.nic.in/CmsUpload/05182022101854Scan%20invitation%20of%20testing%20laboratories_organized.pdf

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Infrastructure And Technology Support: URBAN HAAT

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: How Will The Selection Of The Artisans Be Done?
answer: Any artisans having a Pahchan card may participate in the seminar/workshop. Beneficiaries must be selected in a fair & transparent manner, through well-defined objective parameters /criteria, by way of giving equal opportunity to all artisans, under the supervision of the concerned AD(Handicrafts).

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: Is There Any Reservation/Preference/Priority In The Selection Of The Artisans?
answer: Yes, preference may be given to the marginalized social groups i.e., SC/ST/Women/Differently enabled persons shall also be incorporated under the schemes irrespective of the crafts they practice to ensure their recognition, equality, and empowerment.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: Where Shall The Details Of The Beneficiaries Be Uploaded?
answer: The details of the beneficiaries shall be uploaded on the portal / MIS of the O/o DC (Handicrafts).

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: How Will The Selection Of Project Leader / SRF/ JRF And Resource Persons Be Done?
answer: For conducting Studies/Surveys, eligible candidates will be engaged by the Implementing agency/Institution, upon submission of their detailed profile/resume to the O/o DC (Handicrafts). For seminars/workshops, the Implementing agency/Institution may engage eminent personalities in the respective fields or engage their own faculty/resource persons, with the prior approval of the O/o Development Commissioner (Handicrafts). In either case, the person to be engaged should have adequate proven knowledge in the field of handicrafts and experience in conducting research activities.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: How Will The Inspection And Monitoring Of This Scheme Be Performed?
answer: The AD(H) / Officials of the field office will visit during the implementation of the program and will send the updated report along with 5 photographs directly to the HQ office, New Delhi as per the prescribed proforma under intimation to respective Field Offices. The Inspection shall be carried out by respective Asstt. Director (Handicrafts), HSCs during the project period to assess the progress of the activity sanctioned and suggest suitable corrective action, if required on the subject, and specific comments shall be forwarded to Hd. Qr. Office, New Delhi for settlement of reimbursement cases.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: What Shall Be The Mode Of Payment To Beneficiaries?
answer: The payments to all beneficiaries/concerned must be made through PFMS only.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: What Is The Purpose Of The NHDP: Research & Development Scheme?
answer: The "NHDP: Research & Development Scheme" is introduced to generate feedback on economic, social, aesthetic, and promotional aspects of various crafts and artisans in the handicraft sector. The surveys and studies are sponsored/conducted to generate suitable inputs for planning purposes.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: What Is The Full Form Of NHDP?
answer: The full form of NHDP is "National Handicrafts Development Programme".

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: What Is The Maximum Permissible Amount For Senior Research Expert Under Financial Assistance For Conducting Studies/Surveys?
answer: The Maximum Permissible Amount for Senior Research Experts shall be (in ₹ per month): 35,000/-.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: How Many Senior Research Experts Shall Be Required For Conducting Studies/Surveys?
answer: Two Senior Research Experts shall be required for Conducting Studies/Surveys.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
question: How Many Investigator [Graduate] Shall Be Required For Conducting Studies/Surveys?
answer: Three Investigators [Graduate] shall be required for Conducting Studies/Surveys.

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme

answer: The link to the Scheme Guidelines can be found at: http://handicrafts.nic.in/pdf/Scheme.pdf#page=1

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme

scheme_name: National Handicrafts Development Programme: Research & Development Scheme
