scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Fund For Sportspersons
question: Can retired sportsperson who fulfill the eligibility criteria apply for this scheme?
answer: Yes, retired sportsperson can also apply in this scheme.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Fund For Sportspersons
question: I have only represented India at national level competitions but never at international levels. Can I also apply in this scheme?
answer: Yes, sportsperson who have represented India at national level can apply in this scheme.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Fund For Sportspersons
question: Can I apply online for this scheme?
answer: As of now, only offline mode of application is accepted.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Fund For Sportspersons
question: What is the deadline for submission of the application?
answer: Applications are open throughout the year.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Fund For Sportspersons
question: Am I required to provide my Aadhaar details on the application?
answer: Yes, Aadhaar is a mandatory document.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Fund For Sportspersons
question: How do I know if a field in the application form is mandatory?
answer: The mandatory fields have a red asterisk (*) mark at the end.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: Who can apply for this award?
answer: Indian citizens and organizations/institutions registered in India can apply.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: What is the cash prize under this award?
answer: Each awardee receives ₹2,00,000 along with a plaque and citation.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: How many awards are given each year?
answer: A maximum of 5 awards are given annually, subject to suitable candidates.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: What sectors are covered under this award?
answer: Telecom innovations, skilling, services, manufacturing, and sectoral applications are covered.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: What is the eligible period of contribution?
answer: Contributions made during the last 3 years are considered.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: Is there any age limit for applicants?
answer: No, there is no age limit for applying.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: Can government employees apply for this award?
answer: They are eligible only if the work is not part of their regular official duties or after retirement.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: How can applications be submitted?
answer: Applications must be submitted online through the National Awards Portal.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: Is self-nomination allowed?
answer: Yes, individuals and organizations can nominate themselves.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: What additional benefits are provided apart from cash prize?
answer: Travel reimbursement and ₹7,500 for incidental expenses are provided.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: Can the award be given posthumously?
answer: It is generally not given posthumously except in rare and exceptional cases.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: Who selects the awardees?
answer: The Award Committee selects the awardees based on recommendations.

scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Telecom Excellence Award
question: Can the award title be used as a prefix or suffix?
answer: No, the award cannot be used as a title, and misuse may lead to forfeiture.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: What is the PECFAR?
answer: PECFAR is a fellowship to facilitate a two-way exchange of young early-career Indian and German researchers through short visits for networking and exploring avenues for collaboration and innovation in applied research.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Who are eligible?
answer: Early Career Researchers holding regular positions in academia/research institutions/industry or holding long-term nationally recognized fellowship (4 years and above). | Minimum Qualification: Masterin Science/Bachelor degree in Engineering (4 years). | PhD Students/Post-docs affiliated with research institutions/industries may also apply.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Is it mandatory to form a Pair to apply for the fellowship?
answer: Yes.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: What is meant by long term fellowship eligible to avail the PECFAR fellowship?
answer: 4 years and above.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: I am an Indian working at a German academic/research institute. Can I apply for this fellowship?
answer: Not preferred in case you underwent education in India.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Can I submit separate/multiple applications?
answer: No.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Will IGSTC provide any assistance in forming the Pair?
answer: No. Applicants are solely responsible for identifying & forming their respective pairs and acquiring acceptance letters from institutes/organizations of the paired fellows.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Is it mandatory for both fellows in pairto visit their respective paired institute/organisation?
answer: Yes. It is mandatory for both the fellows in the pair to visit their respective paired institution/organisation. The duration of fellowship visit is up to 2 months with mandatory minimum stay of 3 weeks.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Can the fellows in pair travel to India/Germany at different times?
answer: The two fellows can choose to travel to India/Germany at different times but within a time gap of 9 months. They should by all means not travel at the same time.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: What is the age limit for applying?
answer: 35 years.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: What is the nature of the support under this scheme?
answer: Fellowship: EUR2300 per fellow/month on pro rata basis. | Single round trip economy class airfare including visa fees and medical/travel insurances up to ₹ 1 lakh (for Indian fellow) and EUR 1500 (for German fellow).

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: What do you mean by parent organization and mentor at parent organizations?
answer: The parent organization is the organization in which the fellow is working currently. Mentor will be his/her supervisor/ Head of the organization.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: How much time does the evaluation take?
answer: IGSTC will complete the evaluation process within 8 weeks approximately after the deadline.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Can the fellowship be extended?
answer: No.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Can anyone apply for this fellowship while holding another one?
answer: Yes, provided the other fellowship doesn't come with any restrictions.

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Will IGSTC provide any assistance in the booking of air tickets, visa appointments and accommodation?
answer: No

scheme_name: Paired Early Career Fellowship in Applied Research
question: Are there any rules/restrictions in Air ticket booking?
answer: The Awardees shall book single round economy class shortest route air tickets within the sanctioned grant. IGSTC will not reimburse the cost of cancellation and re-routing. There is no restriction on the air carrier or travel agents for booking air tickets.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: The National Green Tribunal (NCT) Comes Under Which Ministry?
answer: The National Green Tribunal (NCT) comes under the Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law & Justice of the Govt. of India.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: How Many Times In A Year Does The Applications Open For This Internship?
answer: The National Green Tribunal provides opportunities to college students by holding Summer Internship Programs (March, April, May and July ordinarily) and Winter Internship Programs (November, December and January ordinarily). Hence, the applications for this internship open twice a year.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: What Shall Be The Duration Of The Internship Programme?
answer: The duration of the Internship will be 4 Weeks ordinarily. The duration and timing of the internship may be altered by the Competent Authority as and when necessary.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: Can Students Pursuing Mehcanical Engineering Also Apply To This Internship?
answer: No, the applicant should be a student pursuing three-year and five-year law degree courses in environmental studies/law from any recognized College/Law School/University in India.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: How Much Remuneration Is Paid To The Interns By The NCT?
answer: The National Green Tribunal pays no remuneration/expenses to the Interns.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: Where Can I Find The URL To The Scheme Guidelines?
answer: The URL to the Scheme Guidelines can be found at this link - https://greentribunal.gov.in/sites/default/files/all_documents/CCF05072017_0001.pdf

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: When Shall The Certificate Of Internship Be Provided To The Interns?
answer: A certificate will be issued to the Intern at the end of her/his internship after evaluation of the research paper or assessment of the work done.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: To Whom Should The Application Be Addressed?
answer: The applications should be addressed to the Office of the Registrar General, National Green Tribunal (Principal Bench), Faridkot House, Copernicus Marg, New Delhi- 110001.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: What Is The Email ID Of The Registrar General, National Green Tribunal (Principal Bench)?
answer: The Email ID of the Registrar General, National Green Tribunal (Principal Bench) is: rg.ngt@nic.in.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: What Is The Last Date For The Submission Of The Applications?
answer: Interested candidates may send their applications in the enclosed format, by 1st February (in case of the Summer Internship Programme) and by 1st October (in case of the Winter Internship Programme).

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: What Is The Address Of The National Green Tribunal (Principal Bench)?
answer: The address of the National Green Tribunal (Principal Bench) is: Faridkot House, Copernicus Marg, New Delhi- 110001.

scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
question: What Is The Protocol For The Applications That Are Received After The Last Date?
answer: Applications received after the last date may not be considered and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
question: Whether The Candidate Has To Select "Scholarship" Or "Incentive" In The Type Of Scholarship For Applying Under The Scheme?
answer: The candidate has to opt for an "incentive" to be able to apply under the scheme.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
question: Whether A Girl Child With A Brother In The Family Is Eligible To Be Considered Under The Scheme For Award Of Scholarship?
answer: No, only single girl children are eligible to apply under the scheme. However, twin/ fraternal daughters are eligible to apply under this scheme.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
question: Whether A Candidate Who Was Within 30 Years Of Age During Admission To PG Course But Has Crossed This Limit At The Time Of Application Be Eligible To Be Considered?
answer: Yes. The candidate applying under the scheme can apply if she is below 30 years of age as on the last date of application too.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
question: Can A Single Girl Child Pursuing Post Graduation Through Distance Mode Apply Under The Scheme?
answer: No.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
question: After Selection, Is The Awardee Entitled For Hostel Fee Reimbursement/ HRA Or Medical Expenses?
answer: No. The awardee is only entitled for scholarship amount. No HRA/contingency/hostel fee or medical expenses are admissible.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
question: Are The Awardees Eligible For Waiver Of Tuition Fee Or Its Reimbursement?
answer: No. Tuition fee reimbursement is not permitted. However, it is expected from the institutions where student has taken admission in the first year PG course, no tuition fees will be charged by the institute from girl students to pursue PG degree course in Universities/Colleges/Institutions.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
question: Can Students Of Second Year Post Graduation Apply Under The Scheme?
answer: No. The candidates who are pursuing first year postgraduate courses only can apply under the scheme.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
question: Can The Awardee Avail Of Any Other Scholarship Scheme During The Tenure Of This Award?
answer: Yes. This scheme can be availed with any other scholarship scheme as this is an incentive.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
question: What Are The Objectives Of This Scheme?
answer: A) to promote and nurture talent. | b) to reward meritorious students with outstanding performance at the Undergraduate level for pursuing postgraduate studies. | c) to Promote study in basic subjects both General as well as Honours at the undergraduate level. Professional courses are not covered under the scheme. | d) to build up academic excellence at the postgraduate level across the colleges and universities in the country.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
question: What Will Be The Tenure Of The Scholarship?
answer: The scholarship may be tenable for a period of two years to enable the rank holders of each university at the undergraduate level to pursue their Master's Degree.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
question: Is This Scheme Only Apply To Those Pursuing Post-Graduate Programs?
answer: Yes, the awardees, under this scheme, can pursue their Postgraduate program in any area of specialization in any institution of higher learning in the country.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
question: What Is The Amount Of Financial Assistance Provided In This Scheme?
answer: Each awardee, under the scheme, will be provided a scholarship of ₹ 2,000/- p.m. for a period of two years (i.e. 10 months in a year). The second-year grant will be released after receiving the Utilization Certificate and statement of expenditure along with the progress report of the first year.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
question: Is This Scholarship Subject To Securing A Minimum Of Marks At The Undergraduate Level?
answer: Yes, the scholarship would be subjected to securing a minimum of 60% marks at the undergraduate level.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
question: Is This Scheme Also Applicable To Students Who Have Taken Admitted To Part-Time Master's Degree Courses?
answer: No, the scheme is applicable to such students who have taken admitted to a regular, full-time Master's Degree course in any recognized university or a postgraduate college.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
question: Is The Scholarship Available To The Student For The Second PG Degree?
answer: No, the scholarship is available to the student for the first PG Degree only.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
question: Is There An Age Criterion For This Scheme?
answer: Yes, the age limit for the students is 30 years at the time of admission to the PG course.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
question: Is Distance Mode Of Education Covered Under This Scheme?
answer: No, the distance mode of education is not covered under the scheme.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: What is the objective of PG scholarship scheme?
answer: The objective of the scheme is to help and attract young and talented graduate students to pursue education at the Post Graduate Level in Higher Education Institutions.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: Which is the implementing agency of this scheme?
answer: University Grants Commission, Government of India

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: How much amount of scholarship is paid under scheme?
answer: The Scholarship under the scheme is ₹12,400/- per month per student.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: How much amount of contingency is paid under scheme?
answer: An annual contingency of ₹5,000/- will be given to the eligible student.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: What are the eligibility conditions for availing scholarship under the scheme?
answer: The GATE/GPAT qualified students who have taken admission in M.E/M.Tech/M.Pharm courses and integrated dual degree programme in Central, State, Deemed, and Private Universities will be provided scholarships by UGC.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: Can foreign students be eligible for GATE/GPAT scholarship?
answer: No, foreign student are not eligible for GATE/GPAT scholarship.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: Is there any compulsion for teaching activities?
answer: It will be obligatory on the part of every post graduate student to undertake 8 to 10 hours (per week) of work related to teaching and research activities as assigned to him/her by the institute. This includes tutorials, laboratory classes, development and maintenance of laboratories, assistance in research and activities undertaken by faculty members, maintenance and operation of computer and other central facilities, assistance in library, etc.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: Is there any condition for payment of scholarship?
answer: If a student scores below 60% in any semester he/she shall be paid a scholarship @ ₹1,550/- in that particular semester, if the student re-appear for the same semester and scores above 60 %, he will be entitled to get regular scholarship i.e. @ ₹12,400/- p.m. for that semester in which student reappeared. But thereafter after he is eligible for the full scholarship amount, in the next semesters.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: Is there any house rent admissible to the students?
answer: No house rent is admissible to M.E./M.Tech./M.Pharm students.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: Can the scholar take any paid assignment during the tenure of the scholarship?
answer: No. the scholar shall not undertake any paid assignment (emoluments/salary/stipend) during the tenure of the scholarship.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: Shall the scholarship be terminated immediately if the scholar has failed in any semester?
answer: Yes, the scholarship shall be terminated immediately if the scholar has failed in any semester.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: What is the procedure for applying for the Scheme by the universities?
answer: After taking admission by the GATE/GPAT Qualified student, the University needs to submit the online claim for the first semester on the UGC online portal available at www.ugc.ac.in in the prescribed proforma and also upload the undertaking and GATE/GPAT Score Card of the M.E/M.Tech/M.Pharm within the approved intake by AICTE/UGC in the batch in a year early mentioning the category of student i.e. General, SC & ST.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm-UGC
question: How the UGC Scholarship is being disbursed?
answer: The UGC Scholarship is being disbursed through CANARABANK UGC Portal (https://scholarship.canarabank.in/scholar/Login.aspx).

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What is the objective of PG scholarship scheme and how much amount is paid under scheme?
answer: AICTE in order to ensure the development of technical education in India awards Post Graduate Scholarship of ₹12,400/- per month to full-time GATE/CEED qualified students admitted to AICTE approved post-graduate programs in AICTE approved Institutions/ University Departments as per AICTE approved intake. | The Scholarship under the scheme is ₹ 12,400/- per month per student.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What is the duration of the scholarship period?
answer: The Scholarship is tenable for 24 months or for the duration of the course i.e. from the date of commencement of classes till the date of completion of the classes whichever is lower and is not extendable under any circumstances. | Students of final years of dual degree integrated programmes would also be entitled to PG Scholarship from the 9th semester onwards i.e. only for one year in final year.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What are the eligibility condition for availing scholarship under the scheme?
answer: Post Graduate Scholarship is entitled only to those students: | i) Having a valid GATE/CEED score at the time of admission. | ii) Must be admitted as a full-time scholar. | iii) Students of final years of dual degree integrated programmes would also be entitled to PG Scholarship from the 9th semester i.e only for one year in final year. | iv) Admitted in AICTE approved Institutions/ University Departments & AICTE approved programs viz. Master of Engineering, Master of Technology, Master of Design and Master of Architecture. | v) Number of PG Scholarship is limited to the AICTE approved intake in the programme in that year.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Is there any reservation for EWS?
answer: In addition to the approved intake, AICTE will provide PG scholarship to the additional 10% candidates over and above the approved intake of that course from EWS category, if the university/ institute has admitted students from Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs) as per MHRD OM F.No.12-4/2019-U1 dated 17th January 2019.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What are the various types of leave entitlement during the scholarship period?
answer: Students are eligible for following leaves: | i) Casual leave: 15 days in an academic year | ii) Medical leave: Maximum of one month (30 days) in an academic year | iii) Maternity leave : Candidates are eligible for maternity/ Paternity leave as per Govt. of India norms issued from time to time at full rates of scholarship etc. once during the tenure of their award. However maximum duration of scholarship will not be extended in any circumstances. | Note: All kinds of leave should be approved at the level of the University/College/Institute. Prior approval of the University/Institution/ College is mandatory for all types of leaves.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What are the restriction for availing financial assistance from other sources?
answer: In case any student/scholar receives any financial assistance from any other organization during the tenure of course, with due permission of the university/institute, the scholar will not be entitled for the scholarship for the duration in which he/ she is availing such financial assistance and it shall be resumed on discontinuance of such external financial assistance. Further the period for which the scholar has received external financial assistance shall be deducted from the maximum duration of the scholarship.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Whether a candidate admitted in PG programs through management quota is eligible for the Scholarship?
answer: Foreign students, sponsored candidates and candidates admitted in PG programs through management quota are not eligible for the Scholarship.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Is there any compulsion for teaching activities?
answer: It will be obligatory for every post-graduate student to undertake 8 to 10 hours (per week) of work related to teaching and research activities as assigned to him/ her by the Institute. This could include tutorials, laboratory classes, development and maintenance of laboratories, assistance in research and development activities undertaken by faculty members, maintenance and operation of Computers and other central facilities, assistance in library, etc.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Is there any condition for payment of scholarship?
answer: The Scholarship will be granted to the student on a monthly basis subject to the satisfactory academic performance and adherence to University/ Institute norms/rules and regulations as applicable from time to time, certified by the Head of the Institute and obligatory work as prescribed.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What are the conditions for undergoing PG course for the 2nd time?
answer: PG Scholarship is not admissible to passed out students taking 2nd time admission on | the basis of re-qualifying GATE/CEED exam who have already availed the scholarship | from AICTE or any other centrally funded institution like - IITs & NITs etc.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Who can change the amount of PG Scholarship?
answer: The amount of the PG Scholarship is subject to change as per the notification issued by Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), New Delhi (now Ministry of Education) from time to time, with the approval of the Executive Committee of the Council.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What action shall be taken against the students who leave the course in midway?
answer: The student shall be required to give an undertaking to the effect that he/she would not | leave the course midway.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What action for release of scholarship shall be taken in the event of involving in the act of ragging, misbehavior etc.?
answer: The Scholarship may be discontinued at any time for any kind of misconduct by the | student, like involving in the act of ragging, misbehavior etc. on the recommendations | of the Head of Institution (HOI).

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Is there any provision of salary grant, contingencies ?
answer: Salary grant or any other grant e.g. Contingencies, Library, Books etc, will not be admissible to the Institute/College/ University implementing this scheme in compliance with the instructions of Govt. of India, Ministry of Human Resource Development, Deptt. of Higher Education, Technical Section - I conveyed vide letter No. F. No. 9-2/2007-TS.I dated 22nd July, 2008

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What is the mode and procedure of payment of Scholarship?
answer: Generally mode and procedure of payment of Scholarships to the students shall be governed by the policy decision of the AICTE as may be notified from time to time on its web portal or through advertisement in leading English/Hindi newspapers. Presently mode of payment of scholarships is DBT.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What is the procedure for belated claim?
answer: Any belated claim preferred after one year of the completion of the program shall not be entertained.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Can AICTE impose any other conditions?
answer: The AICTE may impose any other conditions as deemed necessary from time to time and | the decision of the AICTE shall be final and binding upon the recipients i.e. | University/Institute/College/Student who are under the ambit of the AICTE for receipt | of PG Scholarship.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What will be the action, in case any student avails the break during the scholarship period?
answer: In case any student/scholar avails the break during the scholarship period on medical ground with due permission of the university/institute, the scholarship will be discontinued from the month of such break and shall be resumed on rejoining the program for the remaining period of the scholarship.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What is the method for payment of PG Scholarship?
answer: PG scholarship is released through PFMS on Aadhar Bridge Payment System (ABPS). The | requirements of bank details etc. are discarded with as details of Aadhar suffice the | requirement for release of scholarship on ABPS through PFMS.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Whether Aadhar number is mandatory for receiving PG scholarship?
answer: An Aadhaar number is mandatory for applying for PG scholarship. Applications will not be accepted without the Aadhaar number of the candidate.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Is there any other mandatory requirement for payment of Scholarship through Aadhar?
answer: The scholarship is credited in Aadhar "ACTIVE" bank account only

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: How to check the Aadhar Active status of bank account?
answer: Student can check Aadhaar Active status of the bank account by following the under mentioned manual link: | https://www.aicte-india.org/sites/default/files/stdc/Manual%20for%0Bank%20account%20linkage%20with%20Aadhaar.PDF

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: What are the reasons for failure to generate bank beneficiary code and remedy thereof ?
answer: The bank beneficiary code are not generated through PFMS mainly due to either of the | following shortcomings:- | - Aadhaar is not in NPCI database | - Aadhar status -Inactive | In that case the student needs to visit Aadhaar Enrollment center/Bank for updating any leftover information like personal details, contact details (mobile no) or any other information.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: When the scholarship is expected after the bank accounts is made ACTIVE?
answer: On receipt of Aadhar active bank account details, a bank beneficiary code is generated in the next 15 days. | On successful generation bank beneficiary code before 20th of a particular month, the scholarship shall be released at the end of that month. Otherwise at the end of next month

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Is there any last date for forwarding monthly attendance?
answer: Attendance/ list of absentees are to be marked/ forwarded positively till 15th for disbursement by 30th of every month.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
question: Whom to contact in case of any difficulties in accessing the portal for submitting online application?
answer: One can avail Helpdesk Service on the following contact: | - For Non-Technical queries: | E-mail ID:- pgscholarship@aicte-india.org | Phone number: 011-29581119 | - For Technical queries: | E-mail ID:- helpdesk1@aicte-india.org | Phone Number: 011-29581333 | Note: Students/Institutions can make call (from 9.30 am to.5 pm) from Monday to | Friday.

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
question: What are the core benefits of the PKVY scheme?
answer: PKVY targets the following benefits: | Promotion of organic farming, in turn resulting in improvement of soil health | Sustainable production of chemical free and nutritious agriculture produce | Direct linkages with local and national markets | To empower farmers through their own institutional development in the form of clusters and groups with capacity to manage production, processing value addition and certification management

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
question: Are benefits directly transferred to the farmers?
answer: No, the Benefits are transferred through regional councils of the state.

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
question: Does this scheme work upon creating a bigger market for the farmers?
answer: Yes, this scheme works to make farmers entrepreneurs through direct market linkages with local and national markets

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
question: Are their any particular eligibility criterias?
answer: No, anyone can apply for this scheme

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
question: Can I directly apply for the scheme as an individual on the portal?
answer: No, the regional council of states will compile all the armers and project details, which will be taken further and the benefits will also be disbursed by the regional council of states only

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
question: If an applicant is considering applying for the incentive program based on their Global Manufacturing Revenue, what is the specific revenue threshold required to be categorized under Group A?
answer: Applicants must have a Global Manufacturing Revenue of pharmaceutical goods or in-vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices of ₹50,00,00,00,000/- or more in the Financial Year 2019-20 to qualify for this category.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
question: Which specific financial year serves as the reference point for calculating the incremental sales of eligible products and determining the pre-qualification eligibility criteria for applicants?
answer: The Financial Year 2019-20 is designated as the base year for the computation of incremental sales as well as for establishing the pre-qualification criteria for all applicants.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
question: Can the capital expenditure incurred by the company towards the acquisition of land for setting up the manufacturing unit be considered as part of the eligible investment?
answer: No, any investment made towards the acquisition of land required for the project or unit is explicitly excluded from the calculation of eligible investment under this initiative.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
question: What is the mandatory sales growth percentage that applicants must strictly achieve in subsequent years to ensure they continue receiving the financial incentives?
answer: For the Financial Year 2023-24 and onwards, the applicant is required to achieve a growth of 7% in sales over the sales of the previous financial year to claim incentives.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
question: What is the specific timeline for submitting the required bank guarantee after an applicant receives the official approval letter from the Project Management Agency?
answer: The selected applicant is required to submit the bank guarantee of the prescribed amount along with an undertaking within two weeks from the date of issuance of the approval letter.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
question: What is the objective of the scheme?
answer: The scheme aims to boost domestic manufacturing and attract large investments in the IT hardware value chain.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
question: Which ministry has launched this scheme?
answer: The scheme has been launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
question: What products are covered under the scheme?
answer: The scheme covers laptops, tablets, all-in-one PCs, and servers.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
question: What type of benefit is provided under the scheme?
answer: The scheme provides a production-linked incentive on net incremental sales of eligible goods manufactured in India.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
question: What is the incentive rate under the scheme?
answer: An incentive of 4% to 2% / 1% is provided on net incremental sales over the base year.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
question: What is the duration of the scheme?
answer: The incentive is provided for a period of 4 years.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
question: Who can apply under the scheme?
answer: Companies registered in India and engaged in manufacturing eligible IT hardware products can apply, subject to meeting scheme criteria.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
question: How is the scheme implemented?
answer: The scheme is implemented through a Nodal Agency acting as a Project Management Agency (PMA).

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
question: On what basis is the incentive provided?
answer: The incentive is provided based on net incremental sales of eligible products over the base year.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
question: What products are covered under the "Target Segment" of this scheme?
answer: The target segment includes Laptops, Tablets, All-in-One Personal Computers (PCs), Servers, and Ultra Small Form Factor (USSF) devices. To be eligible, these must be manufactured in India and be complete in all respects for sale to consumers.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
question: Who is considered an "Applicant" under the scheme?
answer: An applicant is a company registered in India that proposes to manufacture goods covered under the target segment and submits an application for approval. Manufacturing can occur at new or existing facilities across one or more locations in India.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
question: What are the different categories of companies that can apply?
answer: There are three categories: | - Global Company: Non-domestic companies with high global manufacturing revenue.- Domestic Company: Companies owned by resident Indian citizens (more than 50% capital).- Hybrid (Global/Domestic) Company: A category where both global and domestic companies can apply based on specific revenue thresholds

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
question: What types of investments are eligible for determining threshold criteria?
answer: Eligible investments include expenditure on Plant, Machinery, Equipment, and Associated Utilities (including tools, dies, moulds, etc.), Research and Development (R&D), and Transfer of Technology (ToT) agreements. Expenditure on land and buildings is explicitly excluded.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
question: Are there mandatory localization requirements?
answer: Yes. Applicants are required to localise at least Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) and the assembly of the finished goods starting from the first year. In each subsequent year, at least one additional component or sub-assembly must be localised.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
question: How is the incentive calculated if there is an investment shortfall?
answer: If the cumulative investment shortfall is 40% or less of the required threshold, the applicant remains eligible. However, the incentive for that year will be reduced by half of the percentage of the shortfall (e.g., a 30% shortfall results in a 15% incentive deduction).

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
question: Can an applicant claim incentives for products manufactured through a contract manufacturer?
answer: Yes, incentives can be claimed on sales of goods manufactured through a contract manufacturer, provided the arrangement is exclusive for the PLI applicant and the contract manufacturer has not claimed incentives for the same goods under any other PLI scheme.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
question: What happens if an applicant's actual incentive claim is much lower than their projection?
answer: To ensure realistic targets, penalties apply: a 5% deduction if the shortfall is between 25% and 50% of the projection, and a 10% deduction if the shortfall exceeds 50% of the projection. No penalty applies if no incentive is payable for that year.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
question: Is there a limit on the total incentive an applicant can receive?
answer: Yes, there is an overall ceiling on the total incentive payable to any applicant during the scheme's tenure. This ceiling includes incentives gained from over-performance and any incentives received under the previous PLI Scheme 1.0 for IT Hardware.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Who is an applicant under the scheme?
answer: An applicant under the scheme is a | i. Company incorporated/ registered in India under the Companies Act, 2013, engaged in the automotive and/or auto component manufacturing sector or | ii. New Non-Automotive Investor company (who is currently not in an automobile or auto component manufacturing business) incorporated/ registered in India under the Companies Act, 2013 meeting the eligibility criteria specified under the scheme and making an application for seeking approval under the Scheme.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: What are the circumstances under which an applicant may be ineligible for the scheme?
answer: The applicants whose accounts are declared as Non-Performing Asset | (NPA) as per RBI guidelines or defaulter or wilful defaulter as per RBI/CIBIL | or SEBI debarred list or reported as fraud by any bank, financial institution | or non-banking financial companies etc. would be considered ineligible. | Further, there should not be any insolvency proceedings admitted against | the Applicant in the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) etc.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Can an applicant have multiple manufacturing facilities?
answer: An applicant can have multiple manufacturing facilities/ locations in India.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Are Greenfield projects and Brownfield projects both allowed under the scheme?
answer: Yes, Greenfield projects and Brownfield projects both are allowed under the | scheme.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Whether a Proprietorship, Partnership and Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) could avail PLI benefits?
answer: No, Proprietorship, Partnership, and LLPs are not allowed under the scheme. Any company incorporated in India and as defined in the Companies Act 2 of 16 2013, proposing to manufacture one or more eligible product(s) under the scheme, can be an applicant.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Can a 100% foreign-owned company be eligible under PLI Scheme?
answer: Yes, but it has to be registered in India to apply under the scheme.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Do the Value-Added Resellers and Trading companies which are not in manufacturing business qualify under the scheme?
answer: Yes, any Company registered in India under the Companies Act can apply under the scheme subject to meeting the eligibility criteria and establishing a manufacturing facility for production of the eligible products under the scheme.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Can two or more companies of the Group apply through a single common Application?
answer: Any number of companies of the Group is permitted to apply under this scheme as an individual applicants by submitting separate applications. However, they can use the global group revenue, gross block, and net worth of the Group in their separate applications respectively.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: How many components are there in this scheme?
answer: There are two components in the scheme i. Champion OEM incentive scheme ii. Component Champion incentive scheme

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Can a company submit Multiple Applications as Applicant under different Categories?
answer: An applicant eligible for applying under Champion OEM can also apply for the Component Champion segment. However, an auto component manufacturer as an applicant eligible for applying under the Component Champion segment cannot apply under Champion OEM.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Can an applicant approved under both Champion OEM and Component Champion segment claim incentive for the same component under both segments?
answer: An approved legal entity as an Automotive OEM company or New NonAutomotive Investor company can avail incentives under both components of the scheme subject to the condition that any eligible product shall be incentivized only once under the scheme. Any double claim of incentive for the same product under component level and vehicle level can lead to the qualification of the legal entity involved on this ground alone in addition to any other legal action as applicable under the law.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: In case the outlay of incentive exceeds, will the budgetary outlay be enhanced?
answer: This is a fund-limited scheme. In case the calculated incentive pay-out exceeds the budgetary outlay, the scheme could be exhausted earlier than 5 (Five) years period and the incentive pay-out will be reduced on a pro-rata basis as per the formulation developed across all PLIs.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Is there any segregation in the budgetary outlay based on vehicle segments like 2W, 3W, 4W, CV, Tractors and Vehicles used for military purpose etc.?
answer: No. There is only one allocation in the scheme.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Is there any segregation in the budgetary outlay for vehicles and Auto components in the scheme?
answer: No. There is only one allocation in the scheme.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: What is the period for making an application under the Scheme?
answer: The window for receiving applications through the online portal of the scheme shall be 60 days starting from the date of Notice Inviting Applications.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: What is the base year for calculation of eligible sale value?
answer: Financial Year 2019-20 shall be treated as the base year for calculating eligible sale value (not applicable for approved new non-automotive investor companies).

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Can any applicant company claim incentive for any Automobile or Auto component manufactured by them?
answer: No. The applicant company once selected and approved under the scheme can claim an incentive on the Determined sales value of eligible Advanced Automotive Technology products prescribed by MHI.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: Can any approved company claim scheme incentive for all Advanced Automotive Technology (AAT) products manufactured by them?
answer: Any approved company can claim incentive under the scheme for only those Advanced Automotive Technology products meeting the condition of minimum 50% domestic value addition.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
question: When can an applicant submit a claim for disbursements under PLI?
answer: An applicant may submit a claim for disbursement of incentive within 6 (six) months from the end of the financial year to which the claim pertains or within 3 (three) months from the date of finalization of Audited Financial Statements for the same financial year, whichever is later. Claim for any financial year period shall be made only once, unless withdrawn, and no subsequent part claims shall be allowed for the said period.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: What financial benefit does the PLI Scheme for White Goods provide
answer: It offers 4%-6% incentive on net incremental sales of eligible products over the base year for 5 years.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: How does the scheme support domestic manufacturing?
answer: It encourages investment in new manufacturing facilities for AC and LED components, boosting localization and reducing imports.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: Can companies benefit from economies of scale?
answer: Yes. Up to 40% of incremental sales of eligible products may be to sectors outside AC/LED, enabling economies of scale.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: Does the scheme support component-level expansion?
answer: Yes. Companies can invest in multiple eligible components within a target segment; backward integration investments are also eligible.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: Is captive consumption eligible for incentive?
answer: Yes. Captive consumption counts as net sales turnover if at least 60% goes into AC/LED manufacturing.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: When are incentives disbursed?
answer: Incentives are disbursed the year after meeting both investment and sales thresholds, provided that the requisite conditions are met

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: Who can apply under the PLI White Goods Scheme?
answer: Only companies incorporated in India under the Companies Act (2013 or 1956). LLPs cannot apply.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: What are the pre-qualification financial criteria?
answer: Minimum Gross Block, Global Revenue, and Net Worth thresholds must be met for each target segment.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: Is an applicant allowed if it benefits from another PLI scheme for the same products?
answer: No. Double benefits for the same product across PLI schemes are not allowed

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: Where is the application submitted?
answer: Applications must be submitted online via the PLI-WG portal.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: What is the application window?
answer: The scheme opens applications for specified windows; initial was 15 June-15 Sept 2021 with possible later rounds.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights)
question: What is the application fee and payment mode?
answer: Rs 1,00,000 to be paid online

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: What is the main objective of PM-DAKSH Yojana?
answer: The main objective of the PM-DAKSH Yojana is to increase the skill levels of the target youth by providing them short term and long term skills, followed by assistance in wage/self-employment. Besides above, the skill levels of artisans would be enhanced through Upskilling/Reskilling programmes and enable them to increase their incomes within their practicing vocations.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: Who is eligible for the PM-DAKSH Yojana?
answer: Eligibility for the PM-DAKSH Yojana includes Indian citizens aged 18-45 years from SC, OBC, EWS, DNT, Safai Mitras, or Waste Pickers groups. OBC and EWS candidates must have a family income below Rs. 3 lakh, while there is no income limit for SC, DNT, or Safai Mitras/Waste Pickers.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: Who is the appropriate authority to issue Occupation Certificate for a Safai Karamachari or their dependants?
answer: Local Revenue Officer/Local Municipal Officer/Cantonment Executive Officer/ Railway Officer, Head of the Govt. Departments (i.e. Schools, Colleges, Forest, Health, Education, Animal Husbandry) having rank not less than Gazetted Officer, Elected Members of Municipal Body, Pradhan of Gram Panchayats and Regional Managers of Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)/Public Sector Banks (PSBs).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: What is the age criterion for Skill Development Training Programmes under PM-DAKSH Yojana?
answer: Persons between the ages of 18-45 years are eligible for undergoing skill development training programs under PM-DAKSH Yojana.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: What types of Skill Development Training Programmes are available under PM-DAKSH Yojana?
answer: There are following types of skill development training programmes under PM-DAKSH Yojana; (i) Up-skilling/Re-skilling, (ii) Short Term Training Programmes, (iii) Entrepreneurship Development Programmes.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: Whether a person can take training more than one time?
answer: No. A person is eligible to undergo training under skill development training programme only once.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: Whether a person can participate in More than one Skill Training Programmes simultaneously?
answer: No. A person is allowed to participate only in one skill development training program.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: How long is the training period?
answer: The duration of the training varies; upskilling programs are approximately 35 hours, while short-term courses can be up to 1200 hours.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: How can one register for the PM-DAKSH Yojana?
answer: Eligible individuals must register on the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) for the PM-DAKSH Yojana.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: What is the minimum attendance required to be eligible for assessments?
answer: Candidates must have at least 70% attendance to be eligible to appear in the assessments.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: Is there a provision for re-assessment?
answer: Yes, every candidate will be offered one chance for re-assessment.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
question: Is there any cost for the re-assessment?
answer: No, the re-assessment is free of cost.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
question: Who are eligible for the scheme?
answer: This scheme can be availed by to all eligible ration cardholders or beneficiaries covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
question: How do I know if I am NFSA Beneficiary?
answer: You can check on https://nfsa.gov.in/portal/ration_card_state_portals_aad

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
question: How Do I avail the Scheme? Is there any application process?
answer: Interested person shall visit nearest Fair Price Shop with Ration Card

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: If my habitation is seeking the installation and operation of a new Anganwadi Centre facility, what is the modified minimum population requirement for its establishment?
answer: To facilitate the construction and running of an Anganwadi Centre, the existing population norms have been changed to require a minimum habitation population of 100 and above.

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: What is the core characteristic I must possess to be considered a target beneficiary for all the infrastructure and welfare improvements offered by this major mission?
answer: You must strictly belong to one of the 75 identified communities categorized as a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG).

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: If I am applying for construction support to improve my residential situation, what specific condition must my current dwelling meet to qualify for a pucca house?
answer: To be eligible for the provision of a pucca (permanent) house, your Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group household must currently be residing in a kaccha (temporary) house.

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: What essential personal identification documents or entitlements are facilitated or required for identified beneficiaries under this mission?
answer: The Block Level Implementation Team is responsible for facilitating entitlements like Aadhar card, Ayushman Bharat card, and Forest Right Act (FRA) Pattas for eligible beneficiaries.

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: What is the extended timeline provided for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group households to receive pucca houses under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin component of this mission?
answer: Specifically for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs), the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G) housing scheme component has been extended until March 2026.

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: What is the minimum population threshold required in my area for the modified scheme guidelines to sanction and construct a connecting road under the infrastructure plan?
answer: To qualify for connecting road construction under the modified scheme norms, your village or habitation must have a minimum population of 100 and above.

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: I am an individual seeking vocational skill training; what size restriction applies to the Self-Help Group I must be a member of to participate in the livelihood enhancement activities?
answer: If participating in the Van Dhan Vikas Kendra program, the flexibility norms specify that each Van Dhan Self-Help Group (VDSHG) must consist of between 10 and 20 members.

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: If I belong to one of the identified traditional groups, what is the geographical requirement regarding my place of residence to qualify for this mission?
answer: The applicant must reside within one of the 18 States and Union Territories where the population of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups has been officially notified.

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: I am seeking support for income generation activities; what organizational structure must my group belong to in order to establish a Van Dhan Vikas Kendra?
answer: Your group should be established as a Van Dhan Vikas Kendra (VDVK). This Kendra must be composed of between five and fifteen Van Dhan Self-Help Groups (VDSHG).

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: Regarding the provision of safe drinking water facilities, what specific household limit applies to villages that will receive community water supply instead of individual household connections?
answer: The provision for a single point community water connection is intended for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group villages or habitations that have a population count of less than 20 households.

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: Are there any special considerations for securing an electricity connection through the on-grid Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme if my household does not meet the standard state eligibility requirements?
answer: Yes, all identified beneficiary households under this mission are eligible for funding for an on-grid electricity connection under the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS), irrespective of the standard eligibility criteria for the State and Electricity distribution company (DISCOM).

scheme_name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN)
question: In the event that my unelectrified house is considered for an off-grid solar power solution, is there any previous government scheme coverage that would disqualify me?
answer: Yes, if your household has already been covered under the SAUBHAGYA scheme, you would be excluded from receiving the off-grid solar power solution intervention.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
question: Whether the benefits of the scheme are admissible to only Small & Marginal Farmers' (SMF) families?
answer: No. The Scheme for all farmer families irrespective of the size of their landholdings

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: What Are The Different Kind Of Systems Supported Under PM-KUSUM Scheme?
answer: PM-KUSUM Scheme supports three different kind of installations, known as three components of the Scheme as given below: | Component-A: Setting up of decentralized ground/ stilt mounted grid connected solar or other renewable energy based power plants up to 2 MW capacity | Component-B: Installation of stand-alone solar agriculture pumps of capacity up to 7.5 HP | Component-C: Solarisation of existing grid connected agriculture pumps of capacity up to 7.5 HP

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: What Is Component-A Of PM-KUSUM Scheme?
answer: Under this component, solar or other renewable energy based power plants of capacity 500 kW to 2 MW can be installed on barren or uncultivable agriculture land mainly. Agriculture land is also permitted under this scheme provided that solar plants are installed in slit fashion (i.e. raised structure for installation of solar panels) and with adequate spacing between panel rows for ensuring that farming activity is not affected.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: Who Is Eligible Under Component-A Of PM-KUSUM Scheme?
answer: Individual farmers/ group of farmers/ cooperatives/panchayats/ Farmer Producer Organisations (FPO)/Water User associations (WUA). Land on which the project is proposed to be installed should be within 5 km from the nearest electricity sub-station.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: Who Will Purchase The Generated Electricity?
answer: Power generated will be purchased by the local electricity distribution companies (Discoms)

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: Can Farmers Lease Their Land For The Development Of Renewable Energy Power Plant Under Component-A?
answer: Yes, farmers can either install renewable power project on their land or lease the land on rent to a developer at mutually agreed terms between the parties.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: What Kind Of Financial Support Is Available Under Component-A Of The Scheme?
answer: The renewable power generated will be purchased by DISCOMs at a pre-fixed levelised tariff. The duration of PPA will be 25 years from Commercial Operation Date (COD) of the project. Procurement based incentive (PBI) of 40 paisa per unit of electricity generated or Rs. 6.6 lakh per MW per annum, whichever is lower, will be provided to DISCOM for buying electricity generated for five years.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: What Is Component-B Of PM-KUSUM Scheme?
answer: Under this Component, farmers can replace their existing diesel poweredagriculture pumps with standalone solar pumpsof capacity up to 7.5 HP in off-grid areas. Pumps of capacity higher than 7.5 HP may be allowed, however, the central subsidy will be limited to the subsidy applicable for pump of 7.5 HP.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: Who Is Eligible Under Component B Of PM-KUSUM?
answer: Individual farmers, Water User Associations and community/cluster based irrigation system will be covered under this component.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: Is There Any Subsidy For The Installation Of Solar Pump?
answer: For all states except for North-eastern States, Hill States/UTs and Island UTs, subsidy of 30%, each by Central and State Governments will be provided, and the remaining 40% will be invested by the farmer for installation of solar pump. Subsidy in percentage mentioned above is applicable on benchmark cost or tender cost, whichever is lower. For North-eastern States, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Jammu and Kashmir/Ladakh and Island UTs, subsidy of 50% will be provided by Central Government and at least 30% will be provided by the State Government for installation of solar pump. Farmer will have to invest balance 20%.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: What Is Component-C Of PM-KUSUM Scheme?
answer: Under this Component, farmers can solarize their existing grid connected agriculture pumps of capacity up to 7.5 HP. Solar PV capacity up to two times of pump capacity in kW is allowed under the scheme.However, States may choose to allow lower solar PV capacity, which in no case will be less than pump capacity in HP. The farmer will be able to use the generated solar power to meet the irrigation needs and the excess solar power will be sold to DISCOMs.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: Who Is Eligible Under Component C Of PM-KUSUM?
answer: Individual farmers, water user associations and community/cluster based irrigation system will also be covered under this component.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan Scheme For Farmers.
question: Is There Any Subsidy For The Installation Of Solarisation Of Pump?
answer: For all states except for North-eastern States, Hill States/UTs and Island UTs, subsidy of 30%, each by Central and State Governments will be provided, and the remaining 40% will be invested by the farmer for solarization of existing pumps. Subsidy in percentage mentioned above is applicable on benchmark cost or tender cost, whichever is lower. For North-eastern States, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Jammu and Kashmir/Ladakh and Island UTs, subsidy of 50% will be provided by Central Government and at least 30% will be provided by the State Government for solarization of existing pumps. Farmer will have to invest balance 20%.

answer: Yes, you must collect document verification report (Student Copy) from the facilitation centre without fail.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: Is It Necessary For Me To Submit Original Documents To The Facilitation Centre After The Document verification?
answer: No, original documents are to be submitted in the facilitation centers. However, you have to show all the original documents to the Nodal Officer for verification.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: Is There Any Helpline No./E-Mail/Grievance Mechanism For SSSJKL Scholarship Queries?
answer: Yes, you may call on 011-29581043/07/51/10 (from 9.30 am to 5.00 pm Monday to Friday) or email at pmsss_cell@aicte-india.org on all working days for any queries. You can also register your grievance from your login to get the resolution for your query.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: I Am Not Able To Register Under SSSJKL Scholarship And Facing Technical Issue?
answer: Any technical issue at the time of registration you may register your grievance in grievance portal i.e. https://css.aicte.gov.in/login.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: I Have Done Diploma In Engineering Field, Can I Apply Under SSSJKL?
answer: Yes, Candidates who want to take admission under Lateral Entry Scheme have passed Diploma in Engineering from the Polytechnics recognized by UTs of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh directorate of technical education. Admission under Lateral Entry Scheme will be subject to vacant seats available during last academic year in Engineering Stream only.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: I Wish To Pursue My Studies In IIT/NIT/Institute Of National Importance/Centrally Funded Institutions Programs/Courses On My Own Without Participating In SSSJKL Counseling Process, Am I Eligible For SSSJKL Scholarship?
answer: Students who qualify entrance examination conducted by Central Govt. (NEET/JEE) are eligible for scholarships, if they have registered themselves under SSSKL scheme. Candidates are required to get their documents verified by nearest Facilitation Center.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: I Wish To Pursue My Studies In Architecture Course On My Own Without Participating In SSSJKL Counseling Process. Am I Eligible For SSSJKL Scholarship?
answer: Students taking the Architecture course are required to qualify for the NATA examination and register themselves under SSSJKL scheme. Candidates are required to get their documents verified by Facilitation Center.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: I Have Taken Admission Under Management Quota, Am I Eligible For SSSJKL Scholarship?
answer: No, Candidates taking admission under Management Quota or by Agents / NGO are not eligible for SSSJKL Scholarship.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: When And How Do I Have To Upload My Joining Report?
answer: After freezing the seat, candidate is required to report to the allotted college immediately and upload the joining report from SSSJKL institute Portal within stipulated time period. Also complete admission process as per Institute/University rules.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: Where To Check The Details Of My Nodal Officer?
answer: Candidate can check the details of the Nodal Officer either on the Welcome Letter of the Institute or in their Login.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
question: What is the duration of scholarship for various courses?
answer: The duration of courses varies: | - General Degree courses: 3 years | - Professional courses: 4 years | - Medical courses: 4.5 years

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
question: What is the objective of "Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS)"?
answer: CSIS is a unique scheme which pivots around the vision that no student desiring to pursue higher education is denied of the opportunity if he/ she is financially poor. This scheme benefits all categories of economically weaker students for pursuing professional/ technical courses in India only and intends to provide affordable higher education. The Scheme envisages uplifting the students from the grassroots level and increasing the number of qualified technicians/ professionals in the nation. CSIS aims to check the existing geographical imbalance with regard to the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in Higher Educational institutions.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
question: Who is eligible for the scheme?
answer: • Students who want to pursue Technical/Professional higher education courses in recognized institutes in India. | • Higher Education Institutions (HEI) should be NAAC, NBA, CFTI accredited or regulatory approved institutes in India.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
question: Is it compulsory to avail education loan for getting interest subsidy benefit?
answer: • Yes, students who availed of education loans from scheduled commercial banks under the Model Education Loan Scheme of IBA and | • Who are studying in HEI which satisfies the above are eligible for the interest subsidy.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
question: Is there any income criteria for claiming the subsidy?
answer: Yes, the total Family annual income from all sources should not exceed ₹4.5 lakhs.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
question: Where is interest Subsidy credited?
answer: The subsidy amount will be credited to PM VIDYALAXMI DIGITAL RUPEE APP (CBDC WALLET) of the beneficiary and on redemption on the app by the beneficiary, the amount will be transferred to the beneficiary loan account.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
question: Who applies for CSIS
answer: - Students can apply online for education loan and interest subvention under PM-USP CSIS Scheme at https://pmvidyalaxmi.co.in. - No additional application from student is necessary. | - The bank branch which is disbursing the loan should check the eligibility of the student and file the subsidy claim when it is due, using the portal. | - The portal is open throughout the year.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
question: When bank can file its interest subsidy claim?
answer: • The portal maintained by Canara Bank for CSIS claims is open throughout the year. | • Bank branch which is disbursing the loan should file the claim when the interest subsidy for a year is due and the student has shown proof that she/he has successfully completed that year of study.
