answer: The first release is based on project milestones, and subsequent releases depend on project progress assessed by the Project Review Committee (PRC).

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: Are there specific timeframes for project monitoring?
answer: Project monitoring occurs every three months, and external experts review project progress at least once every nine months.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: Can non-student Indian citizens apply for PRISM support?
answer: Yes, PRISM encourages any Indian citizen with innovative ideas or inventions to apply for support.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: What kind of projects should applicants plan for PRISM support?
answer: Applicants should plan projects that lead to the development of demonstrable models/prototypes, providing proof of their innovative concept.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: Are there any restrictions on the type of prior work documentation?
answer: Prior work documentation can include videos, photos, press coverage, or other forms of evidence that highlight prior work related to the innovation.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: Is there a specific format for the Residence Certificate?
answer: The Residence Certificate should be issued by a Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM)/District Magistrate (DM) or be a copy of a ration card or any other document providing proof of residence.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: Can PRISM funds be used for creating infrastructure facilities?

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: What is the key distinction between an award and PRISM's financial support?

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: How does PRISM monitor project progress?

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: What committee is responsible for recommending PRISM grants?
answer: The PRISM Advisory and Screening Committee (PASC) considers and recommends project proposals for approval.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: Who evaluates the project proposals in the PRISM scheme?
answer: Domain Knowledge Experts associated with TOCIC evaluate the project proposals.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

answer: TOCIC coordinators screen project proposals for completeness and forward them to Domain Knowledge Experts for evaluation.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-1: Proof of Concept/ Prototypes/ Models
question: How does PRISM contribute to inclusive development?
answer: By supporting individual innovators, PRISM helps achieve the agenda of inclusive development, which is one of the thrust areas of the XIIth five-year plan (2012-2017).

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
question: What is the highest percentage of the total approved project expenditure that the funding authority can provide as financial assistance under this category?

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
question: What types of innovation activities are primarily eligible for support under Category II, focusing on demonstrable outcomes rather than research?
answer: Support covers the Fabrication of Working Model, Process Know-how, Testing & Trial, Patenting, or Technology Transfer, which demand rigorous demonstrability of the original idea.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
question: When submitting a proposal that has been mentored by external agencies other than the designated TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centres, what submission route must be followed?
answer: Proposals scouted and documented by other agencies must still be routed through the nearest TePP Outreach cum Cluster Innovation Centre and include an evaluation by the assisting agency.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
question: As a student applying for innovation support, what specific documentation is required from the head of my educational institution to be eligible for consideration?
answer: Students must provide a 'No Objection Certificate' signed by the head of their institution, written on the institution's official letter-head, along with the main application.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
question: What are the minimum and maximum financial limits set for the total estimated costs of the proposed invention project to qualify for this particular phase of support?
answer: The overall project cost must fall within the range of more than ₹5,00,000/- and up to ₹35,00,000/- to meet the stipulated financial criteria for the proposal.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
question: Are there any limitations placed on the cost allocated specifically for hiring technical assistants or other related manpower within the project budget?
answer: Yes, the manpower cost intended for technical assistants is capped and must not exceed 20% of the total approved cost for the innovation project.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
question: If I am currently employed by an organization and wish to seek support for my innovative idea, what formal approval must I obtain from my employer?
answer: Individuals working in organizations must furnish a mandatory 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer when applying for support under the Promoting Innovations In Individuals, Start-Ups and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises scheme.

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer
question: If the project solely involves developing new software applications without any embedded physical component, will the proposal be considered eligible for funding?

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer

scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs): Category-2: Fabrication of Working Model/Process Know-how/Testing & Trial/Patenting/Technology Transfer

question: What is the "Pension Scheme for Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations"?
answer: The "Pension Scheme for Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations" is a scheme launched by the Rubber Board, under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. The primary objective is to motivate tappers and encourage their continued involvement in tapping jobs.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
question: What is the main goal of this scheme?
answer: The scheme aims to provide financial support to tappers by offering 50% of the yearly contribution for a maximum period of 5 years, with the purpose of facilitating their enrollment in the pension scheme.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
question: What is the duration of financial support under this scheme?
answer: The financial support is provided for a maximum period of 5 years to tappers who enroll for the pension scheme.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
question: What is the pension amount that an enrolled member can expect upon reaching the age of 60 years?
answer: Enrolled members who consistently remit their annual contributions up to the age of 60 years will receive a monthly pension of ₹1300/-.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
question: Apart from the monthly pension, are there any additional benefits available to the members?
answer: Yes, members are entitled to various additional benefits, including family pension, financial assistance for permanent disability, maternity benefits, medical assistance, and other benefits as determined by the Government from time to time.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
question: What is the age range for tappers to be eligible for enrollment in the scheme?
answer: Tappers aged between 18 to 55 years are eligible to enroll in the Pension Scheme for Tappers.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
question: What is the work experience requirement for eligibility?
answer: Tappers should have a minimum experience of 90 days in the preceding 12 months to be eligible for enrollment.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
question: What are the employment conditions for eligibility?
answer: Eligible tappers should be engaged in tapping jobs throughout the year in small rubber plantations, either for wages or through self-tapping in their own small rubber plantation up to 1 hectare.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
question: Are there any specific exclusions from eligibility?
answer: Yes, tappers who are already members of any pension scheme implemented by the Central/State Government or those tapping in rubber plantations measuring an area above 5 hectares are not eligible under this scheme.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
question: Are tappers enrolled in the Tapper Bank under Rubber Producers Societies (RPS) eligible for enrollment?
answer: Yes, tappers enrolled in the Tapper Bank under Rubber Producers Societies (RPS) are eligible for enrollment in the Pension Scheme for Tappers.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations

answer: Each tapper is required to contribute ₹480 annually to the Pension Scheme for Tappers.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations

answer: Yes, the Rubber Board will contribute 50% of the annual contribution for the initial period of 5 years for all members who consistently remit their contributions on time.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations

answer: Each tapper needs to contribute ₹240 annually to the scheme for the initial 5 years, as the Rubber Board contributes the remaining 50%.

scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations

answer: On production application in format supported with valid documents conveying that the faculty has obtained admission in doctoral programme leading to award of PhD degree in the top ranking 500 foreign university /college and authenticated by its parent University / college in India alongwith filled-up Mandate form, the faculty shall be provided scholarship for first year of the programme only.

scheme_name: AICTE-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT (FOREIGN UNIVERSITY) PROGRAMME
question: Why scholarship under QIP (FU) is provided for 1st year i.e. first 12 months only?
answer: AICTE shall provide scholarship to each faculty who has obtained admission and started pursuing Ph.D degree in the foreign university / institution for 1st year i.e. for 12 months. It is well conceived that there is dearth of funds available in the form of scholarships / fellowships / student assistantships and also other grants etc. which are provided to the students etc. by the foreign universities and other international agencies, which the faculty pursuing PhD may easily procure.

scheme_name: AICTE-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT (FOREIGN UNIVERSITY) PROGRAMME
question: Who are eligible for the scheme?
answer: A full time regular/permanent faculty members of AICTE recognized Degree Level Colleges are eligible to apply.

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: What is the "Raman-Charpak Fellowship Programme"?
answer: The programme offers them an excellent opportunity to carry out a part of their respective PhD/Masters' research project in each other countries and to further establish professional relationships, promote new S&T cooperation, and experience another cultural context.

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: What is the aim of Programme?
answer: The aim is to facilitate the exchange of doctoral students between the two countries, in order to broaden the scope and depth of future engagements in Science, Technology and Innovation. This programme is now also open to French Master Students, who wish to spend some time in India following their curriculum. It aims at improving the Master's skills of French students by providing them an opportunity to carry out internship work in a University/Research Institute based in India.

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: Which is the implementing agency of this Programme?
answer: Indo-French Centre for Promotion of Advanced Research/ Centre Franco-Indien pour la Promotion de la Recherche Avancee

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: When was this Programme launched?
answer: The Fellowship was launched during the State visit of the President of France to India in February 2013.

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: What are the eligibility criteria for applying/availing the Fellowship?
answer: Applicants from India must be Indian citizens residing in India and have registered for a PhD in a recognized university or research institution in India. | Applicants from France must be residing in France and have registered for a PhD/Master's Degree in a recognized university or research institution in France. | Maximum age 30 years as of 1st April of the call year. | Students once supported by CEFIPRA and students who have a permanent position in institutions/universities are not eligible.

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: What are the areas covered under this Fellowship?
answer: Areas covered under the Fellowship: | Atmospheric Sciences | Earth Sciences and Environmental Sciences | Materials Sciences | Physical Sciences | Chemical Sciences | Engineering Sciences | Biological Sciences | Life and Medical Sciences | - Mathematical and Computational Sciences

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: What is the amount of Fellowships?
answer: For Indian Fellow: Fellowship Support of 1500 Euros per month for daily expenses, local travel, accommodation charges plus Social Security charges. | For French Fellow: Fellowship support ₹40,000/- per month for daily expenses, local travel, etc. plus accommodation charges not exceeding ₹45,000/- per month.

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: What are the additional supports provided to Fellows?
answer: To and fro air ticket in economy class between India and France. | Insurance coverage (travel & health) wherever is required & Carte de Sejour (if any). | Any administrative costs for Visa and Registration (if any). | Support for attending conferences/seminars/workshops during the stay.

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: What is the duration of fellowship?
answer: The duration of the Fellowship will be for a period of two to six months.

scheme_name: Raman-Charpak Fellowship
question: How to apply for the fellowship?
answer: The eligible candidates need to register and apply at www.cefipra.org or log on to: http://www.cefipra.org/proposal/index.aspx

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: What is the DBT-RA program?
answer: The DBT-RA program is a research associateship program initiated by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) in India to support postdoctoral research in the field of biotechnology.

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: Who is eligible for the DBT-RA?
answer: To be eligible for the DBT-RA, applicants must have: | - A Ph.D. degree in Science, Engineering, or M.D./M.S. degree in any area of medicine with research interests in Biotechnology and Life Sciences and a good academic record. | - Be below the age of 40 years (45 years for female candidates) as on the last date of application.

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: What are the benefits of the DBT-RA?
answer: DBT-RA fellows receive a monthly stipend of ₹55,000, plus house rent allowance (HRA) and other benefits. They are also provided with a research contingency grant of ₹50,000 per year. In addition, DBT-RA fellows have access to state-of-the-art research facilities and mentorship from senior scientists.

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: How long is the DBT-RA fellowship?
answer: The DBT-RA fellowship is for a duration of two years, with the possibility of renewal for another two years based on satisfactory performance.

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: Where can I apply for the DBT-RA?
answer: Applications for the DBT-RA are accepted online through the DBT-RA website: https://ra.dbtindia.gov.in/

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: What is the application deadline for the DBT-RA?
answer: The application deadline for the DBT-RA typically falls in the month of November. However, it is advisable to check the DBT-RA website for the latest information on the application deadline.

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: What is the selection process for the DBT-RA?
answer: The selection process for the DBT-RA is based on a competitive review of applications. Applicants are shortlisted based on their academic qualifications, research experience, and publications. Shortlisted candidates are then invited for an interview.

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: Can I apply for the DBT-RA if I am already employed?
answer: Yes, you can apply for the DBT-RA even if you are already employed. However, if you are selected, you will have to relinquish your employment to accept the fellowship.

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: Can I apply for the DBT-RA if I have not yet received my Ph.D./M.D./M.S. degree?
answer: Yes, you can apply for the DBT-RA even if you have not yet received your Ph.D./M.D./M.S. degree. However, if you are selected, you will be offered a lower fellowship amount until you qualify the eligible degree.

scheme_name: Research Associates (RA)
question: Can I apply for the DBT-RA more than once?
answer: No, you can apply for the DBT-RA only once in your career.

scheme_name: Rainfed Area Development
question: What is the type of assistance provided in the scheme?
answer: A financial assistance of up to Rs. 30,000/- per family can be given for adoption of integrated farming systems such as cultivating crops along with trees (agro forestry or horticulture) or undertaking at least any two activities out of fishery, apiculture, silage making & vermicomposting.

scheme_name: Rainfed Area Development
question: What is the maximum limit for the monetary assistance?
answer: A monetary support of Rs. 30,000/- per family for adoption of integrated farming systems. This amount is over and above any other assistance availed by other complimenting schemes such as WDC-PMKSY, MGNREGA, NFNSM, other components of RKVY, National Mission on Edible Oil-Oilseeds (NMEO-OS), Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH), National Mission on Natural Farming, Sub Mission on Agricultural Extension(SMAE) etc. through convergence.

scheme_name: Rainfed Area Development
question: Does the financial assistance vary according to the farmer's landholding?
answer: The amount of assistance shall be uniform for all farmers irrespective of the size of their land holding. Credit support, if required, may be arranged to meet the balance

scheme_name: Rainfed Area Development
question: Who can avail benefits of this scheme?
answer: All the farmers of the State & Union Territory are eligible to take the benefits of this scheme.

scheme_name: Rainfed Area Development
question: What activities are eligible for assistance under the scheme?
answer: Integrated farming systems or combination of at least any two activities out of fishery, apiculture, silage making & vermicomposting.

scheme_name: Rainfed Area Development
question: Can I avail benefits under RAD scheme if I am already a beneficiary of PMKSY-WDC scheme?
answer: Yes, you can avail, benefits under RAD are over and above PMKSY-WDC and other complimenting schemes of RKVY.

scheme_name: Rainfed Area Development
question: Is there any application fee?
answer: No. The entire application process is completely free of cost.

scheme_name: Rainfed Area Development
question: What documents are required for application?
answer: Once the cluster is identified by the state government for scheme implementation, they may ask for KYC documents (Aadhar, Voter Id, etc.), bank account details, photographs, land documents/ownership proofs and any other document on case to case basis.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Is the grants received under Ramanujan Fellowship taxable?
answer: Yes, the Grant received under Ramanujan Fellowship is taxable as per I.T. rules.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: To whom the Ramanujan Fellowship is meant for or what is the aim of initiating the Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: The Ramanujan Fellowship is meant for brilliant Indian scientists and engineers from all over the world to take up scientific positions in India and for those Indian scientists who want to return to India from abroad. The Fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: How can a person apply for the Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: Individual Scientists and Technologists working abroad should approach the Institutions of his/her choice for hosting them for the fellowship. The nominee will then fill out his application through the serb online portal serbonline.in and submit it to his nominator who will verify the application and then submit the nomination to SERB through online portal only.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What are the areas covered under Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: All Areas of Science (in the broadest terms) are covered by this Fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Which are the institutes and universities where the Ramanujan Fellow can work?
answer: The Ramanujan Fellows can work in any of the scientific institutions and universities in the country other than the institute where he/she has obtained his/her doctorate degree.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Is Ramanujan fellow eligible to apply for Core Research grant proposal?
answer: Yes, Ramanujan fellows are eligible to apply for Core Research grant proposal.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What are the eligibility criteria for applying for Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: Following are the eligibility criteria for applying Ramanujan Fellowship: | The fellowship is open to brilliant Indian scientists and engineers from all over the world who are below the age of 40 years, who wants to return to India from abroad. | The applicant should possess a higher degree or equivalent, such as Ph.D. in Science/Engineering, Masters in Engineering or Technology/MD in Medicine, etc. and have adequate professional experience. | These Fellowships are very selective and only those who have a proven/outstanding track-record as evident from their research publications and recognitions would be eligible. | In case a fellow is offered a permanent position, he/she will be in-eligible for the fellowship. | This fellowship is meant for working in new areas and laboratories in order to expand their research capabilities, other than the one, where the candidate has obtained his/her doctorate degree. | Nominations from the Ph.D guides of the candidate and nominations from the same institute where they opted their Ph.D, will not be considered. | The age of the candidate should not be more than 40 years. | The candidate should be working abroad at the time of his nomination for the fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What is the duration of the Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: The Ramanujan Fellowship duration is for 5 years only.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: How/When can the individual start his Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: A letter is sent by the Science & Engineering Research Board (SERB) to the Individual as well as to the host Institute informing the award of Ramanujan Fellowship. After this the Individual has to join the fellowship within six months of the date of approval letter and to send his / her Acceptance Letter to the Host Institute, indicating the tentative month when he wants to start the Fellowship, and then the Institute will forward his Acceptance Letter to Science &Engineering Research Board along with the details of the bank for transfer of fund through RTGS(in the prescribed format). Based on this letter SERB will process the case for getting administrative and financial approvals and then a Sanction Order is issued to the Host Institute (marking a copy to the Ramanujan Fellow) and a copy to the Drawing and Disbursing Officer, SERB for disbursing the grant under Ramanujan Fellowship. When the grant money is received by the Host Institute, the Ramanujan Fellow can start his/ her Fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What is the nature of support the Ramanujan Fellow is entitled for?
answer: For Fellows who will be availing the Ramanujan fellowship after 31.12.2018, the revised funding pattern of Ramanujan fellows is as follows: | Ramanujan Fellow is entitled for a Fellowship of ₹1,35,000/- consolidated per month(including HRA component) | The fellowship will carry a research grant of ₹7.00 Lakh per annum. and overhead charges of ₹60,000/- to the host institute until the fellow is not having any position in India. | In case the selected fellow gets any position such as permanent, tenure track or contractual position, he/she, will become in-eligible for receiving fellowship including research grant and overhead under the fellowship and has to relinquish the Ramanujan fellowship in total. | For fellows who have already started availing this fellowship on or before 31.12.2018,(viz. sanction order of SERB issued on or before 31.12.2018) such fellows on acquiring a job(permanent, tenure track or contractual position) will be allowed to draw the research grant and overhead charges as indicated at (ii) above. Only the fellowship component will be discontinued as indicated by (i) above.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What is the emoluments under Ramanujan Fellowship for HRA?
answer: SERB gives only consolidated fellowship of ₹1,35,000/- p.m (including HRA component) per month.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Can a person avail grants under Ramanujan Fellowship and Salary from the Institute at the same time?
answer: No, A person can opt either to avail his/ her salary from the Institute or Fellowship amount under Ramanujan Fellowship and it is applicable to the fellows those who have started the fellowship on or before 31.12.2018(after the issuance of the sanction order on or before 31.12.2018 as per terms and conditions of latest O.M. dated 01-01-2019). | Fellows who get a permanent position after 31.12.2018 (issuance of sanction order happened after 31.12.2018), will relinquish the Ramanujan fellowship in total in case they get salary from institute on getting permanent, tenure track or on contractual basis.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Can a fellow change the host institute after getting Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: - Yes, in case the Ramanujan fellow who is availing fellowship (first sanction order issued on or before 31.12.2018), such fellows on acquiring a permanent job at other institute, will be allowed to transfer the fellowship and he can draw only research grant and overhead charges. The fellow should intimate to SERB about his permanent position immediately subsequently he can request for approval for change of host institute at a new institute within one month of shifting to new institute by submitting NOCs from both institution and appointment letter with detailed terms of references/conditions and the F.Y papers till the last date of working at earlier institute. The same is applicable for those fellows who want to transfer their fellowship to other Institute but without getting a permanent position. | - However, if a Ramanujan Fellow who is availing the fellowship (first sanction order issued after 31.12.2018), gets a permanent, tenure track or contractual position at other institute, then he/she will become in-eligible to receive the Ramanujan grant in total (as per the terms and conditions in the latest O.M. dated 01-01-2019) subject to final settlement and closure of the fellowship which is the mandatory requirement of this fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: How many times a person can avail International Travel per year in the Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: A person can avail one International Travel per year under Ramanujan Fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: How does a Ramanujan Fellow get his subsequent Grant?
answer: The Grant for the subsequent year are released only after receiving the Statement of Expenditure (SE) and Utilization Certificate (UC) in the prescribed format (available in the website). The SE and UC are financial year wise i.e. from 01st April to 31st March. For the first year it would be from the Date of Start (DOS) to 31st March and subsequently from 01st April to 31st March. In addition, a work report of for that FY is also required.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What payments can be made to the project staffs employed for Ramanujan fellow under Research grant?
answer: The project staff can be paid as per the SERB order issued time to time. Latest orders are available at SERB website.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Can an Indian scientist/engineer working in India under a permanent/temporary position be nominated by the institute for Ramanujan Fellowship?
answer: No, Ramanujan Fellowship is meant for reverse brain drain i.e. inviting brilliant Indian scientists and engineers who want to return to India from abroad to take up scientific positions in India.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What is the time duration for selected candidates to join the host institute as a Ramanujan fellow?
answer: The selected candidates must join their host institute within 6 months from the issue of the Ramanujan Fellowship Award letter, else the award will be cancelled automatically.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Can an Institute nominate an employee having temporary employment in India?
answer: No, Institute can nominate Indian scientist for Ramanujan Fellowship only from outside India, having no position or employment in India.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: From where a candidate can get himself nominated from?
answer: - Candidate can choose to work at any S&T institution including University/ department or other academic institutions and national R&D laboratories in India other than the institute where he/she obtained his/her doctorate degree, provided the institution where they wish to pursue research is willing to provide the necessary R&D, administrative and basic infrastructural support to facilitate research. | - The application has to be filled by the nominee through the serb online portal serbonline.in and then submit it to his nominator of the host Institution who should be the head of organisation/ university/ institute or an authorized academic personnel of the institute/organisation/university. The nominator will then verify the application and then submit the nomination to SERB though online portal only. | - Selection will be made by Selection Committee specially appointed for the purpose.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What is the role of SERB in supporting Ramanujan Fellows?
answer: - SERB would release fellowship grant of ₹1,35,000/- per month(including HRA component) per month and Research grant of ₹7,00,000/- p.a and overheads of ₹60,000/- p.a. financial year wise, limited only to 60 months from the date of commencement. | - Grant for subsequent years would be released based on the scientific review of the work done, submission of SE & UC and annual progress report. | - During the tenure of the fellowship the awardee is not entitled to any kind of salary. However, he/she can apply for research grant to various funding agencies through their host institute. The information on the details of projects applied/sanctioned by the agencies may be made available to SERB from time-to-time. | - SERB may be kept informed about IPR issues and technology/product/process developed/commercialized, if any, during the tenure of the fellowship. | - SERB reserves the right to discontinue this fellowship at any stage and change the terms & conditions of the fellowship.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: What is the entitlement of Ramanujan fellow in the host institute?
answer: The SERB recommended Ramanujan fellow is equivalent to Scientist-D for the TA/DA etc.

scheme_name: Ramanujan Fellowship
question: Can a Ramanujan Fellow entitled to guide/supervise the M.Phil/Ph.D Scholars?
answer: SERB encourages Ramanujan fellow to get guideship at their respective host institute based on the applicant research experience, so then they can supervise M.Phil/Ph.D scholars which will help them in their academic career development.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: Does Only The Submission Of An Application Form Guarantee The Award Of A Fellowship And Research Grant?
answer: No, mere submission of an application form does not guarantee the award of a Fellowship and Research Grant.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: Who Shall Be Held Responsible If The Applicant Furnishes Incorrect/Incomplete Information That Results In The Cancellation Of His/Her Candidature?
answer: It is the responsibility of the applicant to provide correct information, failing which he/she will be solely responsible for the cancellation for his/her candidature.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: What Is Meant By "Aadhaar Seeding"?
answer: The fellowship is directly paid to the research scholars in their bank accounts. For this, the bank account numbers of the scholars are required to be Aadhaar linked and verified. This process is called "Aadhaar Seeding". As per the instructions of the Government of India, the Aadhaar has been made mandatory for the disbursement of all Government subsidies/Scholarships/Fellowships which are disbursed directly into the beneficiary's account. Accordingly, Aadhaar will be used as an Identifier for the release of grants under these schemes.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: What Would Be The Mode Of Payment For The Scholarship/Fellowship?
answer: The payment of the scholarship/fellowship will be through DBT.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: Is There Validity To The Scheme's Benefits?
answer: The benefits are provided till the complete duration of the course.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: Can I Apply Offline For The Scholarship/Fellowship?
answer: No. You need to visit the official website to apply.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: How Are The Applications Invited For The Purpose Of This Scheme? Is The Application Process Online?
answer: Applications are invited through online mode once in a year through advertisements in leading newspapers & employment news. Short notification is also uploaded in the UGC website i.e. www.ugc.ac.in

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: Is There Any Application Fee?
answer: No. The entire application process is completely free of cost.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: Do I Need To Complete The Application In One Sitting?
answer: No. You can save the application as draft and continue at a later time before the deadline.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: How Do I Know If A Field In The Application Form Is Mandatory?
answer: The mandatory fields have a red asterisk (*) mark at the end.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: To Whom Should The Candidates Reach Out If They Have Any Doubts Regarding The UGC Scholarship/Fellowship Scheme?
answer: The candidates can reach out to the helpdesk if they have any doubts regarding the UGC scholarship and fellowship schemes. Given below is the UGC helpline for scholarships/fellowships: Address: UGC, Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi - 110002. UGC Scholarship Contact No: 011-23604446, 011-23604200 Email ID: webmaster.ugc.help@gmail.com

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: What Is The Objective Of This Fellowship Scheme?
answer: The objective of this research grant is to provide opportunities to regularly appointed faculty members of Universities/ Institutes/ Colleges (hereinafter "Institutions") to pursue research in their area(s).

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: What Will Be The Tenure Of The Fellowship?
answer: The tenure of the fellowship will be 2 years.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: How Many Slots Are There In The Fellowship?
answer: There are 200 slots or as may be decided by the Commission.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: What Is The Amount Of The Quantum Of Support?
answer: The quantum of support under the scheme is ₹ 10,00,000. The grant can be utilized for purchasing items like minor equipment, consumables, contingencies, fieldwork, travel, etc.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: Will The Grant Be Released In A Lump Sum Or In Installments?
answer: The grant will be released in 3 installments to the university. | (i) Initially, 50% of the grant will be released on receipt of the joining report (Annexure-I). | (iii) The next installment of 25% of the research grant shall be paid on submission of the utilization certificate (Annexure II) of the first installment. | (ii) The final installment of 25% of the research grant shall be released on a reimbursement basis on submitting the claims and utilization certificate of the second installment. | However, the tenure to utilize the whole grant shall be 2 years from the release of the first installment of the research grant.

scheme_name: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
question: Can The Grant Be Used For International Travel, And Purchasing Furniture Items?
answer: No, The grant cannot be used for international travel, purchasing furniture items, or for appointing a project assistant or research fellow.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: What Are The Objectives Of RGNF?
answer: The objective of the scheme is to provide five-year fellowships in the form of financial assistance to students from SC categories, as notified by the Central Government to pursue higher studies such as M.Phil. and Ph.D. at Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges as indicated below: | i. Universities/Institutions/Colleges included under sections 2(f) and 12(B) of UGC Act. | ii. Deemed to be Universities included under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956 | and eligible to receive grants-in-aid from UGC. | iii. Universities/Institutions/Colleges funded by Central/State Government | iv. Institutes of National Importance.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: Which Ministry Formulated RGNF?
answer: The Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship (RGNF) Scheme for Scheduled Caste is formulated and funded by the Ministry of Social Justice &Empowerment.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: How Many Slots Are There In This Fellowship?
answer: There are 2000 slots for Scheduled Caste every year for all the subjects: Sciences, Humanities, Social Sciences, and Engineering & Technology.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: Is There An Earmarking For Persons With Disabilities?
answer: Yes, 3% of fellowships are reserved for Persons with Disabilities candidates belonging to SC categories as per the provision laid down by the Government of India.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: How Are The Applications Invited For This Scheme?
answer: The applications are invited through online mode once a year through advertisements in leading newspapers and Employment News.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: On What Grounds Can The Tenure Of The Candidate Be Extended?
answer: If the research work is found satisfactory, his/her tenure will be extended further for a period of five years under the enhanced emoluments of the Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship SC.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: What Is The Tenure Of The Fellowship Under The RGNF-SC Scheme?
answer: The tenure of the fellowship is initially for five years under the RGNF-SC Scheme.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: How Is The Distribution Of The Fellowship Performed?
answer: I. The total number of fellowships each year will be 2000. | ii. In case the numbers of candidates exceed the number of available slots, UGC will select the candidates for the fellowship based on the percentage of marks | obtained by them in their qualifying Post Graduation examination. | iii. The reservation for differently abled students shall be made as per UGC norms and in a horizontal manner. | iv. Scholars will be selected under the scheme in all domains of knowledge.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: Can Transgender Candidates Apply Under This Scheme?
answer: Yes, Transgender candidates are eligible to apply under the scheme. The reservation shall be followed as per government of India norms.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: What Will Happen If The Work Of The Candidate For The First Two Years Is Not Found Satisfactory?
answer: In case the work for the first two years is not found satisfactory, an additional year will be given to him/her for improvement. However, during this period he/she will be designated as Rajiv Gandhi National Junior Fellow. In such cases work will be evaluated again before the third year of the tenure, and if improvement is found the Fellow will get two more years of RGNF at enhanced rates (SRF). In case the candidate is not considered suitable for upgradation, the fellowship for the remaining tenure will be at JRF rates.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: Is Medical Assistance Provided Under This Scheme?
answer: No separate /fixed medical assistance is provided. However, the fellow may avail of the medical facilities available in the University/Institution/College.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: What Is Meant By "Academic Leave"?
answer: Academic Leave: The Fellow may be allowed academic leave (without fellowship and other emoluments) for a period not exceeding one year during the tenure of award for academic/teaching assignment /foreign visit in connection with research work.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: Can The Expenditure On Travel Be Claimed From UGC?
answer: The expenditure on travel cannot be claimed from UGC. The period of leave without fellowship will be counted towards the tenure.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: What If The Awardee Wishes To Apply For Any Other Fellowship/Paid Assignment/Examination Conducted By A Public Body During The Tenure Of The Fellowship?
answer: If the awardee wishes to apply for any other fellowship/paid assignment/examination conducted by a public body during the tenure of the fellowship, he/ she is not required to obtain NOC from UGC. In case of selection, the candidate would be required to tender their resignation from the Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
question: Are The Candidates Eligible For Maternity/Paternity Leave?
answer: Yes, Candidates are eligible for maternity/ paternity leave at full rates of the fellowship as per Govt. of India rules once during the tenure of the award.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: What is the objective of the scheme?
answer: The objective of the scheme "Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for Writing Original Book in Hindi" is to encourage writing books originally in Hindi and to promote the Official Language.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: What are the categories under which awards are given?
answer: The scheme recognizes excellence in writing across different categories, including: | Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi on knowledge and science based subjects. | Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi on Forensic Science, Police, Criminology Research and Police Administration. | Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi on subjects related to Culture, Religion, Arts and Heritage. | Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar for writing original book in Hindi in the field of law.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: What additional benefits do awardees receive apart from the cash prizes?
answer: Apart from the cash prizes, awardees will be presented with a certificate and a memento to honor their achievement. Additionally, authors/publishers retain the copyright of the award-winning book.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: Are there any provisions for travel and accommodation for awardees from distant places?
answer: Yes, awardees traveling from places other than the designated award distribution location will be provided to and fro fare for 2nd AC. They will also receive a daily allowance as per the rules of the Government of India. However, lodging arrangements are to be made by the awardee at their own expense.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: Who is eligible to participate for the award?
answer: The author or co-author must be a citizen of India to be eligible for participation for the award.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: What genres are considered under the scheme?
answer: - The book should be written on the genres mentioned as follows:- | Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, Physics, Biology, Energy, Space Science, Medicine, Chemistry, Information Technology, Management, Psychology etc; Contemporary subjects such as Liberalisation, Globalisation, Consumerism, Human Rights and Pollution etc. | Forensic Science, Police, Criminology Research and Police Administration etc. | Culture, Religion, Arts and Heritage etc. | Subject related to Law

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: Can a book with multiple authors be submitted?
answer: Yes, in the case of multiple authors, each co-author must fill out the proforma separately to be considered for the award.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: Are translated books accepted under the scheme?
answer: No, only original works in Hindi are accepted.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: Can a book that has received awards from other government organizations participate?
answer: Books that have received awards from any government organization previously will not be eligible.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: What is the acceptable timeframe for books to be considered under the scheme?
answer: Books published between 1st January to 31st December are eligible for consideration under the Scheme.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: What types of books are not eligible under the scheme?
answer: Books in the form of a thesis for Ph.D., poems, novels, stories, plays, or textbooks are not eligible under the scheme. The book should be an analytical review of the subject it deals with.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: What responsibilities do authors have regarding the content of their books?
answer: The author/co-author will be responsible for facts and figures given in the book and must give references wherever possible as proof.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: Can an author receive the award if they have won in the previous three years?
answer: If a person has received a prize under any scheme of Department of Official Language during the preceding three years, his/her entry shall not be considered. However, a co-author, (if any) can participate in the scheme. The co-author will be given the amount proportionately.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: What is the minimum page requirement for eligible books?
answer: The books submitted under the scheme should contain a minimum of 100 pages.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: What happens if the Evaluation Committee finds none of the submitted books suitable for the award?
answer: If the Evaluation Committee arrives at a conclusion that none of the-books, received as entries, is suitable for the award, decision of the committee in this regard will be considered as final.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: How is the award money distributed if a book has multiple authors?
answer: In case the book selected for the award has more than one author, the award money will be divided equally among them.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: Is there a requirement for books to have an ISBN to be accepted under the scheme?
answer: Yes, only books with ISBN will be accepted for the award.

scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
question: How can I apply under the scheme?
answer: Author entry proforma fill it out with accurate details, and submit it along with three copies of the original book and the required documents before the specified deadline.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program
question: What is the purpose of internship with MoPR?
answer: The Internship Program has the following objectives: To engage 'Students' and 'Research Scholars' for tapping academic talents, knowledge, skills, and techniques to be best utilised and associated with the MoPR's Policy and Action Research work for mutual benefits.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program
question: What is the Period of Internship?
answer: The Internship Program shall be available throughout the year, based on the requirements of MoPR. Preferable periods would be: | (a) Mid-week of October to the first week of December; and | (b) Mid-week of June to Third-week of August.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program
question: What is the eligiblity criteria of the internship scheme?
answer: The applicants pursuing Graduation/Post Graduation/Research courses from any recognized University/Institution within India or abroad are eligible to apply for the internship.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program
question: Is the Internship program part of Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan?
answer: The 'Internship Program' is part of the Framework for Implementation of Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) of Revamped Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA) (2022-23 to 2025-26) of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR), Government of India.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program
question: Will I get the Experience Certificate?
answer: Yes, A certificate will be issued after successful completion of the above-mentioned Internship period, along with the submission of deliverables for the given assignment by MoPR, by the divisional Head (DH)/ or concerned official.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
question: When Was This Scheme Instituted?
answer: The Scheme "Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar" was instituted in the year 2009 by the Department of Sports.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
question: What Are The Categories In Which The Award Is Conferred?
answer: There are four categories of awards under the Scheme: | (a) Identification and nurturing of budding/young talent | (b) Encouragement to sports through Corporate Social Responsibility | (c) Employment of sports persons and sports welfare measures | (d) Sports for Development

scheme_name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
question: What Are The Objectives Of This Scheme?
answer: The objective of the award is to encourage and promote the involvement of corporates, voluntary organizations, sports control boards, etc., in the promotion and development of sports in the country.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
question: What Are The Benefits Provided Under This Award?
answer: The awards will consist of a citation and a trophy in each of the above-mentioned categories. There will be no cash award.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
question: Where Can I Find The Video Tutorial For The Application Process?
answer: The video tutorial for the application process can be viewed at this link - https://dbtyas-sports.gov.in/home/User_Manual#

scheme_name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
question: What Are The Eligibility Criteria For The Category Of 'Identification And Nurturing Of Budding/Young Talent'?
answer: For the category of 'Identification and nurturing of budding/young talent', the entity should have identified and nurtured at least 50 young and budding sportspersons each year during the last three years.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
question: What Are The Eligibility Criteria For The Category Of 'Sports For Development'?
answer: For the category of 'Sports for Development', only non-governmental organizations, which have been working for the promotion and development of sports at least for the last three years would be eligible to apply. Memorandum of Association, Rules & Regulations, Bye-laws, etc under which the applicant NGO has been established and documents indicating the source of funds for its functioning and activities should also be submitted along with the application.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
question: What Are The Eligibility Criteria For The Category Of 'Employment Of Sportspersons And Sports Welfare Measures'?
answer: For the category of 'Employment of sportspersons and sports welfare measures', the entity should have recruited at least 50 sportspersons during the last three years.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar
question: Do I Need To Apply Offline For This Scheme?
answer: No, the applicant should visit the website https://dbtyas-sports.gov.in/ to register and apply for Online Schemes of the Department of Sports.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
question: What is Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar (RKVP)?
answer: It is an award given to agricultural scientists and professionals for outstanding contributions in agriculture and allied sciences.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
question: What type of work is considered for the award?
answer: The applicant's work must include research, innovation, or extension activities with proven impact on society, economy, or environment.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
question: Is there any minimum experience required?
answer: No, the applicant can apply at any stage of their career as no minimum service period is required.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
question: Can a person apply more than once in a year?
answer: No, the applicant can submit only one application for one contribution in a year.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
question: How many members are allowed in a team?
answer: The applicant can be part of a team of up to 5 members (or minimum 3 for interdisciplinary category).

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
question: Can the same person apply in multiple categories?
answer: No, the applicant can apply in only one category.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
question: Who can nominate the applicant?
answer: The applicant can be nominated by institutions, government bodies, or can also self-nominate.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
question: What happens if the awardee cannot attend the ceremony?
answer: The award is still considered given, but no one else can receive it on their behalf (except in posthumous cases).

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
question: How long is the application valid?
answer: The applicant's application is valid for one year only and is not carried forward.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
question: Is there a fee for getting the soil tested?
answer: No. The entire application process is completely free of cost under this scheme.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
question: Can I get my soil tested for other parameters than mentioned in the scheme?
answer: No.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
question: How are the recommendations arrived at?
answer: Recommendations are based on GFR developed by State Agriculture Universities.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
question: Can any farmer apply for a soil health card?
answer: Yes, any farmer can apply for a soil health card for his/her land, through District Agriculture Office.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
question: How to apply for the scheme?
answer: For generation of SHC, farmer should reach out to the District / State Nodal officer if he/she wants to get soil testing done for free. Agent visits the farmer and collects farmer details, land details and geo-tags the land through mobile app and generates a QR code (which carries information on farmer and land). The soil is taken to a STL where it is tested on 12 parameters. The SHC is generated after soil test on portal. The SHC gives crop recommendations and fertiliser recommendations (which crop should be grown on this soil type and how much and which fertiliser is best suited).

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
question: What are the documents required for the scheme?
answer: The documents may vary for each state. It is recommended to consult with the relevant authorities for detailed information.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
question: Will necessary training be provided to entrepreneur after setting up VLSTL?
answer: Yes, training programme will be organised by state government and manufacturer for beneficiary entrepreneur. Training will include topics such as how to collect sample using mobile application, sampling methodology, how to run tests, maintenance of machines, how to use consumables, and how to generate Soil Health Cards using test results through SHC portal.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
question: How will awareness be generated among farmers regarding SHC?
answer: Entrepreneurs will be trained for awareness generation of farmers about fertiliser use and crop recommendation based on Soil health Card.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
question: On what basis will VLSTL provide recommendations?
answer: VLSTL will generate customised soil nutrient recommendations based on analysis results. By considering the specific nutrient requirements of different crops and the nutrient levels in the soil, these labs provide farmers with recommendations for fertiliser application.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
question: Are there any additional incentives for certain genders, or certain caste/minority farmers?
answer: No, the scheme treats all farmers as equal,

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
question: Can village level STLs be set up by SHGs?
answer: Yes, VLSTLs can be set up by SHGs under The Rural Awareness Works Experience (RAWE) programme, Krishi Sakhis, students of government schools, and agriculture graduates from SAUs, PACS, etc. The labs should be operated by local youth.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
question: Is there a minimum education requirement for the entrepreneur setting up the VLSTL?
answer: Yes, the applicant should be 10th pass with science and knowledge of computer

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
question: How much time will the approval from SLEC take?
answer: SLEC will finalise the entrepreneur's proposals received from the District Level Executive Committee (DLEC). The entire procedure will take maximum one month.

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
question: Post approval from SLEC, how much time will it take for release of funds?
answer: State government will release financial assistance to entrepreneurs within a week after approval of application

scheme_name: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility Village level Soil Testing Lab
question: When should the entrepreneur submit bills/receipts of procurement?
answer: Entrepreneurs after receiving fund will submit receipts of procurement of lab equipment, consumables, etc. to DLEC within 15 days

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: What is "Raw Material Assistance Scheme"?
answer: In order to assist the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in procuring the raw material(s), NSIC arranges to provide raw material as per specific needs and requirement of the unit(s).

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: Who can avail assistance under the Scheme?
answer: Any Manufacturing/Service MSME having Udyam Registration Certificate can apply for the assistance under the Scheme.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: Does NSIC facilitate procurement of raw materials for trading activities?
answer: No trading activity allowed under Raw Materials Assistance Scheme.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: Does NSIC facilitate MSMEs for raw material procurement against advance payment or on credit?
answer: NSIC facilitates MSMEs in raw material procurement in both way i.e. against advance payment and also on credit, as per the requirement of MSMEs

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: How to apply for raw material assistance on credit under the Scheme?
answer: Any MSME needs raw materials through NSIC may apply to any of the NSIC field offices for Raw Material Assistance in the prescribed application forms, which can be downloaded from NSIC's website (www.nsic.co.in) or may be obtained from any of the field offices.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: Where to submit application for raw material assistance?
answer: The duly filled in application form along with prescribed documents can be submitted with the nearest branch office of NSIC. Details of NSIC offices are available on www.nsic.co.in.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: How the limit is sanctioned for procurement of material on credit?
answer: A limit is sanctioned keeping in view the raw materials requirements of the unit, financial position of the unit and available security of equivalent value in the form of bank guarantee.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: Whether there is any ceiling of the limit to be sanctioned under the Scheme?
answer: Maximum exposure to a single unit under the scheme is ₹1000 Lakhs in case of manufacturing unit and ₹600 lakhs in case of service unit. Maximum exposure to an Infrastructure unit will be ₹500 lakhs whether individual or group. The ceiling for maximum exposure to all associate/sister concerns or connected accounts belonging to a 'GROUP' is fixed at ₹2000 lakh for manufacturing units, ₹1500 Lakh for service units and ₹500 Lakh for Infrastructure unit.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: What is the validity of the limits sanctioned under the Scheme?
answer: One year. Thereafter, the limit can be renewed for one year provided conduct of the account was satisfactory during last year.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: How does NSIC provide credit support to MSMEs for procurement of raw materials?
answer: The unit has to submit proforma invoice/ original invoice/ material receipt note with the specific request to release the payment. The maximum assistance is provided upto 95% of the Bank Guarantee value.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: Whether payment is released to the MSME?
answer: No. NSIC releases the payment to the supplier as requested by the MSME.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: What is the credit period of the assistance provided?
answer: The credit is allowed for 180 days. However, it can further be extended on the request of MSME with the consent of the respective Zonal Head, provided the unit serves interest, the total outstanding is within the Bank Guarantee limit and the Bank Guarantee remains valid for an extended period.

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: What are the benefits to MSMEs under the Raw Material Assistance Scheme?
answer: - Materials facilitated under Bulk supply arrangements are provided at the bulk supplier's rate by eliminating the middlemen. | - Discounts received under bulk supplies arrangements are shared with MSMEs, enabling them to reduce the cost of purchase of materials. | - Availability of raw material on credit and enabling MSMEs to execute the orders in hand

scheme_name: Raw Material Assistance Scheme
question: What is the rate of interest charged, if repayment is not made within 180 days?
answer: 1.25% per quarter.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance To 100% Disabled Child Of Ex-Servicemen
question: What Is Validity Of This Scheme?
answer: The benefit under this scheme is valid for the lifetime of child. However "life certificate" and "Disability Certificate" on the Govt prescribed format, need to be submitted through the respective ZSB by 15 January for the grant to be continued in the next financial year.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance To 100% Disabled Child Of Ex-Servicemen
question: What Is The Frequency Of Benefit?
answer: The Financial Assistance Will Be Provided Once In Year.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: How To Renew The Scholarship For Second Year?
answer: The applicant has to follow the same process as followed while applying for first time.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Can I Get My Tuition Fee Reimbursed Under This Scheme?
answer: This Is Not A Tuition Fee Reimbursement Scheme

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Can I Give Bank Details Of Any Bank?
answer: No. Account details of only State Bank of India (SBI) or Punjab National Bank (PNB) is valid for application.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Can I Apply For This Scheme Even If I Am Getting Other Scholarship?
answer: No, One can apply for this scheme only if he/she has not taken any | money/grant from the state or present employer in the form of education | allowance or scholarship.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Do I Have To Submit Hard Copy Of Application Form In Zonal Sainik Board.?
answer: Yes. The applicant has to take hard copy of the filled application form at the time of Verification.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Can A Daughter Of Ex Servicemen Who Is Studying In College Apply For Scholarship Under This Scheme?
answer: Yes. However, if either of the parents of girl is alive then they have to apply on behalf of daughter.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: In Which Month One Can Apply For This Scheme?
answer: One has to apply in the month of May for non-board classes, in July for the board classes 10th & 12th and in August for under-graduate course students.

scheme_name: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
question: What is the purpose of this scheme?
answer: To provide financial relief to orphan children of ex-servicemen.

scheme_name: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
question: How much is the assistance?
answer: ₹3,000 per month, paid annually.

scheme_name: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
question: Who implements the scheme?
answer: The scheme was implemented by the Kendriya Sainik Board Secretariat.

scheme_name: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
question: Who is eligible?
answer: Sons below 21 years and unmarried daughters of deceased ESM and spouse.

scheme_name: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
question: What if the daughter gets married?
answer: The assistance stops immediately.

scheme_name: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
question: What documents are needed?
answer: Service discharge book, death certificates, birth certificate, bank details, and unmarried certificate (for girls).

scheme_name: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
question: Can the payment be made monthly?
answer: No, it is paid annually.

scheme_name: RMEWF- Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of ESM
question: How is payment made?
answer: Through ECS directly to the bank account.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
question: Who is eligible for the Penury Grant under this scheme?
answer: Only non-pensioner Ex-Servicemen (ESM) up to the rank of Havildar/equivalent and their widows who are living in extreme poverty are eligible. The ESM/widow should be 65 years or older as of 01 April of the financial year in which they are applying. (In case of widows of deceased beneficiaries, the age criterion does not apply.)

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
question: What is the amount of financial assistance provided under the scheme?
answer: The scheme provides ₹4,000 per month, paid annually (i.e., ₹48,000 per year) to the eligible Ex-Servicemen or their widows.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
question: Is the assistance under this scheme transferable to other family members after the death of the ESM or widow?
answer: No. The assistance is non-transferable. After the death of an ESM, the widow must apply afresh to receive the benefit.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
question: What are the exclusion criteria for this scheme?
answer: Any Ex-Serviceman receiving a pension is not eligible for this scheme. The scheme is strictly meant for non-pensioners.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
question: What documents are required to apply for the scheme?
answer: The applicant must upload: | - Complete Service Document/Discharge Book (all pages) | - Identity Card issued by ZSWO- Age proof (if not in service document) | - Aadhaar Card | - Bank Passbook (first page) and Cancelled Cheque | - Certificate of Penury (in prescribed format) | Specimen Format here

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
question: What is the verification process after application submission?
answer: The Zila Sainik Welfare Office (ZSWO) will: | - Verify all uploaded documents | - Certify that the applicant has no income or pension- Ensure that no financial aid has been taken from other government sources | - Recommend the case to the Kendriya Sainik Board

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
question: What is the timeline for processing and payment of the assistance?
answer: Once approved by the Secretary of KSB, the payment is processed by the Accounts Section and directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account via ECS. Applications are typically processed quarterly.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
question: How can applicants track their application status?
answer: Visit: https://ksb.gov.in/index.htm | Click on "Status of application", then enter your DAK ID and verification code.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Ex-Servicemen In Penury
question: What is the process for receiving the grant in subsequent years?
answer: Beneficiaries must submit a Life Certificate online, countersigned by the ZSWO, between 01 December and 31 March every year. | - Digital Life Certificates or certificates signed by any other authority are not accepted.- Failure to submit on time will result in non-payment for that year.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Vocational Training Of Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Can I Apply For Multiple Vocational Courses?
answer: This is a one time benefit and for only one vocational course.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Vocational Training Of Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Can I Apply While Pursuing Vocational Training?
answer: No. Widow can apply only when she has successfully completed her vocational training.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Vocational Training Of Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Can I Give Bank Details Of Any Bank?
answer: No. Account Details Of Only State Bank Of India (SBI) Or Punjab National Bank (PNB) Is Valid For Application.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Vocational Training Of Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Will Old Cases Of Financial Assistance Be Considered For This Scheme?
answer: Old Cases Will Not Be Entertained.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Medical Treatment Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Can I Take The Benefit Of This Scheme For Treatment In Any Private Or Government Hospital?
answer: No. the financial assistance will be provided for expenditure incurred at recognized government hospitals at rates approved under CGHS/ ECHS.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Medical Treatment Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Can I Give Bank Details Of Any Bank?
answer: No. Account details of only State Bank of India (SBI) or Punjab National Bank (PNB) is valid for application.

scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Medical Treatment Of Ex-Servicemen
question: Whose Account Details Can Be Filled In The Registration Form?
answer: The applicant has to fill his/her Aadhaar linked bank account number.

scheme_name: Reimbursement of membership Fee in Government promoted E-Commerce Portals
question: What is this scheme ?
answer: Reimbursement of Membership fee of Government promoted e-commerce portals Scheme is a sub scheme under National Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Hub (NSSH) scheme.

scheme_name: Reimbursement of membership Fee in Government promoted E-Commerce Portals
question: What are the benefits ?
answer: The financial assistance may be provided 80% or a maximum of ₹ 25,000/- (excluding applicable taxes) whichever is less, per financial year for new as well as renewals for SC/ST MSE.

scheme_name: Reimbursement of membership Fee in Government promoted E-Commerce Portals
question: Who can get the scheme benefits?
answer: - Applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste(SC) / Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. | - He/She should represent any Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs).
